title: 1023 | Senior UX/UI Designer
description:
Intetics Inc., a leading American technology company specializing in custom software application development, distributed professional teams creation, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is on the lookout for a Senior UX/UI Designer to join our team and provide exceptional customer support.

Long-term cooperation on an as-needed basis, with potential part-time assignments and travel to the client’s office if required

Responsibilities

• Translate business requirements, user needs, and functional constraints into user journeys, user flows, wireframes, and interface designs

• Create consistent, usable interfaces aligned with design standards and business objectives

• Build and maintain interactive, clickable prototypes in Figma

• Present designs to stakeholders and end users, validate assumptions, and identify usability issues

• Refine designs based on structured feedback and validation results

• Collaborate with Business Analysts, business owners, developers, and delivery teams throughout design and implementation

• Align designs with requirements and acceptance criteria, communicate design decisions, and maintain consistency across screens and interactions

• Prepare production-ready designs and support developers during implementation

• Verify that implemented interfaces conform to approved designs

• Support multiple concurrent projects while following established delivery processes, quality standards, and information security requirements

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in UX/UI, product design, interaction design, or an equivalent role involving digital products or applications

• 3+ years of hands-on experience using Figma to create wireframes, interface designs, component-based layouts, and interactive prototypes

• 3+ years of experience translating business requirements and user needs into user journeys, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and production-ready interface designs

• 3+ years of collaboration with Business Analysts, business stakeholders, and development teams across design, validation, and implementation

• Proven experience presenting and validating designs with stakeholders or end users and incorporating feedback through iterative design cycles

• Experience leading or supporting multiple concurrent projects

• Experience working independently and within multidisciplinary teams in complex environments involving multiple teams, vendors, countries, or business functions

• Experience delivering digital products or designs within structured and/or Agile environments

• Understanding of enterprise applications, integrations, technical dependencies, and non-functional requirements relevant to design decisions

• Experience working in accordance with information security, privacy, confidentiality, and data protection requirements

• A university degree or professional qualification in design, UX design, graphic design, digital design, human-computer interaction, or a related field

• A portfolio containing at least two examples of your own designs for digital products or applications that have been implemented

Would be a plus:

• Experience working with or for large organizations with complex structures and multiple business units

• At least one relevant professional certification, such as Nielsen Norman Group UX Certification, Certified Usability Analyst (CUA), Google UX Design Professional Certificate, Interaction Design Foundation UX certificates, IAAP CPACC, or WAS

• For university degrees, the awarding institution must rank among the top 500 in an overall or subject-specific university ranking

title: Director of Design - Maternity Cover (9 months FTC)
description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

We are looking for an experienced design leader to provide maternity cover for our Director of Design from January 2027. You will cover the full remit for the duration of the leave: leading a team of product designers and a graphic design team, and making sure Design keeps moving forward on its strategic priorities during the leave.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set direction, unblock and coach designers, and be the senior voice for Design across Product, Tech and Marketing, while stepping in on design work where it matters most.

•

Product Design: a team of product designers spread across Kpler's verticals (Commodities, Maritime, Chartering & Freight, Pricing & Trading, Platform). The focus is mainly B2B, with some B2C work, mostly on Mobile. Product Design is embedded end to end with Product, and we are accelerating on AI-assisted design to funnel non-designers' prototyping into good practice.

•

Graphic Design: a team of graphic, motion and brand designers, including freelancers, working across brand, marketing and data visualisation. We are accelerating our graphic and motion design with AI initiatives, giving the marketing team tools to speed up their work while keeping the brand consistent across the board.

Responsibilities

Leadership

• Lead and line-manage the product design team day to day: 1:1s, performance and probation management, coaching, career development.

• Provide a single point of contact for Design towards Product, Engineering and senior leadership.

• Maintain the Design coverage map so every crew knows who their designer is and who owns what.

• Support hiring in progress and onboarding of new joiners and freelancers.

Product design

• Own design quality and consistency across all Kpler products.

• Support and track delivery across the team, and act as decision maker where priorities overlap or conflict.

• Coach the team and Product on discovery, UX research and evidence-led design.

• Drive adoption of AI-assisted design workflows and guidelines, including how non-designers contribute prototypes.

Graphic design

• Set creative direction and priorities for graphic design in partnership with the Lead Graphic Designer and Marketing.

• Oversee the brand refresh, brand consistency in external materials (including AI-generated and motion content) and data visualisation standards.

• Help define and make work the operating model between Graphic Design and Marketing (service desk, briefs, sprint plans).

• Manage freelance graphic design resources.

Hands-on design

•

Step into critical product or brand work to unblock the team or cover gaps.

Must haves / Skills & Experience

• 8+ years in design, with 3+ years leading designers, ideally across product and brand/marketing design.

• Strong product design portfolio for complex B2B / data-heavy software; credible graphic design / brand sensibility.

• Experience managing a distributed, multi-disciplinary team and working with freelancers.

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders in Product, Tech and Marketing and to make decisions in ambiguity.

• Fluent with Figma and design systems; comfortable with AI-assisted design and prototyping tools.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Able to start in January 2027, with a handover period before the leave begins.

Nice to have

• Experience in fintech, data, maritime, energy or commodities.

• Experience designing a B2C mobile app.

title: UX Content Designer
description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels.

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline UX Content Design Team 👋

The UX Content Design team is a small but high-impact group of Content Designers and Localisation experts working across Trainline’s most important initiatives. We sit within the Product organisation as part of a wider cross-functional UX team, partnering closely with UX Designers, Engineers, Product Managers, and insight specialists to cut through the complexity of travel for millions of users across more than 40 countries.

We work from discovery so we can shape the best content decisions early, and you’ll be right at the heart of that. In this role, you’ll have genuine end-to-end ownership of meaningful projects, with the backing of an experienced content design team around you. You’ll report to the UX Content Lead, who will support your priorities, skill development, and career growth, while bringing your own areas of influence to a team tackling some genuinely interesting challenges.

In this role as the Content Designer, you will...🚄

•
Co-design clear, intuitive end-to-end user journeys and contribute to content strategy across key Trainline initiatives

•
Bring clarity to propositions by working with our tone of voice, adapting how it dials up or down to support users across different contexts and needs

•
Take AI prototypes through testing and refinement with real rail users, helping to shape how emerging technology serves our travellers

•
Develop and execute content strategies that drive conversion, using insights, testing, and performance data to strengthen your decisions

•
Create scalable content governance standards for internal and customer-facing agents, contributing to how our content strategy is interpreted and applied at scale

•
Advise on inclusive and accessible content best practices with the wider Product team

•
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Research, and Engineering across workshops and sprints

•
Think deeply about localisation, ensuring the content you create works meaningfully for travellers across the more than 40 countries we serve

We’d love to hear from you if you have...🔍

•
A solid background in content design for digital products, with examples of work you’re proud of - whether from professional experience or personal projects you’ve dedicated time to (please include one or two links in your CV or application)

•
Experience testing and optimising content, using data and user insight to inform and strengthen your decisions

•
Confidence working with a tone of voice and adapting it to suit different user needs and contexts throughout a journey

•
Comfort experimenting with AI in your content practice - you don’t need to be an expert, but an openness to exploring AI systems and governance is important to us

•
A collaborative mindset with the ability to communicate your rationale clearly and effectively to teammates and stakeholders

•
A foundational understanding of UX best practices and design principles

•
Ideally, some experience in the travel, transport, or ecommerce industry, though equivalent commercial experience is equally welcome

•
It would be a bonus if you have experience writing content rules for AI systems, though this is a growing area and we’re happy to support your development here

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits.

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one!

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do:

•
💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail

•
✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey

•
🤝 Travel Together - We're one team

•
♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

title: VP of Design
description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•

SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•

SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•

SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•

Committed to our customers and community.

•

Obsessed with quality.

•

Deliberate in our decisions.

Effective as one team.

Position description

Sonar is looking for a VP of Design to own the end-to-end design vision and execution across our product portfolio. Reporting to the CPO, this is Sonar's most senior design leadership role, responsible for setting design strategy, scaling a high-performing global design organization, and ensuring our products deliver an exceptional, cohesive experience for developers and enterprise customers alike. Define and drive a design strategy that ties directly to measurable business outcomes, working with Product and Engineering leadership to prioritize investments. Track and report on design's impact on key business and product metrics.

Build, scale, and lead a global design organization, including hiring, mentoring, and developing design talent to foster a high-performing, creative, and inclusive team culture.

•

Champion and evolve Sonar's design systems and UX best practices, ensuring consistency and quality across a complex, technical, developer-facing product suite.

•

Guide the design approach for agentic and AI-driven features, ensuring the team understands emerging patterns and best practices in this space.

•

Engage directly with customers, users, and industry leaders to gather insights, and translate those insights into actionable, high-impact design solutions.

•

Represent design at the executive level, communicating strategy, trade-offs, and progress to executive leadership and cross-functional, global stakeholders.

•

Partner with Product Management and Engineering to ensure design is embedded early in the product development process, not bolted on at the end.

Experience and qualifications

•

7+ years of management experience in product design, UX, or a related field, with a proven track record of leading and scaling teams globally.

•

Demonstrated success in end-to-end product design leadership, including visual design, interaction design, workflows, strategic product thinking, and platform evolution.

•

Deep expertise in design systems and UX best practices, including experience designing for developer tools, API based tools, or similar technical/complex products.

•

Good understanding of the agentic domain and how it shapes product and design decisions.

•

Experience defining design strategy that drives measurable business outcomes.

•

Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across executive leadership, cross-functional teams, and global stakeholders.

•

Proven ability to mentor and develop design talent, fostering a high-performing, creative, and inclusive global design culture.

•

Deep understanding of customer needs and market trends, with experience engaging directly with users and industry leaders to translate insights into actionable, high-impact design solutions.

title: Product Designer

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.

You will belong to one of our product areas, where you’ll help ensure that our developer and agent users write better code and have a seamless experience in the product.

Research and map complex user workflows to ensure our solutions are intuitive and highly functional.

Listen to our users and customers to understand their needs. Develop a deep understanding of the SDLC and how we can enable developers and AI agents to produce better quality software.

•

Work closely with other product designers to ensure a cohesive information architecture and a unified experience across the entire product platform.

•

Align with your product manager on problem definition, providing design solutions throughout the end-to-end development stage.

•

Partner with engineering teams early in the design process to vet technical feasibility and uncover edge cases.

•

Help the Product Design team grow by contributing to our design processes, tools, and collaborative frameworks.

Experience and qualifications

•

Experience organizing data-heavy environments into logical structures and mapping user journeys that minimize friction.

Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience using AI tools to accelerate research, ideation and design velocity.

•

A self-starter mindset with the drive to identify UX gaps and propose structural improvements without being prompted.

Ability to articulate design decisions and the "why" behind them to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Comfort working in a cross-functional environment where feedback is shared openly and success is a team effort.

Delivery mindset. Your role does not end when the design is handed off.

title: Principal UX Designer
description:

Are you fascinated by IPs that blend genres in interesting ways and approach UXUI in potentially novel ways? Are you delighted by game interfaces that make it frictionless to play with friends? Do you spend time dissecting trends in game UX and interaction design?

As a Principal UX Designer on teamLFG, you will drive the UX/UI of an Unannounced Project from pre-production and beyond. From early technical planning and user flows to playtesting and tweaking the UI of the shipping game, you’ll use research, prototyping, and collaboration to turn gameplay ideas into user experiences that support both player needs and product goals. title: Product Designer - Paris
description:
As a Product Designer, you'll work on the H Platform, where our users create and run agentic AI workflows powered by our models. Nobody has written the playbook for designing these experiences yet. Our next stage is making the platform truly useful for its users and levelling it up, in design as much as in technology, and you'll build the product experiences that deliver real value in organisations.

At H Company, we believe AI should take action in the real world, and our mission is to make agentic AI genuinely useful for large organisations. We're pioneers in computer use: our own vision-language models power agents that see, click and type their way through the software businesses already run, with no integrations or rebuilds, and we own the whole stack, from research and models to the products built on top of them.

What you'll be doing

•
Talking to our users constantly to understand their needs and figure out what will make the platform truly useful for them.

•
Turning those insights into research and explorations, looking at problems from different angles before settling on a direction.

•
Picking the right tool for each task: a Figma design, a prototype, or a small PR when a quick change is the fastest way to ship.

•
Testing what you build with users, measuring its impact (A/B testing, user interviews, users daily use data...) and iterating quickly based on what you learn.

•
Shaping the roadmap together with the whole team, engineers and PMs alike.

Who you'll work with

The role sits in our Product team, which is responsible for product direction, strategy and design. You'll join the product designer who owns design and UX today, and work closely with product, engineering and forward deployed engineers.

What we think it takes

Above all, we want someone who cares deeply about users, has great product taste and can explain it, moves fast while keeping quality high, leaves their ego at the door and welcomes feedback.

Likely a good fit if you

•
Have 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer at tech companies.

•
Have excellent UX, UI and interaction design skills, and can make complex, technical flows, like building and running AI agent workflows, feel simple and intuitive.

•
Have a portfolio that shows your latest work.

•
Have hands-on experience running user tests and A/B tests.

•
Know when a proven solution is good enough and when a problem deserves something new.

•
Have designed complex data or ML/AI-driven products: you know how to make complex systems understandable and how to design for AI behaviour that isn't always predictable, building trust and keeping users in control.

•
Are comfortable in technical discussions: you can dig into constraints and trade-offs with engineers and ramp up quickly on technical topics to discuss them with our researchers and more technical engineers.

•
Are fluent in Figma.

•
Can work within a design system and contribute to it.

Stronger still if you

•
Have designed platforms: complex B2B web or desktop software used by professionals, whether that's tools to build and run workflows, big data and analytics software, operational dashboards or other data-dense interfaces.

•
Are curious about code and AI in your design workflow. Every design team is still figuring out how AI changes the way we work, and we're no different, so we'd love someone who has started experimenting, whether by prototyping in code, building small tools or bringing AI into their process, and who wants to keep exploring with us.

If you match most of this but not every point, apply anyway. We care far more about how you think, your curiosity and your care for users than a perfect match.

How we hire

Four stages: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute portfolio review, a 60-minute design interview in person at our Paris office, and a closing 30-minute conversation.

The portfolio review and design interview are built around your own work and how you design. Please apply with your CV and a link to your portfolio showing your latest work.

description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

At Rippling, Design is central to our mission to free smart people to tackle hard problems. We build products that automate the operational complexity of running a business—from HR and payroll to IT and finance—so our customers can focus on what matters most. In a world of fragmented, outdated systems, we're creating a unified platform where thoughtful design turns complexity into clarity, confidence, and action.

As a Product Design Lead on the HRIS team, you'll play a key role in shaping and scaling Rippling's core HR platform, helping businesses manage their workforce more efficiently across the globe.

You'll own end-to-end product experiences across high-impact areas, from core workflows like hiring and organizational data management to compliance and more. You'll help define a new generation of AI-first experiences, reimagining how work gets done through intelligent, proactive, and increasingly autonomous products that reduce manual effort and free our customers to work on hard problems.

Success in this role requires a designer who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys partnering closely with product, engineering, and cross-functional teams, and can quickly develop deep expertise in new domains. Designers at Rippling are product builders. AI isn't just something we design—it's fundamental to how we work, from exploration and prototyping to shipping world-class customer experiences.

What you will do

• Help define long-term and AI-first strategies within our HRIS portfolio.

• Design new 0-1 experiences, improve and expand existing experiences, and execute on tactical deliverables.

• Design for both employees and HR leaders, delivering flows that feel effortless day to day while providing the control, compliance, and visibility required at scale.

• Collaborate tightly with Product and Engineering to make high-velocity decisions, ship with urgency, and advocate relentlessly for customers at every step.

• Partner closely with our Product Research team, collaborate and support research projects, and use insights in your design work.

• Champion a consumer-grade quality bar, elevating craft across the portfolio and mentoring designers in systems thinking, interaction design, and visual polish.

• Work closely with other designers to develop and expand our design system.

What you will need

• 8+ years of end-to-end product design experience shipping complex, high-impact products from concept to launch, then iterating based on what you learn.

• A portfolio that shows you can turn messy, ambiguous problems into simple, intuitive workflows, especially in complex domains.

• Active use of LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) in your design workflow whether for research, requirements, copy, or exploration.

• Comfort with AI-assisted prototyping tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar), even if you're not writing production code.

• Strong interaction and visual design craft, with the ability to produce polished work across edge cases and states, and communicate clear, build-ready specs.

• Relentless customer focus, backed by a habit of digging into real behavior, identifying pain points, and designing solutions that solve meaningful problems.

• Excellent communication and storytelling, from crisp async write-ups to persuasive presentations that drive alignment and decisions.

• A track record of working effectively with Product and Engineering, moving quickly while holding a high quality bar.

• Comfort operating in fast-moving environments, juggling multiple work-streams, unblocking dependencies, and owning timelines with minimal oversight.

title: Senior Product Designer - Cards & Credit
description:
In 1954, architect Eero Saarinen designed a radically modern bank branch for Irwin Union in Columbus, Indiana. With glass walls, no private offices, and a floor plan that invited openness, it embodied a new kind of transparency in finance. The building was surrounded by trees, furnished by Herman Miller, and featured rustic brick flooring. Today, that space is a conference center, and that spirit of design-forward thinking in banking* feels all but extinct.

Mercury believes that level of care and craft in design has been lost in modern finance, and we’re building products that bring it back. Cards and credit are built on complicated systems and inherited conventions, but our customers shouldn’t have to experience that complexity. We believe thoughtful design can turn something traditionally transactional into an experience that feels simple, intuitive, and distinctly Mercury.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Cards & Credit team. You’ll tackle complex product problems, question inherited assumptions, and shape experiences that help startups spend less time banking and more time building.

In this role, you’ll:

• Own meaningful Cards & Credit product problems from initial framing through shipped experience, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to understand the problem and shape what we should build.

• Turn complicated systems, requirements, and edge cases into experiences that feel remarkably simple and intuitive.

• Work across the entire design stack, from framing problems and exploring concepts to workflows, detailed interactions, visual design, prototyping, and final implementation.

• Explore broadly and design from first principles, questioning inherited patterns and assumptions when a better answer may exist.

• Bring a high level of interaction and visual craft to the Cards & Credit experience, from the structure of a workflow to the details of hierarchy, typography, motion, and state.

• Collaborate with Mercury’s Brand team on physical cards and related products, creating a cohesive experience between the objects our customers hold and the product experiences surrounding them.

• Develop a deep understanding of our customers, communicate the reasoning behind your decisions clearly, and work through tradeoffs with your partners to arrive at the strongest solution.

What you’ll bring:

• A strong portfolio of product work demonstrating exceptional product thinking, interaction design, and visual craft.

• An ability to understand complicated systems and turn them into simple, thoughtful product experiences.

• Deep curiosity about why a problem exists before deciding how to solve it, with a willingness to question assumptions and work from first principles.

• Real ambition for the work itself. You want to do the best work of your career here, and you’re energized by being surrounded by people who hold themselves to the same bar.

• A high bar for craft and the judgment to know where additional thought and detail meaningfully improve an experience.

• Comfort navigating ambiguity and taking ownership without waiting for every requirement to be defined.

• A habit of exploring multiple possibilities, prototyping ideas, and changing direction when a stronger solution emerges.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to articulate your thinking, explain tradeoffs, and build conviction with Product and Engineering partners.

• Deep care for customers and an ambition to create products that don’t just function well, but genuinely make their lives better.

You don’t need a background in banking, fintech, cards, or credit. We care much more about whether you’ve demonstrated the ability to understand complicated problems and turn them into simple, thoughtful product experiences.

Complexity can be learned. The instinct to find its essence is harder to teach.

The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits. Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

Infilla’s mission is to make more housing happen faster by making permitting unremarkable. The U.S. is short 4-7 million homes, and local permitting is one of the top bottlenecks with approvals taking months to years. Infilla is building the modern permitting platform that helps local governments review projects faster, more consistently, and more transparently. Customers include San Francisco, New York City, and the State of Delaware, among others. We’re backed by Basis Set Ventures, Base10 Partners, Urban Innovation Fund, SHAKTI VC, 20Growth, Bloomberg Beta, and 20+ founders/operators who’ve built products at scale.

WHAT YOU’LL DELIVER

•
Design and deliver the Inspections MVP to live customers within 3 months of start, and Code Enforcement within 5.

•
Maintain the Infilla design system after the contractor build, across web and mobile components, so engineers and coding agents implement from it without translation and with minimal drift as new surfaces ship.

•
Enable engineers to independently ship UI that meets the bar through shared design principles, a working critique practice, and a design system that makes the consistent choice the easy one.

WHAT YOU’VE DONE BEFORE

•
You’ve designed, shipped, and iterated on 0-to-1 B2B mobile apps that real users use

•
You’ve independently owned cross-platform, end-to-end designs without a design manager

•
You use AI in the work itself, daily

WHAT YOU’RE GREAT AT

•
Product judgment & scoping - Takes a fuzzy problem and decides what makes the MVP and what waits. Grounds decisions in how the work is actually done rather than in what similar products look like.

•
Design craft - Makes intuitive experiences that hold up in real conditions, across native mobile and dense desktop, from information architecture through visual detail.

•
Systems thinking - Designs products that fit a coherent whole — thinks in models and workflows rather than just screens, and keeps the design system consistent as new surfaces ship.

•
Design enablement - Makes other people better at design without doing the work themselves. Co-creates the principles and holds the bar when engineers ship UI unassisted.

•
Ownership in ambiguity - Makes progress without a spec, a PM, or a clear brief. Decides and moves rather than waiting for the requirements to firm up.

NICE TO HAVE, NOT NEEDED

•
You’ve designed for deskless workers, government staff, or less technology-savvy users

•
You’ve designed AI product surfaces

•
You’ve maintained design systems

•
You’ve designed products that meet WCAG AA 2.1 accessibility standards

•
You have experience with brand design or marketing design work

•
You are a former founder, beyond being a solopreneur or consultant

Research shows women & minorities are more likely to consider themselves unqualified if they don’t meet every single requirement in a job description. This represents what we’re ideally looking for, but everyone is unique. We hire for strengths & potential, not lack of weakness or a perfect resume fit.

DETAILS

•
This is a full-time remote role based in either LatAm. If you'd prefer to start on a contract basis, we're open to that

•
You will join as 2nd designer and report to the Founder & CEO

•
Competitive salary based on experience and working location

•
US-based employee benefits: meaningful equity, healthcare / vision / dental insurance, 401K, and 26 days of PTO including federal holidays

THE PROCESS

We aim to make this happen in 2 weeks:

•
Initial call with Savanna to assess mutual fit (20 min)

•
Design portfolio deep dive with Daria to assess design craft (60 min)

•
Jam session #1 with Phi to assess product judgment & scoping (60 min)

•
Team day onsite (virtual onsite for remote candidates)
- Jam session #2 with Carl to assess systems thinking (60 min)
- Scaling design taste conversation with Brandon to assess design enablement (30 min)
- Founder conversation with Jenny to assess ownership in ambiguity (45 min)

•
Reference checks (manager, PM peer, designer peer, engineering peer)

HOW WE WORK

•
Ideas > Hierarchy - Best idea wins regardless of source. Be intellectually honest.

•
Kind > Nice - Share clear, helpful feedback often. Voice your concerns and listen.

•
Courage > Comfort - We do the right thing, even when hard or uncomfortable.

•
Hours > Weeks - Solve it in hours, not "eventually." Speed is our biggest edge as a startup.

•
Fix > Flag - See a problem, own it, and fix it — don't wait for someone else to.

LEGAL

Infilla is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need an accommodation at any point in the interview process, let us know and we'll make it work.

title: Healthcare to UX Design Career Changer Apprenticeship
description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.

We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

• Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design

• Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables

• Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules

• Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

• Build digital products and services 0-1

• Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice

• Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management

• Identify target market for product and position product for launch success

• Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process

• Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics

• Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users

• Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales

• Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights

• Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution

• Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables

• Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea

• Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution

• Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options

• Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

title: Design Lead
description:
Design Lead

Quatrain Creative

About the Company

Quatrain is a fully remote, woman-owned content agency that blends strategy, storytelling, and design to create high-impact content. For more than a decade, our team of experienced writers, designers, and content strategists has worked with B2B brands across industries—from education to technology—to craft compelling blog posts, case studies, ebooks, videos, and more. Our values define everything we do, and we are deeply committed to a culture that is positive, transparent, collaborative, and grounded in trust. Our team members enjoy flexible schedules, family-friendly PTO policies, and true work-life balance.

Position Overview

We're looking for a hands-on Design Lead to own the quality and execution of our design work. You'll split your time between creating design work yourself and leading a small team of freelance designers. You'll develop creative briefs, review deliverables, and help ensure projects meet client expectations and high creative standards while staying on schedule and within budget. You will represent our design team in client meetings, confidently communicating with clients and leading design discussions. You'll also contribute to the evolution of our agency's website and internal creative processes.

Please note: This is not a branding, web, or marketing campaign design role. We specialize in designing content-heavy marketing assets for B2B companies, and we're looking for someone with deep experience creating polished, professional editorial-style marketing assets.

Our ideal candidate has an exceptional portfolio featuring ebooks, guidebooks, white papers, case studies, sales collateral, slide decks, infographics, and other editorial-style marketing assets. Many of our projects are +20 pages and require expert typography, page layout, information hierarchy, and production skills in Adobe InDesign and PowerPoint.

* If your experience is primarily in branding, UI/UX, websites, paid media, packaging, environmental design, illustration, or advertising campaigns, this role is likely not the right fit.

Core Responsibilities

• Produce high-quality design work for multiple clients (approximately 50-70% of your time).

• Design long-form marketing assets including ebooks, guidebooks, case studies, white papers, sales collateral, slide decks, and infographics with a strong emphasis on typography, layout, and readability.

• Manage and mentor a small group of freelance designers.

• Write creative briefs and translate client needs into actionable design direction.

• Review and provide feedback on design deliverables.

• Attend client meetings as the design lead and communicate creative decisions clearly.

• Coordinate design workflows and maintain consistency across projects.

• Build and maintain internal style guides for each of our clients.

• Improve and maintain the agency website and other internal creative assets.

• Help establish design standards, templates, and processes as the agency grows.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design or related field.

• 5+ years of professional graphic or digital design experience, preferably in an agency or client services environment.

• Experience leading or mentoring designers, freelancers, or creative teams.

• Confidence leading client meetings, advising clients on design direction, presenting creative work, and communicating design decisions to clients.

• Experience developing creative briefs and translating business goals into effective visual solutions.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to provide thoughtful, constructive design feedback.

• Excellent organization and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• Proficiency with PowerPoint and Adobe Creative Cloud, with advanced knowledge of Adobe InDesign.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment with little direction or oversight.

• Must reside in Eastern or Central time zone and be available to work Eastern business hours.

•
A portfolio is required and should demonstrate significant experience designing long-form, content-heavy marketing materials. We're specifically looking for work such as ebooks, guidebooks, white papers, case studies, sales sheets, slide decks, infographics, and other editorial-style business collateral. Experience focused primarily on branding, logos, websites, UI/UX, packaging, environmental graphics, or paid advertising does not align with the primary responsibilities of this role.

Bonus Qualifications

• Experience with web design and tools like Webflow

• Experience with PM tools like Monday, Asana, or Wrike

• Experience designing for B2B clients in tech or education

• Basic motion graphics experience

Benefits

• $80,000/yr salary

• Flexible work schedule

• Fully remote

• 12 days of paid time off for federal/school holidays

• Annual office closure from Christmas Eve to New Years Day

• Unlimited PTO after 90 days of employment

• HRA available after 90 days of employment

Salary: $80,000 / year

title: Senior UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer 2 – AI
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI to help define the next generation of intelligent experiences across Intermedia's products.
In this role, you will design experiences that make artificial intelligence useful, intuitive, trustworthy, and approachable for business users. You will work at the intersection of UX strategy, interaction design, generative AI, conversational experiences, and enterprise software, turning sophisticated AI capabilities into simple experiences that solve real customer problems.
You will partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML teams, Engineering, Research, and other designers throughout the complete product lifecycle—from customer and market research through concepts, prototyping, development, launch, and post-launch analysis.
This is not simply a role for adding AI features to existing interfaces. You will help define how users interact with AI across our products, including copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, recommendations, summarization, intelligent automation, and agentic experiences.

Responsibilities
AI Experience Design

• Design intuitive user experiences for AI-powered capabilities across web, desktop, mobile, and administrative interfaces.

• Explore new interaction models for generative AI, including conversational interfaces, copilots, AI assistants, intelligent recommendations, content generation, summarization, and AI-driven workflow automation.

• Design experiences for emerging agentic AI capabilities where AI systems can reason, recommend actions, execute tasks, and coordinate multi-step workflows on behalf of users.

• Translate complex AI functionality into simple, understandable interactions appropriate for everyday business users.

• Determine when AI should proactively assist users versus when users should explicitly initiate or control AI functionality.

• Design effective patterns for prompts, suggestions, generated content, AI actions, confirmations, feedback, and human intervention.

• Create experiences that communicate what an AI system is doing, why it made a recommendation, and what actions it has taken or intends to take.

UX & Product Design

• Own design initiatives from discovery and concept development through prototyping, implementation, launch, and post-launch optimization.

• Conduct user research, usability studies, interviews, competitive analysis, and workflow analysis to understand customer needs and behaviors.

• Translate customer problems and product requirements into user journeys, workflows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.

• Develop and validate design hypotheses through rapid prototyping and user testing.

• Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows through thoughtful UX and intelligent automation.

• Use qualitative and quantitative data to evaluate experiences and recommend improvements.

• Work closely with Product Management to ensure designs address meaningful customer problems and measurable business outcomes.

AI Trust & Responsible Design

• Design AI experiences that establish appropriate levels of trust, transparency, and user control.

• Clearly distinguish AI-generated information and actions where appropriate.

• Design graceful experiences for uncertainty, incomplete information, errors, hallucinations, and situations where the AI cannot confidently complete a request.

• Create effective confirmation, undo, escalation, and human-in-the-loop patterns for AI-driven actions.

• Design feedback mechanisms that allow users to evaluate, correct, or improve AI-generated results.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Privacy, and Legal teams to incorporate responsible AI principles into the user experience.

• Help establish UX guidelines for consistent and responsible use of AI throughout Intermedia products.

Design Systems

• Contribute to and evolve Intermedia's design system to support AI-powered experiences.

• Define reusable patterns and components for conversational interfaces, AI recommendations, generated content, AI actions, status indicators, feedback mechanisms, and agentic workflows.

• Ensure new AI capabilities integrate naturally with established product experiences rather than feeling like disconnected features.

• Maintain consistency across products while identifying where emerging AI interactions require new design paradigms.

• Partner with designers and developers to ensure design-system components are practical, scalable, accessible, and consistently implemented.

Collaboration & Leadership

• Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML engineers, software engineers, architects, researchers, and other designers.

• Facilitate design workshops and collaborative discovery sessions to explore customer problems and AI opportunities.

• Clearly communicate design rationale, research findings, user needs, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Challenge assumptions and advocate for customer-centered solutions when technology or implementation considerations begin driving the experience.

• Provide design leadership and mentorship to other designers and help raise the overall quality of UX across the organization.

• Collaborate effectively across multiple teams and product areas to create coherent end-to-end customer experiences.

• Stay current with emerging AI technologies, interaction patterns, and design practices and translate relevant developments into practical product experiences.

Our Expectations

• 5+ years of professional UI/UX, Product Design, or Interaction Design experience, ideally designing complex SaaS or enterprise software.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, complex workflows, interaction design, and thoughtful problem solving.

• Excellent knowledge of usability, UX/UI, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and human factors principles.

• Strong ability to analyze complex requirements and turn them into simple, elegant solutions.

• Experience conducting or participating in user research and usability testing.

• Strong proficiency with Figma, prototyping tools, and modern design-system practices.

• Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering in an Agile software-development environment.

• Strong communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to work effectively with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.

• Strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of the broader product and customer experience.

AI Experience & Knowledge
We don't expect you to be an AI engineer, but we do expect curiosity and practical fluency with modern AI technologies.
The ideal candidate has:

• Experience designing products or features powered by generative AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation.

• Understanding of large language models (LLMs) and the opportunities and limitations they introduce into product experiences.

• Familiarity with conversational UX and natural-language interfaces.

• Understanding of concepts such as prompts, context, AI-generated content, confidence and uncertainty, hallucinations, and AI feedback loops.

• Familiarity with AI agents and emerging patterns for designing systems that can perform multi-step actions on behalf of users.

• Experience thinking through trust, transparency, explainability, privacy, and user control in AI experiences.

• A strong interest in experimenting with new AI tools and interaction models.

Advantages

• Experience designing enterprise communications, collaboration, contact center, productivity, or workflow-automation products.

• Experience designing AI copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, or agentic workflows.

• Experience developing or contributing to large-scale design systems.

• Experience with voice and multimodal interfaces.

• Understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design.

• Familiarity with HTML/CSS and the technical constraints of modern web applications.

• Experience using AI-assisted design and prototyping tools.

• Experience working with globally distributed Product and Engineering teams.

What Success Looks Like

As a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI, you will help ensure that AI at Intermedia is not simply powerful technology—it is a valuable and trusted customer experience.
Success means:

• Customers immediately understand how AI can help them.

• Complex AI capabilities feel simple and natural to use.

• Users remain informed and in control when AI recommends or takes actions.

• AI features integrate seamlessly into existing customer workflows.

• Common AI interaction patterns become consistent across Intermedia products.

• Research and customer feedback meaningfully influence AI product decisions.

• Product and Engineering teams view Design as a strategic partner in determining what AI experiences should be built, not simply how they should look.

Ultimately, you will help establish the design language and interaction principles that shape how customers experience AI across Intermedia's portfolio.

You will partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML teams, Engineering, Research, and other designers throughout the complete product lifecycle—from customer and market research through concepts, prototyping, development, launch, and post-launch analysis.
This is not simply a role for adding AI features to existing interfaces. You will help define how users interact with AI across our products, including copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, recommendations, summarization, intelligent automation, and agentic experiences.

Key Responsibilities

AI Experience Design

• Design intuitive user experiences for AI-powered capabilities across web, desktop, mobile, and administrative interfaces.

• Explore new interaction models for generative AI, including conversational interfaces, copilots, AI assistants, intelligent recommendations, content generation, summarization, and AI-driven workflow automation.

• Design experiences for emerging agentic AI capabilities where AI systems can reason, recommend actions, execute tasks, and coordinate multi-step workflows on behalf of users.

• Translate complex AI functionality into simple, understandable interactions appropriate for everyday business users.

• Determine when AI should proactively assist users versus when users should explicitly initiate or control AI functionality.

• Design effective patterns for prompts, suggestions, generated content, AI actions, confirmations, feedback, and human intervention.

• Create experiences that communicate what an AI system is doing, why it made a recommendation, and what actions it has taken or intends to take.

UX & Product Design

• Own design initiatives from discovery and concept development through prototyping, implementation, launch, and post-launch optimization.

• Conduct user research, usability studies, interviews, competitive analysis, and workflow analysis to understand customer needs and behaviors.

• Translate customer problems and product requirements into user journeys, workflows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.

• Develop and validate design hypotheses through rapid prototyping and user testing.

• Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows through thoughtful UX and intelligent automation.

• Use qualitative and quantitative data to evaluate experiences and recommend improvements.

• Work closely with Product Management to ensure designs address meaningful customer problems and measurable business outcomes.

AI Trust & Responsible Design

• Design AI experiences that establish appropriate levels of trust, transparency, and user control.

• Clearly distinguish AI-generated information and actions where appropriate.

• Design graceful experiences for uncertainty, incomplete information, errors, hallucinations, and situations where the AI cannot confidently complete a request.

• Create effective confirmation, undo, escalation, and human-in-the-loop patterns for AI-driven actions.

• Design feedback mechanisms that allow users to evaluate, correct, or improve AI-generated results.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Privacy, and Legal teams to incorporate responsible AI principles into the user experience.

• Help establish UX guidelines for consistent and responsible use of AI throughout Intermedia products.

Design Systems

• Contribute to and evolve Intermedia's design system to support AI-powered experiences.

• Define reusable patterns and components for conversational interfaces, AI recommendations, generated content, AI actions, status indicators, feedback mechanisms, and agentic workflows.

• Ensure new AI capabilities integrate naturally with established product experiences rather than feeling like disconnected features.

• Maintain consistency across products while identifying where emerging AI interactions require new design paradigms.

• Partner with designers and developers to ensure design-system components are practical, scalable, accessible, and consistently implemented.

Collaboration & Leadership

• Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML engineers, software engineers, architects, researchers, and other designers.

• Facilitate design workshops and collaborative discovery sessions to explore customer problems and AI opportunities.

• Clearly communicate design rationale, research findings, user needs, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Challenge assumptions and advocate for customer-centered solutions when technology or implementation considerations begin driving the experience.

• Provide design leadership and mentorship to other designers and help raise the overall quality of UX across the organization.

• Collaborate effectively across multiple teams and product areas to create coherent end-to-end customer experiences.

• Stay current with emerging AI technologies, interaction patterns, and design practices and translate relevant developments into practical product experiences.

Our Expectations

• 5+ years of professional UI/UX, Product Design, or Interaction Design experience, ideally designing complex SaaS or enterprise software.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, complex workflows, interaction design, and thoughtful problem solving.

• Excellent knowledge of usability, UX/UI, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and human factors principles.

• Strong ability to analyze complex requirements and turn them into simple, elegant solutions.

• Experience conducting or participating in user research and usability testing.

• Strong proficiency with Figma, prototyping tools, and modern design-system practices.

• Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering in an Agile software-development environment.

• Strong communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to work effectively with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.

• Strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of the broader product and customer experience.

AI Experience & Knowledge
We don't expect you to be an AI engineer, but we do expect curiosity and practical fluency with modern AI technologies.
The ideal candidate has:

• Experience designing products or features powered by generative AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation.

• Understanding of large language models (LLMs) and the opportunities and limitations they introduce into product experiences.

• Familiarity with conversational UX and natural-language interfaces.

• Understanding of concepts such as prompts, context, AI-generated content, confidence and uncertainty, hallucinations, and AI feedback loops.

• Familiarity with AI agents and emerging patterns for designing systems that can perform multi-step actions on behalf of users.

• Experience thinking through trust, transparency, explainability, privacy, and user control in AI experiences.

• A strong interest in experimenting with new AI tools and interaction models.

Advantages

• Experience designing enterprise communications, collaboration, contact center, productivity, or workflow-automation products.

• Experience designing AI copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, or agentic workflows.

• Experience developing or contributing to large-scale design systems.

• Experience with voice and multimodal interfaces.

• Understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design.

• Familiarity with HTML/CSS and the technical constraints of modern web applications.

• Experience using AI-assisted design and prototyping tools.

• Experience working with globally distributed Product and Engineering teams.

What Success Looks Like

As a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI, you will help ensure that AI at Intermedia is not simply powerful technology—it is a valuable and trusted customer experience.
Success means:

• Customers immediately understand how AI can help them.

• Complex AI capabilities feel simple and natural to use.

• Users remain informed and in control when AI recommends or takes actions.

• AI features integrate seamlessly into existing customer workflows.

• Common AI interaction patterns become consistent across Intermedia products.

• Research and customer feedback meaningfully influence AI product decisions.

• Product and Engineering teams view Design as a strategic partner in determining what AI experiences should be built, not simply how they should look.

Ultimately, you will help establish the design language and interaction principles that shape how customers experience AI across Intermedia's portfolio.

title: Senior Product Designer (Fully Remote)
description:
The Role We Need:

PadSplit is hiring a Senior Product Designer to shape and improve experiences across our two-sided housing marketplace. You’ll play a central role in designing intuitive, human, and scalable experiences that create measurable impact for our customers and business.

The Person We Are Looking For:

We’re looking for a senior-level designer who blends strong product intuition, systems thinking, deep empathy for users, and growth-minded experimentation. You thrive in complex problem spaces, move fluidly between big-picture strategy and pixel-level detail, and can clearly connect design decisions to customer needs and business outcomes. Above all, you are authentic, collaborative, and energized by solving meaningful problems with cross-functional teams.

Simplify Complex Experiences – Turn complicated workflows, rules, and marketplace dynamics into experiences that feel clear, intuitive, and approachable.

Drive Product Strategy – Partner with PMs to identify opportunities, shape solutions, and connect customer needs with measurable business outcomes.

Experiment & Iterate – Use data, customer feedback, prototypes, and experiments to test assumptions and continuously improve experiences.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally – Work closely with PMs, engineers, marketers, operations, and data partners to develop and deliver cohesive solutions.

•
Craft High-Quality UI – Build responsive, polished interfaces in Figma using thoughtful components, interaction patterns, and PadSplit’s design system.

•
Build AI-Infused Experiences – Prototype and design intelligent workflows and AI-powered features alongside our engineering, ML, and AI teams.

Here’s What You’ll Need to Be Successful:

•
Proven Experience – 4+ years designing digital products, ideally with complex acquisition funnels or marketplace environments.

•
Deep UX Skills – Strong research abilities and comfort engaging directly with users to uncover pain points and opportunities.

•
Business Fluency – Ability to connect design decisions to metrics, revenue, and real estate economics like rent, ROI, and occupancy.

•
Workflow Mastery – Experience designing multi-step processes, complex service environments, and edge-case-heavy workflows.

•
UI Excellence – Expertise in Figma and interaction design across web and mobile, with strong systems thinking and component reuse.

•
Data Orientation – Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation frameworks, and interpreting both qual and quant insights.

AI Capability – Demonstrated experience designing AI-powered features and leveraging modern AI tools in your design practice.

Authentic Collaboration – A humble, kind, curious, and mission-driven approach that elevates the team and the user experience.

• NO BOTS HERE: your resume will be reviewed by live humans from PeopleOps and the hiring manager.

• If warranted, the next steps would be a project review with the hiring manager (1) hour.

• If warranted, the next step would be a design case study with key Design stakeholders at PadSplit for one (1) hour.

• If warranted, the final step would be a design craft exercise with key stakeholders at PadSplit for one-and-a-half (1.5) hours.

title: Visual Design Lead, UX
description:
The UX team at Cricut is responsible for user research, interaction design and visual design of software applications across desktop and mobile platforms. We design intuitive, easy-to-use software that inspires our customers, and helps them design and make projects.

The team is uniquely positioned – it reports directly to the CEO – and we collaborate across the organization to ensure hardware, content, materials, and software all work together to deliver awesome experiences. Our UX team members come from varied backgrounds and experience; all of us were drawn to the mission of empowering every person to be creative.

If you are interested in helping others realize their creativity and enjoy working on consumer-facing hardware / software, Cricut may have the dream job for you!
We are looking for top-notch, seasoned UX visual design leaders who have vision, communicate it well and love deep problem solving.

This position is not about skinning software; it is about artfully applying visual communication to create compelling user experiences. You’ll be hands-on yourself, as well as direct the work of a small team of other UX visual designers. This is a once-in-a-lifetime job opportunity – the right person will have incredible impact on the look and feel of Cricut’s software across the board.

You’ll focus on the design of delightful software experiences that clearly communicate functionality and interactivity, while maintaining and extending Cricut’s brand. You’ll have the opportunity to participate in the entire user-centered UX design process – from concept through execution, incorporating customer feedback throughout the process. Your work will happen in a highly collaborative environment, where you partner with interaction designers, researchers, product managers, software developers, industrial designers, and colleagues from the Marketing and Creative teams.

Responsibilities:

• Create visual designs that support compelling user experiences on a variety of software platforms (including desktop and mobile) that integrate with our branded hardware.

• Deliver work that translates complex ideas into simple and useful designs.

• Collaborate with UX researchers, interaction designers, software developers and QA to deliver high quality visual designs that effectively communicate interactivity.

• Help drive development of a visual design system that will empower the UX team and development to move more quickly, with consistency.

• Participate in every stage of the user-centered design process – visualize possibilities early in the design process to facilitate communication, create graphics to support user-testable prototypes, and deliver pixel-perfect visual designs that are implementation-ready.

• Clearly articulate how and why your design directions address the challenge at hand and be ready to consider tradeoffs and alternatives to meet new requirements as they arise.

• Leverage, extend and maintain the integrity of the Cricut brand in collaboration with our Creative Team (who are responsible for packaging, marketing, etc.)

• Balance work on several design projects simultaneously, bringing system’s thinking and a clear understanding of relationships between different aspects of the software to ensure visual coherence.

• Execute to the quality of top consumer brands such as Apple and Google Nest, stay abreast of product design trends, and communicate them to the entire UX team to ensure our work and process are state-of-the-art.

• Strong conceptual thinker who has a passion for design problem solving.

• Keen attention to detail and a passion for simplifying complicated systems.

• Excellent written and spoken communication; ability to clearly defend design choices with clear rationale.

• Egoless, with a clear focus on collaboration over individual accolades.

• Strong organizational, multi-tasking, and time management skills and the ability to work independently.

• Interest in DIY / crafting experiences and a keen interest in gaining an understanding of and empathy for Cricut’s users.

• 10+ years of experience as a UI / Product designer working on consumer-facing software applications on more than one platform (e.g., Mac, Windows, iOS, Android).

• Proven ability to partner with UX designers, UX researchers, software developers and QA to ensure user needs are met and designs are implemented correctly.

• Exceptional portfolio, demonstrating software application visual design executed to a high level of impact and refinement.

• Experience working in an Agile environment.

• Proficiency with user interface design patterns and standard User Centered Design methods. Mastery of standard design tools such as Figma, Sketch or Adobe Creative Suite and a willingness to learn new tools.

• Excellent visual design skills, including a strong understanding of typography, color theory, composition, and branded experiences.

• A willingness to jump into design work at multiple stages of development and provide guidance to other designers, with a keen eye towards weaving it all together coherently.

• Previous experience overseeing, managing, and mentoring other designers.

• Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, information design, fine art, or relevant field. Graduate degree is a plus.

• Able to work Mountain Time hours.

A Quick Note Before You Apply…

Cricut is in a powerful chapter of transformation. We’re evolving fast—refining our strategy, growing our teams, and raising the bar across the board. This is an incredible opportunity for the right kind of person—but it’s not for everyone.

We’re looking for A-players—people who don’t just meet expectations, but consistently exceed them. If you thrive in dynamic environments and find joy in turning challenges into momentum, keep reading.

Here’s what makes someone a great fit for this role (and for this moment at Cricut):

You have a bias for urgency.
You don’t wait for perfect clarity to take action—you start, learn, and adjust. You believe that speed matters, especially when paired with thoughtfulness. You ask: “What can move forward today?” and push past inertia.

You set high standards—especially for yourself.
You’re proud of your work and protective of your reputation. You take ownership, deliver quality, and don’t cut corners. You hold yourself accountable without waiting to be asked.

You stay focused when things are moving fast.
You can identify what really matters and don’t get distracted by noise. You prioritize well, and manage your time wisely.

You collaborate like a pro.
You elevate the people around you, communicate clearly, and give thoughtful feedback. You’re low ego, high output—and your team loves working with you.

What to Do Next:

Please attach your resume including links to your portfolio where applicable. If you want to show your super powers in other ways – include that information too. You can be sure that Cricut® is an employer who values individuality, equality and diversity, so tell us what you’re all about. If you are a Maker or a DIY enthusiast, whether you think you are a good one or not, we would love to hear about it when you send us your information!

At Cricut®, we celebrate inclusion and diversity. Cricut is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions based on merit. Cricut prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual identity, gender identity, marital status, veteran status, nationality, citizenship, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, or any other unlawful consideration. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Cricut participates in E-Verify.

Cricut® makes smart cutting machines that work with an easy-to-use app, an ever-growing collection of materials, and crafting essentials to help you design and personalize almost anything — custom cards, unique apparel, everyday items, and so much more.

We believe everyone is born creative. We’re a diverse tapestry of thinkers, dreamers, givers, DIYers, handi-workers, artisans, and forever and always architects of things.

At Cricut, we place the power of handmade into the hands of all. We give you beautiful, easy-to-master tools so you can make something unique, remarkable, perfect. We surround you with ideas, community, inspiration, and encouragement to take your creativity further than you ever imagined. And as a community, we celebrate the exhilarating act of making every single day.

So, make that handcrafted card that feels like a hug. Design a shirt for fun, for family, or for a full-blown business. Craft with a passion or for a purpose. Make something big and bold, itsy-bitsy, amazingly ambitious, or just plain silly. Whatever you make, just make your heart out. Because here’s the remarkable truth: When we all make together, we make all things possible.

Let’s make.

description:
