title: Senior Manager, UX Design
description:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care through Counterpart Assistant, our technology platform for primary care. By supporting primary care physicians and their teams, we help identify patient needs earlier, make complex clinical information actionable, and support longitudinal management of chronic conditions.

As Senior Manager of UX Design for the Interventions Pillar, you will lead the team designing how clinical insight becomes action. Your portfolio will include decision support, treatment planning, intervention selection, treatment execution, care coordination, and longitudinal follow-through.

You will manage talented, experienced designers who already understand our product, systems, and clinical users deeply. Your role is to help them expand their strategic ownership, make stronger decisions through ambiguity, influence across the organization, and define the future of their domains.

AI will be an important part of this work. You will guide teams in applying AI where it can help clinicians synthesize information, evaluate options, plan care, and follow through—while preserving appropriate evidence, transparency, and clinical control.

Why this role?

The Interventions Pillar addresses a central challenge in healthcare: identifying an opportunity is not enough. Better outcomes require translating insight into an appropriate decision, treatment plan, action, and durable follow-through.

This role is an opportunity to:
● Shape how Counterpart supports consequential clinical decisions and treatment workflows.
● Develop senior designers into stronger strategic and organizational leaders.
● Define how AI can responsibly assist clinical reasoning and action.
● Connect clinical expertise, product strategy, design, and technology around measurable outcomes.

As a Senior Manager, UX Design, you will:

• Lead the clinical UX strategy. Establish a coherent direction across clinical decision support, treatment planning, intervention selection, execution, coordination, and longitudinal follow-through.

• Develop senior design talent. Coach experienced designers to lead through ambiguity, define strategy, make high-quality trade-offs, influence senior stakeholders, and increase their impact beyond their immediate product areas.

• Advance AI-enabled clinical workflows. Help teams determine where AI should synthesize information, generate options, recommend next steps, automate work, or remain out of the workflow. Establish expectations for evidence, uncertainty, human oversight, review, and correction.

• Create strong cross-functional decisions. Partner with Clinical, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Research leaders to connect clinical needs, model capabilities, user evidence, technical constraints, and business priorities.

• Raise the quality and effectiveness of execution. Strengthen critique, research synthesis, clinical review, prototyping, evaluation, and learning practices so teams can move efficiently without oversimplifying consequential problems.

Success in this role looks like:This leader will bring deep expertise in clinical-product design while creating strategic alignment and design leverage across the Interventions pods.

• In the first 90 days, establish leadership and strategic alignment by building strong partnerships with product directors, ensuring balanced workloads, and embedding design as a critical part of business strategy. Success will be measured by stakeholder feedback, stronger design integration, and improved operational effectiveness.

• In the first 6 months, focus on delivering impact by deepening user understanding, embedding research insights into design decisions, and pushing for best-in-class UX. Accelerate iteration cycles, reducing time-to-insight by 30%, while fostering a culture of experimentation and autonomy. Guide the team in complex problem-solving, balancing constraints, and proactively shaping solutions.

• Beyond six months, scale strategic impact and industry influence by positioning design as a key business driver, ensuring UX directly contributes to engagement, provider adoption, and overall user experience. You will push for consumer-grade, next-gen experiences that redefine digital healthcare while strengthening team expertise, fostering strategic thinking, and elevating design’s role in product direction. Success will be measured by design’s ability to drive best-in-class UX, shape industry standards, and create tangible product improvements that shift user expectations.

You should get in touch if:

• You have 7+ years of design experience in a design environment (in-house, agency, or relevant industry), with 5+ years of managing people.

• You have led complex, high-consequence workflows in healthcare or another expert professional domain.

• You bring strong judgment in interaction design, information design, research, and product strategy— and know how to coach others without taking over their work. You can demonstrate how you have helped experienced designers grow from strong executors into strategic decision-makers and organizational leaders.

• You have experience with AI-enabled products or can demonstrate sound judgment about recommendations, automation, evidence, uncertainty, and human oversight.

• You have experience in complex systems and applications, knowing how to simplify the complex and create delightful, intuitive experiences.

• You are an advocate for collaboration, working closely with product and engineering to ensure design is a driver of business outcomes, not just execution.

• You are excited about shaping the future of healthcare UX – bringing the same level of quality and innovation seen in leading consumer products to an industry that desperately needs it.

Benefits Overview:

• Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.

• Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.

• Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.

• Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities

• Reimbursement for office setup expenses

• Monthly cell phone & internet stipend

• Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams

• Paid parental leave for all new parents

• And much more!

About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

title: Lead UX Designer
description:
Overview

Consilio builds eDiscovery and legal technology solutions used by legal teams at major organizations. Our users make consequential decisions inside our products — often under deadline, always under scrutiny. The work is high-stakes by nature: decisions made inside our products carry legal weight.

We're looking for a Lead UX Designer to own design for critical areas of our product suite and to serve as a steward of our design system. Two things make this role unusual. First, you'll be working out how AI shows up inside these workflows. Second, you'll be setting the standards that hold the experience together across a multi-product portfolio, and governing how those standards get used.

This is an individual contributor role. You will set direction, and you'll have real influence over what gets built.

How this role operates

You'll partner with Product and Engineering early — shaping the problem, not styling a decision that's already been made. You'll prototype fast to explore and align, and work with Engineering to keep design and code in sync.

Our internal design team is small and growing. You'll have more ownership than you'd get at a mature design org, and less existing infrastructure to lean on.

Responsibilities

· Own end-to-end design for one or more product areas, from problem framing through delivery and post-launch iteration

· Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early, not just execute on requirements

· Translate in-flight product strategy into journeys, information architecture, and interaction patterns

· Define the interaction models for AI-assisted workflows: how users understand what the system did, why it did it, and how far to trust it

· Evolve and maintain Consilio's design system — defining components and patterns, and setting the standards for how they're used

· Build accessibility standards into the system rather than retrofitting it

· Prototype rapidly to explore, align, and de-risk decisions using modern AI tools

· Lead or partner on user research, and turn findings into decisions other people can act on

· Make the case for design decisions and system standards to senior stakeholders through evidence and clear storytelling

Qualifications

· 8+ years designing complex enterprise or B2B software, with shipped work you can walk us through

· Hands-on experience building and maintaining a design system in a multi-product environment — not just consuming one

· Experience designing end-to-end journeys for multi product ecosystems

· Experience with Figma Make, or other similar prompt-based prototyping tools.

· Depth in interaction design, with visual craft strong enough to make the work persuasive

· Demonstrated experience partnering with Product and Engineering from problem definition forward

· Bachelor’s degree in Design (e.g., Interaction, Visual, Industrial Design), HCI, or equivalent practical experience.

Qualities we're looking for

· Systems thinking. You design for scale and consistency by default, not as a cleanup pass.

· Standards judgment. You know when to generalize a pattern and when a one-off is the right answer — and you can say no to a component request without damaging the relationship.

· Comfort with ambiguity. You can make a defensible tradeoff without perfect information, and revisit it when better information arrives.

· Influence without authority. You change what gets built by being persuasive and well-reasoned, not by escalating.

· Clarity under complexity. You can take a genuinely complicated workflow and make it feel obvious.

Portfolio

· Strong portfolio demonstrating complex workflow design across multiple web-based enterprise products.

· Work samples that showcase prototyping ability.

Nice to have

· Experience with AI driven products or designing AI powered interactions

· Formal or self-directed learning in AI/ML concepts

· Prior experience designing for legal, compliance, healthcare, financial services, or another high-consequence regulated domain.

Consilio’s True North Values

•
Client Experience | Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.

•
Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.

•
Innovation | Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.

•
Grit | Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.

This is not a management-only role. We are looking for someone who is comfortable getting directly into the work — mapping flows, wireframing screens, building prototypes, iterating on UI, reviewing builds, and solving problems alongside Game Design, Art, Product, Engineering, and Production.

What You’ll Do

• Own the overall UX quality and UI/UX discipline across the game.

• Translate game and product concepts into clear user journeys, flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes.

• Stay ahead of production by resolving major interaction and usability questions before features move into Art and Engineering.

• Rapidly prototype and compare UX solutions before committing significant production time.

• Own information architecture, navigation, screen hierarchy, interaction patterns, usability, and player comprehension.

• Design intuitive experiences for gameplay, progression, onboarding, rewards, LiveOps, social features, and monetization.

• Proactively identify UX problems through design reviews, prototypes, and playable builds.

• Follow features through implementation and work with Engineering to preserve design intent.

• Improve the Game Design → UX → Art → Engineering workflow so features move through production with clearer intent and fewer late-stage redesigns.

• Establish reusable UX patterns, UI components, interaction standards, and documentation.

• Mentor and work in parallel with another UI/UX Designer while remaining directly involved in execution.

• Partner closely with the Art Director to define and evolve the visual language of the UI, translating the game’s overall art direction into a cohesive, scalable interface system.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

• Senior or Lead-level experience designing UI/UX for shipped games.

• Strong shipped experience with mobile Free-to-Play games, ideally casual or mass-market titles.

• A portfolio demonstrating both UX thinking and finished game experiences, not just polished UI screens.

• Strong ability to turn complex game systems into simple, intuitive player experiences.

• Excellent understanding of mobile interaction design, information architecture, hierarchy, readability, feedback, and usability.

• Experience designing F2P systems such as progression, rewards, FTUE, events, LiveOps, and monetization.

• Strong wireframing and interactive prototyping skills.

• Strong proficiency with Figma or equivalent modern product-design tools.

• Strong UI design fundamentals and the ability to take work beyond low-fidelity UX when needed.

• Strong product judgment and a proactive approach to identifying and solving experience problems.

• Experience mentoring or providing design direction to other UI/UX Designers.

• Experience collaborating closely with Game Designers, Artists, Engineers, Product Managers, and Producers throughout feature development.

• Familiarity with Unity-based game production is highly valuable.

• Comfort using AI-assisted or rapid-prototyping tools to explore and validate design solutions faster is a plus.

Portfolio

A strong portfolio is essential for this role.

We are particularly interested in examples that demonstrate:

• Shipped mobile and F2P game experiences

• User flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes

• Evolution from early UX concepts to final shipped UI

• Gameplay, onboarding, progression, rewards, LiveOps, or monetization UX

• Examples where you simplified a complex feature or solved a meaningful usability problem

• Your individual contribution versus the work of the broader team

Case studies showing how you arrived at a solution are especially valuable. We want to understand the problem, the alternatives you explored, the decisions you made, and how the experience evolved through implementation.

Benefits

Why Join UserWise

• Own the UX of a flagship mobile game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.

• Have significant influence over the product while it is still actively being shaped.

• Work in a lean team where UI/UX is central to the game experience rather than a downstream production function.

• Establish the UX processes, standards, and design systems that guide the project.

• Experiment with rapid prototyping and AI-assisted workflows to increase iteration speed and design quality.

• 100% remote, flexible work with a small, experienced team.

What We Offer

• Market-competitive compensation

• Paid Time Off

• Performance Bonus

• Annual Performance Reviews

about us

This role is fully remote. You can be located anywhere in Europe with a + in France.
Cycloid’s mission is to help organizations scale their platform engineering initiatives. Our platform optimizes the developer experience and operational efficiency by accelerating the delivery of internal developer portals and platforms. We reduce cognitive load for IT teams and advocate for FinOps and Green IT best practices. With Cycloid, platform teams don’t need to start from scratch to get a fully customized and sustainable solution.

Platform teams use Cycloid to design, build, and run platforms that enable end users to visualize, deploy, and manage projects, interact with DevOps and Cloud automation, and enforce best practices without needing deep expertise, all while keeping cloud costs and carbon footprint under control.

Cycloid is both an Internal Developer Platform and an Internal Developer Portal, with modules covering self-service workflows, platform orchestration, project lifecycle and resource management, FinOps and GreenOps, and an extensible plugin system. It can be consumed via the web console, CLI, or API.

We are an open organization. Your voice matters, and your point of view has a real impact on how we work and what we build. We are looking for someone opinionated, pragmatic, and comfortable shaping direction, not just executing.

Our long-term goal is to build the leading internal developer platform in the world, sustainably.

what is my challenge ?

Cycloid is currently defining the foundations, plans, and specifications for a full-scale rewrite of the platform, including a deep integration of AI into both development and design workflows. We are rethinking architecture, UX patterns, workflows, and the entire product experience.

You will own the design function end-to-end and become the primary driver of the product design vision for this new platform. This is a hands-on IC role: deep product thinking, complex systems UX, architecture-level design, and UI execution.

The design team is currently composed of one person (who will transition out), meaning you will step into a role with full ownership and autonomy, directly collaborating with product, engineering, DevOps experts, and the Founder.

This is a product-first role. You will work on complex workflows, platform and infrastructure UX, configuration models, permissions, environment lifecycle, and the connective tissue that helps highly technical and less technical users be successful.

We value designers who understand how things are built. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you must be comfortable discussing implementation constraints, reading code when useful, and collaborating efficiently with engineering teams.

what should i bring to the table?

Responsibilities

• Own and drive the product design vision for Cycloid, in alignment with product strategy and company goals.

• Lead the design of new features end-to-end: discovery, flows, architecture, prototypes, UI, and iterative refinement.

• Shape UX for complex, technical domains such as platform engineering workflows, infrastructure automation, permissions, configuration, and lifecycle management.

• Collaborate daily with product managers, frontend, backend, and DevOps experts to define requirements, challenge assumptions, and validate solutions.

• Establish a scalable design system for the next-generation version of Cycloid, ensuring coherence, quality, and long-term maintainability.

• Integrate AI-powered workflows and tools into design processes to accelerate discovery, prototyping, documentation, and iteration.

• Work closely with frontend teams to translate designs into high-quality Vue.js implementations; contribute small visual or interaction fixes when appropriate.

• Provide clear reporting to the Founder on product direction, priorities, and progress.

Requirements

• 10+ years of experience in product design, including senior or lead-level ownership of complex products.

• Proven experience driving design for technical products (developer tools, platforms, infrastructure, SaaS, DevOps, or cloud software strongly preferred).

• Demonstrated ability to own design in small or startup teams; able to bootstrap a design practice before scaling the design team progressively.

• Strong interaction design, UX architecture, and UI design skills, with a portfolio that shows systems thinking and clarity.

• Comfortable with frontend fundamentals (HTML, CSS, basic JS) and able to reason about implementation trade-offs.

• Experience influencing product strategy and collaborating closely with engineers.

• Ability to communicate design rationale, constraints, and decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Pragmatic, simplicity-oriented problem-solving mindset (KISS).

• Fluent in English.

• Startup mindset and comfort operating with autonomy.

Nice to have

• French speaker.

• Deep understanding of the IDP, DevOps, Cloud, CMP, or developer tooling ecosystem.

what we bring to the table

• Competitive salary and benefits.

• 100% remote work.

• High autonomy and full ownership of product design.

• A friendly, highly technical team.

• Real influence on the direction of a growing platform.

• Support for professional development and continuous learning.

• Strong commitment to sustainability and positive environmental impact.

• Home office setup budget up to €1200.

• Choose-your-own-device policy.

• One company retreat per year in the EU.

how we manage from now

• Application review (resume + portfolio).

• Interview with the current design lead to discuss your background, design approach, and fit.

• Design exercise to evaluate product thinking, systems design, and execution quality.

• Interviews with cross-functional leads (product, engineering, DevOps) and Founder to align on workflows and product vision.

• Reference check with your previous 3 N+1 managers and direct reports.

Cycloid is committed to equal opportunity and inclusive hiring. If the role resonates with you, we’d be happy to talk, even if you don’t tick every box.

title: Product Design Lead
description:
Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.

We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.

This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.

You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.

If you’re a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, we’d love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

• Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.

• Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.

• Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.

• Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.

• Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.

• Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.

• Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.

• Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.

• Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.

Requirements

What you'll bring:

• Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.

• Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.

• Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.

• The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.

• The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.

• Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.

• Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.

• Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.

• Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.

• Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.

• An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.

You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.

Benefits

All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:

• A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversary

• A “ReFuel Day” once a quarter to relax and refuel

• Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to life’s events

• A progressive parental leave policy

• Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern Cross

What's it like to be a Fuellie?

Fuel50’s team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand, and team members across five countries. We have a co-working space in the BHive in Takapuna that we use to meet occasionally for team and strategic planning and other team events. If you’re based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, we’ll pay for you to get here.

We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful. Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.

• We have a culture around continuous and respectful feedback and recognition - be part of a team working towards a common goal and helping each other every step of the way.

• We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.

• We'll have your back when you need help - your colleagues want to see you succeed and work hard to help you do so.

• We work hard and deliver amazing results to our clients - when you see our amazing feedback, you'll be proud to be a Fuellie.

Application process:

If this sounds like you, then please apply. If you’re not sure you're ready or perhaps you don't meet all requirements yet, please apply anyway. We'll review every application that we get.

Please include a link to your portfolio or attach it as part of your application.

This role is based in New Zealand, candidates must hold the relevant right to work in NZ i.e. Citizenship or a work visa at the time of application.

description:
Hi, I'm Willi, and I lead Product at Modash.

I'm looking for a Senior Product Designer/Product Manager to own the payments experience in our Payments/Creator team.

Background & reason for hiring

Modash helps brands scale creator partnerships on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Brands pay creators in lots of different ways: free products, one-time payments and affiliate commissions. Today those are separate flows rather than one coherent experience.

This role is about building one payment experience that handles all of them, on both sides:

•
Brand side - setting up the deal and paying for it

•
Creator side - getting paid

You own the entire workflow end to end. The role combines design and product management in one person: you decide what to build and why, and then you design how it works.

This is what you'll own:

The payments experience

Free products, one-time payments and affiliate commissions, for brands and creators alike, from setting up the deal to the creator getting paid. You work on prototypes and concepts for future iterations, design them, collect feedback and get the requirements ready for engineering.

Running development cycles

• Prepping user stories and explaining them to the engineers

• Doing the QA once the work is ready

• Giving and receiving feedback in retros

• Deciding when it's good enough to get into customers' hands - it's your product

The customer voice and the story

• Talking with customers about their pains and needs around paying creators, gifting products and running affiliate programs

• Keeping everyone in the company up to date on your roadmap, new releases and plans for the next sprints

• Working closely with product marketing so your product stands out and customers understand what's new

• Tracking your impact using customer feedback and north star metrics

Your first months in Modash will bring

• Onboarding with the product and Creator teams on how brands and creators use Modash today

• Customer calls with brands and creators, plus time in Fullstory and Amplitude to see where the payment flows break down

• Joining sprint planning with the engineering team and getting to know the backlog

Team structure

You'll report to me (Head of Product) and work closely with a dedicated engineering team lead Besnik. You'll also join a group of talented designer/PMs Renata, Maksym & Heidi who own other parts of our B2B SaaS product, and you'll work with them on product ideas, the shared design system and synced roadmaps.

Requirements

Required skills and experience

• Experience as both a product designer & product manager or in a hybrid PM/design role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company

• You've written great user stories and communicated your designs clearly to developers

• You've prioritized work with a bigger goal in mind and built a roadmap yourself. You can explain why some things came first and others didn't make the cut.

• You've worked with a design system to keep the experience coherent

• Extreme attention to detail. You notice the wrong spacing, the unclear label and the missing edge case, and you don't ship sloppy work.

• Get-it-done attitude. We all run into roadblocks every day. We're looking for someone who finds solutions, motivates themselves and keeps getting things done.

• You're used to, and actually enjoy, a fast pace and constant change in a growing company

• You aspire to be great. We're not shooting for mediocrity here.

• Interest in the creator economy. Our mission is to help creators get paid. You don't need to live and breathe the creator world, but we'd like your values to align with ours.

• You're fluent in English. Our team is spread across many countries, and we work together in English every day.

Nice to haves:

• UX work on affiliate, marketplace or payments products

• Strong instincts in research or analytics (you don't need to be an expert in both)

• Experience with our tools: Figma, Linear, Notion, Amplitude and Fullstory

If you meet most but not all of these, don't let that stop you from applying. We're not looking for a finished product, and we'd be happy to grow with you.

Benefits

What we're offering

•
Fully remote working in Europe 🏠 As long as you have a reliable internet connection, work wherever is best for you. At home, in a café, on a beach. Whatever works.

•
Compensation. Your compensation is made up of salary and stock options. As we're growing fast, the stock option package is especially significant. Annual salary range is 65,000€ - 85,000€ for this role. We hire across Europe, so the exact number depends on your location, employment type, skills, and experience.

•
Flexible working hours ⏱ We trust you to do your job without anyone looking over your shoulder. Do your best work whenever it suits you.

•
Unlimited paid vacation 🌴 If you're happy and well rested, you'll do better work. Take the time you need to enjoy a balanced life.

•
Personal development 🧠 When you grow, we benefit. If there's a course, book or conference that will help you upskill, we'll cover it.

•
Ownership 💡 You're the expert at what you do, so you should have the freedom to make decisions and act quickly. No unnecessary red tape. Got an out-of-the-box idea? You'll have the autonomy to try things you might not be able to at other companies.

•
Regular team offsites ✈️ We’re remote-first, but we make time to connect, collaborate, and have fun together in person.

description:
About the Job

The Opportunity

As a UI/UX Designer at Emetlab, you will craft the experiences that make complex AI data infrastructure feel effortless, intuitive, and unmistakably premium. Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company delivering expert-produced, rigorously validated datasets and end-to-end AI solutions to frontier laboratories, Fortune 500 enterprises, ambitious startups, and sovereign AI programmes across the globe.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end design process, from research and ideation through to high-fidelity interfaces and interaction design. You will shape how clients discover, configure, and receive datasets, how domain experts navigate contributor workflows, and how internal teams monitor quality assurance pipelines, ensuring every touchpoint feels polished, purposeful, and built for precision.

This is a rare opportunity to define the design language of a platform that operates at the intersection of AI and data infrastructure, where your work will set the standard for how world-class organisations experience the data partner behind their most advanced models.

What You'll Do

Own the end-to-end design process from user research, wireframing, and prototyping through to final high-fidelity UI and interaction design. Design intuitive, elegant interfaces for complex workflows including dataset configuration, contributor task management, quality review dashboards, and client delivery portals. Conduct user research, usability testing, and accessibility audits to ensure every design decision is grounded in real user needs across both client and contributor experiences. Develop and maintain Emetlab's design system, establishing visual patterns, component libraries, and interaction guidelines that scale with the product. Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Operations teams to ensure designs are technically feasible, well-implemented, and delivered with fidelity. Create information architecture and data visualisation design that makes complex quality metrics, pipeline statuses, and dataset analytics immediately comprehensible. Champion clarity and usability at every level of the design process, ensuring the platform is efficient and delightful for users ranging from AI researchers to domain experts across 120+ countries.

What You'll Need to Succeed

2+ years of professional UI/UX design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft across web and mobile applications. Strong command of design tools such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe Creative Suite, with experience building and maintaining design systems. Experience designing for data-rich environments, dashboards, or enterprise platforms where clarity and information hierarchy are critical. A refined eye for typography, colour, spacing, and visual hierarchy, with an instinct for creating premium, polished experiences. Experience thriving in fast-paced environments where you own the full design lifecycle and collaborate directly with engineers. A collaborative disposition, comfortable working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Data Operations teams to bring ideas to life. Genuine interest in AI, data systems, or building tools that empower expert communities is highly valued.

Role Details

Employment Type: Full-Time and Part-Time positions available Location: Fully Remote Stage: Growth stage, operational

About Emetlab

Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company built on a single conviction: the quality ceiling of any AI system is determined by its training data, not its architecture or compute. We produce expert-crafted, rigorously validated training datasets across 12 specialised domains, delivered by a global network of over 5,000 vetted domain specialists spanning 100+ languages and 50+ specialisations. Beyond datasets, we offer end-to-end AI solutions including Fine-Tuning, RLHF & Alignment, Red Teaming, Model Evaluation, Data Annotation, Synthetic Data Generation, and Pre-Training Data Pipelines.

Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months

Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure

About The Role:

You will establish the systems, templates, and technical foundations that allow our teams to publish high-quality content quickly and consistently—without relying on engineering for routine website work. You will help evolve our website into a scalable growth platform that supports YipitData’s businesses, strengthens our brand, and creates clear, intuitive experiences for our audiences.

As the company’s in-house website design and development expert, you will partner closely with Design, Brand and Communications, Demand Generation, Corporate and Investor Marketing, Product, and business stakeholders across YipitData. You will also help us build internal website expertise and reduce our long-term reliance on external agencies.

Working hours: This is a fully remote role with a standard working schedule of approximately 9 am – 5 pm. Because you will collaborate with teams and stakeholders across both East and West Coast time zones, you will need the flexibility to occasionally accommodate meetings in a variety of time zones.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

As Our Lead Web Designer & Developer You Will:

• Own the end-to-end design and development of YipitData’s public-facing websites, from early concepts and user flows through launch and ongoing iteration.

• Manage website projects and priorities across multiple stakeholders, communicating tradeoffs and moving work forward in a fast-paced environment.

• Develop self-service templates, guidance, and governance that enable non-technical teams to publish and update content safely.

• Collaborate with external agencies and specialized partners when needed while steadily increasing YipitData’s in-house capabilities.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

• You have 5+ years of professional experience designing and building high-quality marketing or corporate websites, with a portfolio demonstrating both strong UX/visual design and hands-on implementation.

• You are highly proficient in Webflow, including CMS architecture, reusable components, responsive layouts, interactions, and custom code when needed.

• You have strong front-end fundamentals, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and can independently troubleshoot technical and implementation issues.

• You have deep experience with responsive design, information architecture, design systems, accessibility standards, browser compatibility, and website performance.

• You are comfortable owning work from initial request through discovery, design, stakeholder alignment, development, QA, launch, and iteration.

• You combine a high visual bar with pragmatic execution—you know when to refine a solution and when to ship, learn, and improve.

• You are an effective cross-functional partner who can translate among design, marketing, technical, and business stakeholders.

• You use qualitative feedback and quantitative signals to improve user experience, content discoverability, conversion, and overall site performance.

Nice-to-have experiences include:

• Technical SEO, AEO, structured data, content discoverability, or large-scale CMS publishing.

• Conversion-rate optimization, experimentation, analytics, and lead-generation workflows.

• Working with multiple brands, audiences, or business lines within one organization.

• Collaborating with (and eventually reducing reliance on) external design and development agencies.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Aetonix is a digital health company building a chronic care management platform for U.S. health systems, clinics, and ACOs. Our product has two faces:

• A mobile app that helps Medicare patients (65+) complete simple, guided check ins, and

• A desktop app that helps care teams know which patients need them most — and act.

We are backed by Trudell Medical International (TMI), a Canadian-headquartered medical device company. We operate with patient capital and startup urgency.

The next 6 months are about proving product-market fit with real clinical evidence in a category where fewer than 4% of eligible U.S. patients are currently receiving the care they are entitled to.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

You'll join our design team – working alongside our Product Designer and Lead Product Designer – as a senior contributor across the patient mobile app and care-team desktop app, owning specific product surfaces end-to-end and raising the craft bar within your area.

You’ll report directly to the VP of Product, and partner closely with the Lead Product Designer on shared design system standards, growing our research practice, and raising the bar on the team’s design craft.

HATS YOU WEAR

Craft Contributor Your work sets the example within your surface area, and raises the bar for the team around you.

• Deliver high-quality, well-reasoned design from problem framing through shipped product.

• Give structured critique that builds design taste and judgment in others.

• Contribute to our evolving design system across web and mobile surfaces.

Researcher You run and synthesize lean research, and share those learnings with peers.

• Lead qualitative and quantitative research with care teams and Medicare patients.

• Recognize when data or research is missing and go get it — designing the study, recruiting, and synthesizing findings.

• Translate complex clinical workflows into clear, intuitive software interactions.

Discovery Partner You bring a user-grounded point of view to the product decisions that shape your surface.

• Participate in product decisions as a full voice, grounded in user insight.

• Push back when a problem needs more framing before solutions are explored.

• Frame recommendations in the language of outcomes and impact.

Communicator You tell a crisp story that connects the design to the people it serves.

• Confidently present design work to cross functional peers, innovation partners, and executives when needed.

• Use story maps, journey maps, and similar tools so product, design, and engineering align on risks and priorities.

• Bring patient and clinician voices into trade off discussions so core perspectives shape final decisions.

MUST HAVE

• 5–7+ years of experience in product design, with a portfolio showing end-to-end ownership from research through shipped product.

• Strong research skills: able to run a usability study, synthesize findings quickly, and share what you learn with others.

• Hands on with AI/ML powered product design. You have experimented with AI or ML features, and can explain what “good” looks like.

• Experience contributing to and working within a shared design system (web + mobile), in partnership with other designers and engineers.

• Solid accessibility practice baked into your work (keyboard and screen-reader flows, clear focus states, robust interaction patterns).

• Familiarity with product analytics tools (e.g., Amplitude) to uncover usage patterns and inform design decisions.

• Active use of AI design and research tooling (e.g., Claude, Figma Make or equivalents) to accelerate prototyping, synthesis, and research; teaches others to do the same.

• Ability to craft compelling design stories that win buy-in from engineers and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Comfort giving and receiving structured feedback, with genuine interest in helping other designers grow, even without a formal mentorship mandate.

NICE TO HAVE

• Background in healthcare, clinical, or regulated software. You understand what HIPAA and clinical workflows mean for design decisions.

• Behavioral science experience; designing for habit formation, engagement, or behavior change.

• Familiarity with CCM, RPM, or chronic disease management platforms.

• AI/ML product design experience in a healthcare or clinical context: conversational interfaces, clinical decision support, or data-heavy dashboards.

• WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility expertise in a regulated health context.

WHO YOU ARE

• A builder. Most energized when you are crafting something new, not polishing something established.

• Mission-driven. You care about patients and want your design work to have measurable impact on how chronic disease is managed.

• Humble enough to listen deeply to a care coordinator, confident enough to challenge a product decision, and persuasive enough to translate both for executive stakeholders.

WORKING CONDITIONS

• Fully remote: open to candidates in Canada or the United States. EST/CST overlap preferred for core collaboration hours.

• Occasional in-person team meetings in Ottawa, London (Ontario) and Toronto, Canada areas (travel required on a quarterly basis at minimum).

• Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, RSP matching, and professional development opportunities.

WHAT WE OFFER:

• An agile, dynamic and motivated team working together in a fast-growing company that is changing the future of virtual care

• The ability to make a real difference in people’s lives

• Health insurance including medical, dental, vision and life

title: Product Designer (US - Part-time, Contract)
description:
Spate is a trend intelligence platform for consumer brands in beauty, wellness, and food and beverage. We analyze anonymous, aggregated public consumer data to spot emerging trends early and explain why they're growing, so brands can make product and marketing decisions with confidence.

Our founders, Yarden Horwitz and Olivier Zimmer, started Google's Trendspotting division and called trends like turmeric, cold brew, and face masks before they went mainstream. Spate is Y Combinator-backed, and more than 200 brands use it, including Sephora, L'Oréal Paris, Estée Lauder Companies, Unilever, P&G, and e.l.f. Our data regularly appears in The New York Times, WWD, British Vogue, and The Business of Fashion.

About the role

We're looking for a part-time contract product designer to shape Spate's core product: the dashboard where brand teams explore trends, build reports, and work with our AI assistant.

Our platform will change a lot over the next year or two as we rebuild around LLM-powered features. We already ship an AI Assistant, AI Reports (an LLM powered dashboard builder), and in-dashboard summaries and analysis. We need someone who can work out what those experiences should be, not just how they should look.

Our users are brand innovation teams, product marketers, social media teams, and agencies. Most aren't data analysts, so much of the job is turning dense trend data into something clear and actionable.

You'll join the Frontend & UX team, four people including you, and work closely with our frontend lead. The role is fully remote and part-time, about 20 hours a week. You’ll need to be based in US Central Time (UTC−6) or US Eastern Time (UTC-5). We require you to be available for core collaboration hours of 9:00 AM–12:00 PM Eastern.

This is a remote, Part-time contractor position.

What you'll own

The product, not just the screens. At Spate, product design and UI/UX design happen together. Features aren't fully defined and then handed to a designer. You'll help decide what we build and why, and stay involved from the first conversation to launch. You'll work with our frontend lead to choose the right deliverable for each problem: a written proposal, a user flow, a prototype, or a full Figma spec.

Finding problems worth solving. Find user pain points on your own, through customer calls, feedback, and usage data. Then take them from problem to proposal: frame the problem, explore options, and make the case for a direction. Leadership sets the overall direction and can help point you at problems, but you won't need our input to get started.

How our AI features work. Decide when something should be a chat, a report, or an inline summary. Define how we show where an insight came from, and how we handle loading, uncertainty, and wrong answers. Help shape the voice and structure of AI-generated insights, because in an LLM product the words are part of the UX.

The design system. We have a Figma library and a React component library that are only loosely in sync. You'll own the system's principles and the Figma side, and partner with our frontend engineers to make the two a single source of truth. The goal is that everyday design decisions are answered by the system, so engineers can ship UI that feels like Spate without waiting on design.

AI quality, over time. As the role settles in, you'll help define what a good AI answer looks like for our users, and contribute to how we review user feedback and evaluate our LLM features.

Requirements

What we're looking for

We care more about mindset than years of experience. You're driven, you care about making a good product, and you have a growth mindset. You value autonomy and self-direction.

• 2+ years of product design experience, with work shipped in a real product.

• Strong product opinions. You think about what to build and why, not just how it looks, and you're comfortable defending and revising your ideas.

• A portfolio that shows how you framed problems, not just how you solved them. At least one case study should start from a fuzzy problem with no spec.

• Experience with, or a strong interest in, data-heavy products such as dashboards, analytics, or reporting tools.

• You've worked within or contributed to a design system, and understand how components and patterns scale.

• Real curiosity about AI products, ideally with some hands-on exploration.

• Strong written communication. We're remote and you're part-time, so your proposals and decisions need to stand on their own.

• Experience working as a freelancer or contractor, managing your own time and deliverables.

• Fluent in Figma, with AI tools in your everyday workflow.

Nice to have

• Experience as the first or only designer on a team.

• You've built or substantially evolved a design system that engineers adopted.

• Experience designing AI features, or reviewing the quality of LLM output.

• Depth in data visualization.

• Familiarity with consumer goods, beauty, food, or marketing and insights tools.

• Comfort building quick functional prototypes with AI tools to test ideas against real outputs.

Your first 90 days

• At 20 hours a week, we'll keep the first three months focused.

• First 30 days: Learn the product and the people who use it. Watch a few customer calls, review feedback and usage data, and ship your first improvements to the user experience.

• By day 60: Design your first feature solving a major user pain point or goal.

• By day 90: Work with the rest of the team to ship your feature into production.

How we work

Contributors at Spate work flexibly, with few meetings, a lot of impact, and real say over the direction of their work. Leadership sets product direction and priorities, and you shape how we get there. That means bringing proposals rather than waiting for briefs.

Our aesthetic is cool, smart, data-driven, and approachable. We want a designer who can hold that line while the product changes quickly.

This role does not include:

• Writing production code. Figma is your main tool, and our frontend engineers build.

• Brand and marketing design, such as the website, sales decks, or client reports.

• Other product surfaces like our API and MCP server.

Compensation

• Hourly rate: $75/hour.

• About 20 hours a week, as an independent contractor.

Recruitment Process

• Video interview (30 min). About you, in your own words.

• Assessment (10 min). A quiz designed to assess your problem solving abilities and approach to work.

• Intro call with our frontend lead (~20 min). Your background, how you like to work, and whether the role fits.

• Case study (60 min). Work through a solution to a real-world problem and record your process.

• Case study review (45 min). Walk us through your case study, focusing on how you framed the problem and arrived at your solution.

• Conversation with our CEO (45 min). Product vision, how we work, and your questions.

description:
Lead UX/UI Designer

Heptic Arena — Full-Time — Remote (Europe)

About Prism Studio

Prism Studio is a Malta-based game development studio making bold, player-first games. We're a small, cross-disciplinary team working remotely across Europe, with a culture built on ownership, trust and self-management. Our first title, Heptic Arena, is a third-person PvPvE arena shooter set in an intergalactic game show. We're now building it with our community through closed playtests on the road to Early Access.

About the Role

We're looking for a Lead UX/UI Designer to own the user interface and player experience of Heptic Arena across PC and console. You'll report to the Creative Director and set the UI vision, standards and direction for the game. You'll also stay hands-on: designing screens, building assets and working in engine day to day.

This is a player/coach role. There's no line management, but you'll mentor junior designers and freelancers, review their work and raise the quality bar across the team. You'll be the go-to person for UI and UX decisions, working closely with art, design, engineering and production.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, Manage, Define and maintain Heptic Arena's Players UX,UI visual language and design system (components, typography, iconography, colour, motion,accessibility guidelines.

Lead UI/UX across the full player journey: front end, HUD, menus, progression, store, social features and onboarding.

Propose, Concept, Design, prototype and deliver: wireframes, user flows, screen maps, mockups and final UI assets, from early concept through to polish.

Work closely with Game Design and Engineering on implementation in Unreal Engine, and resolve UX trade-offs and technical constraints early.

Use playtest feedback, analytics and A/B testing to find UX problems and iterate on solutions.

Mentor junior designers and freelancers through design reviews, feedback and clear briefs.

Estimate, plan and prioritise UX/UI work with Production, Execute and control development, create and distribute UX/UI tasks in Jira.

Own UX/UI documentation in Confluence and keep it the single source of truth for the team.

Set up review and QA processes so that the implemented UI meets our quality, consistency and accessibility standards.

Represent UI/UX in leadership and cross-discipline discussions, and advocate for the player's experience.

About You

• 5+ years of experience in game UI/UX design, including at least one shipped PC or console title.

• A strong portfolio of PC/console game UI work (not mobile), showing both systems-level thinking and polished visual execution.

• Deep knowledge of UI design principles, information hierarchy and usability, especially for real-time, action-heavy games.

• Hands-on experience implementing UI in Unreal Engine (UMG/Common UI preferred)

• Expert use of design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Miro, Axure, Adobe XD or similar.

• Experience building and maintaining a UI design system or style guide.

• Proven ability to guide and mentor other designers and give clear, constructive feedback.

• Strong communication and documentation skills, and confidence presenting and defending design decisions to stakeholders.

• Comfortable with Jira,, Confluence and Google Workspace

• Self-driven and organized, able to thrive in a remote, self-managing team.

• Based in or near the Central European time zone (CET ± 2 hours).

Nice to have

• Experience with UI animation and motion design, such as After Effects, Rive or in-engine animation.

• Experience with multiplayer, live-service or competitive shooter UI, including HUDs, scoreboards, matchmaking, stores and battle passes.

• Knowledge of console platform UI guidelines.

• Familiarity with accessibility standards for games.

• Experience running or analysing usability tests.

Life at Prism Studio

We work as one unit with one common goal. Our purpose is to build a cross-disciplined team where everyone is self-managing, wherever they are in the world. We collaborate in an open, friendly way, as a global team built on talent and communication.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
About ECP

ECP is a market-leading SaaS solution that enables senior living communities to better care for their residents. ECP is used in over 8,000 communities. We're looking to further expand by increasing the number of customers that use our software and increasing the scope of how we serve our customers by developing and releasing new products.

Senior living is deeply under-penetrated with software and ECP is one of the largest and fastest-growing software companies in the industry. We recently raised a growth round of equity to reinvest in our product, technology, and go-to-market. Our mission is to build world-class software that improves the quality of life for seniors and improves clinical, business, compliance, and operational performance for our customers.

Role Overview

ECP is hiring a Lead Product Designer to lead our product experience and be a true thought partner to product and engineering leadership. Reporting to our VP of Product, you'll shape the experience across our full suite (clinical, CRM and billing), modernizing what customers use today and defining what we build next. Our goal is the best-looking, easiest-to-use software in senior living, with AI that takes work off the plates of community staff and operators.

This is a hands-on IC role. You'll start as our sole designer, with the opportunity to grow into leading design as the team expands. We want someone who will obsess over our product, our industry, our customers and their pain points.

Who You'll Design For

Our users run senior living communities: caregivers, nurses, med techs, sales and leasing teams, business office staff and executive directors. They work long, busy shifts, often on shared devices, and staff turnover means many are new to the job. Every extra click or confusing screen costs them time they'd rather spend with residents.

That's why ease of use is non-negotiable: workflows should take as few steps as possible and be learnable without training.

Responsibilities

• Design vision. Set and own the design vision across the product suite, establish process and quality standards, and be the voice of the user in roadmap conversations. Mentor designers as the team grows.

• Business impact. Tie design work to business outcomes such as adoption, customer satisfaction and sales win rates. Define how success is measured and use the results to guide what you design next.

• Craft and simplicity. Own the visual direction that makes us the best-looking software in our market. Remove steps, reduce clicks and push back on complexity users don't need. Design experiences that work seamlessly across desktop, tablet and mobile.

• AI feature design. Lead AI-powered features from concept through launch. Define how users interact with AI and how they review, trust and correct its outputs. Look for places where AI can remove work entirely, not just assist with it.

• Design system. Build and evolve a design system, starting where it has the most impact, and drive adoption with engineering so our products look and behave consistently. Set it up in Claude so PMs can build on-brand prototypes themselves.

• Customer research. Join customer calls, visit communities, shadow staff on shift and run usability tests. Keep personas current and track competitor and AI trends.

• Execution and collaboration. Deliver wireframes, mockups and working prototypes built in code with AI tools, provide development-ready specs, and resolve tradeoffs directly with PMs and engineering. Present and defend decisions with evidence.

• Accessibility. Set accessibility standards aligned to WCAG and champion them with engineering.

Requirements

• 7+ years of product or UX design experience, including leading design for a product area end to end, mentoring other designers and presenting confidently to leadership, and tying design decisions to measurable business outcomes.

• A portfolio showing exceptional visual and interaction craft, including examples of simplifying complex workflows and designing responsive experiences across desktop, tablet and mobile.

• Experience shipping AI-powered features that real users rely on, with a solid grasp of AI UX patterns (setting expectations, showing sources, handling errors, keeping humans in control).

• Experience building or significantly evolving a design system and driving adoption, including setting it up in Claude so PMs can build with it.

• Expert in Figma and fluent in using Claude to iterate quickly, including building working prototypes in code that give engineering something functional, not just a mockup.

• Hands-on user research and usability testing.

• Working knowledge of WCAG accessibility standards, with experience tracking and fixing violations.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience designing healthcare, senior living or other regulated-industry software, especially AI features where accuracy and trust matter.

• Experience supporting multiple product lines, including scaling a design system across them.

• Experience as an early or sole designer, or building a design team.

• Bachelor's degree in design, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

title: Product Designer
description:
About Sendmarc

We are a cyber security company that is on a mission to make the internet a safer place. We do this by delivering tooling and services related to an international standard, DMARC. Our technology enables organisations to protect their staff, customers, suppliers, and the whole world from email spoofing and impersonation attacks on their domains.

We’re a fully remote company with the majority of our builders working out of South Africa and sales teams in the Netherlands, the US, Latin America, Australia and the UK.

Why This Role Exists

The mission of this role is to create beautiful and user-friendly interfaces across Sendmarc’s digital products.

Sendmarc ships new capability fast, across a growing set of products and surfaces. This role exists to make sure every feature we ship is clear, consistent, and genuinely easy to use.

You’ll work alongside Sendmarc’s existing product design function, building out the design system that keeps our interfaces consistent as the product surface area grows, and working closely with Product and Engineering to take ideas from concept to shipped feature.

Outcomes

The core outcomes this role is accountable for:

End-to-End Product Design

Design and deliver product experiences that are intuitive, cohesive, and user-centric, communicating design thinking through wireframes, prototypes, sketches, user flows, mockups, and high-fidelity visual designs, and distilling complex problems into systematic, scalable solutions that get refined iteratively.

Usability & Research

Investigate usability pain points and apply UX heuristics to improve clarity and ease of use, and conduct research that informs design decisions, shapes product direction, and surfaces new opportunities.

Design System Ownership

Define, evolve, and maintain Sendmarc’s Design System, keeping the experience consistent and unified across the product ecosystem, and develop the usage guidelines, reusable components, content standards, and usability documentation that let product teams move faster.

Cross-Functional Delivery

Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and stakeholders to plan, design, and implement new features, analysing business rules and technical constraints to keep solutions feasible, presenting design work and adjusting it based on feedback, and supporting engineers through delivery with assets, clarifications, and updates.

Competencies

PRODUCT DESIGN

• Experience designing end-to-end product experiences, from wireframes and user flows through high-fidelity UI

• Comfortable distilling complex problems into systematic, scalable design solutions, and refining them iteratively

• Strong grounding in UX heuristics and usability principles, with a track record of removing friction and confusion from an interface

DESIGN SYSTEMS

• Experience defining, evolving, and maintaining a design system: components, usage guidelines, content standards

• Understands how a documented, reusable design system speeds up delivery for the wider product team

COLLABORATION & DELIVERY

• Comfortable working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and stakeholders to plan and ship new features

• Able to translate business rules and technical constraints into feasible, effective design solutions

• Confident presenting design work, gathering feedback, and iterating in response

• Comfortable supporting engineers through delivery with assets, clarifications, and design updates

TOOLS & EXPERIENCE

• Tertiary qualification in Design, Interaction Design, HCI, or a related discipline

• 5+ years hands-on experience designing digital interfaces, preferably for SaaS or B2B products

• Strong proficiency in Figma and prototyping tools

• A portfolio demonstrating practical UX and UI design work

Who We're Looking For

You’re a practical, detail-oriented designer who gets real satisfaction from solving an interface problem cleanly and shipping something people find genuinely easy to use. You communicate design thinking clearly, through wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups, and you’re comfortable working closely with Product and Engineering from early concept through to a shipped feature.

SaaS or B2B product experience is a plus, not a requirement: what matters more is a portfolio that shows sharp thinking and polished execution.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
ParentSquare is a rapidly growing Santa Barbara-based company that’s changing the way schools and parents communicate every day. Sound simple? We strive to keep it that way! Our mission is to give schools the power to incredibly enhance family engagement for all students. ParentSquare and RemindHub, our flagship products, serve over 22 million students and drive our mission by providing unified communications tools -forms, sign ups, payments, RSVPs, direct messaging, language translations, chat and more. Remind Chat, our free product, reaches over 80% of K-12 students, providing a safe and easy-to-use platform for direct communication between teachers and families. And our latest innovation, SmartSites, offers state-of-the-art websites for school districts, enhancing their online presence and accessibility.

We are not just creating a product; we are creating empowered educators and engaged parents to improve the lives of all students. We are passionate advocates for our customers and for our employees and we invite you to join us on this exciting journey.

Who we’re looking for:

ParentSquare is seeking a Senior Product Designer to own the end-to-end experience for a major area of our platform, used by families and educators in districts across the country. You'll take problems from discovery through shipped product, partnering with Product and Engineering as an equal voice in what gets built. You'll work closely with our new UX Research and Design Systems practices, use AI tools to explore and prototype faster, and help raise the craft bar by mentoring other designers. This is a new role on a cross-functional product team.

Most importantly, you’re someone who shares in our passion for improving the lives of students through communication.

Reports to: Vice President, Product Design

This role will include:

• Owning end-to-end design for a product area, from problem framing and discovery through shipped experience

• Defining the problem before exploring solutions, and pushing back when a request is a solution looking for a problem

• Turning complex workflows like district-wide messaging, forms, payments, and permissions into experiences that feel simple, even for users who scan, skip, and make mistakes

• Partnering with UX Research, Customer Success, and Support to understand real usage, run usability tests, and make decisions from what you learn

• Designing accessible, translation-ready experiences for families across languages (including right-to-left), abilities, devices, and comfort with technology

• Building on and contributing to the design system, delivering production-ready work that covers states, edge cases, and responsive and native behavior

• Using AI tools to prototype faster, and designing AI-powered features that users can understand, review, control, and correct

• Presenting and defending design decisions in Design Crit and with stakeholders, then partnering with engineers through implementation and review

• Mentoring other designers and helping raise the craft bar across the team

Our ideal candidate will have the following:

• 5+ years of product design experience, with shipped work on complex web and native mobile (iOS and Android) products

• A portfolio with 2 to 3 in-depth case studies showing how you framed the problem, made decisions, and measured results

• Strong interaction design, information architecture, and visual design craft, with fluency in Figma, prototyping, and design systems

• Experience running usability tests and using research and analytics to inform design

• Hands-on experience using AI tools in your design workflow, such as Claude, Cursor, or Figma Make

• Working knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.2 AA) and how to design for them

• Clear communication and the ability to influence PMs, engineers, and leadership

Bonus points for:

• Experience in EdTech, K–12, or products where the buyer and the end user are different people

• Experience designing for multilingual or low-literacy users

• Experience designing AI-powered features, including how users review, control, and correct AI output

• Experience prototyping in code (React or HTML and CSS) with AI coding tools like Cursor or Claude Code

The perks of working for us are great!

You’ll get your foot in the door as our company continues to grow. We’re big believers in work-life balance and provide:

• Employer-paid health insurance (including dependent coverage)

• An employer-matched 401K retirement savings program from day 1

• Paid Parental Leave

• Stock options

• Health + wellness reimbursements

• PTO that increases each year

• 15 paid holidays, including your birthday!

As a fully remote team, we’ll make sure you have all the tools and equipment you need to make your home office a place where you can thrive.

We're an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. We are committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace in compliance with applicable state laws.

The salary range for this role will be $120,000 - $150,000, DOE.
