title: Senior Product Designer I
description:
Are you excited by the challenge of shaping the future of healthcare? Do you enjoy solving complex problems where innovation, usability and clinical safety are equally important? Are you curious about how AI is transforming the way we design and build products?

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer who combines excellent design craft with strong product thinking, technical curiosity and a collaborative mindset.

You'll help shape intuitive, trustworthy clinical experiences, working closely with clinicians, Product, Engineering and Clinical Safety specialists. We're looking for someone who understands the responsibility of designing for healthcare but isn't afraid to challenge established approaches, experiment and explore new possibilities.

About Semble

At Semble, we're on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. Our cloud-based clinical system helps thousands of healthcare professionals deliver better care through powerful, intuitive and secure software.

We're a passionate team united by three cultural drivers:

Impact – We do work that matters.

Collaboration – We are in it together.

Human touch – We care deeply.

We're also embracing AI, both in how we work and in the products we build. We're looking for people who share our curiosity about emerging technologies and are excited to explore their potential responsibly.

This role can be fully remote in the UK or France.

What you will be doing

As a Senior Product Designer within our Clinical team, you'll design experiences that support healthcare professionals in making decisions, documenting care and managing complex clinical workflows.

You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and Clinical Safety specialists, balancing innovation with the responsibility of creating safe, reliable healthcare technology.

You'll also help evolve how our design team works, using AI and emerging technologies to explore ideas, learn faster and deliver better outcomes.

Responsibilities

• Own complex clinical design challenges – Lead design work from discovery through delivery, translating user needs, clinical requirements and technical constraints into intuitive, accessible solutions.

• Balance innovation with clinical safety – Work alongside Clinical Safety specialists to identify risks, challenge assumptions and design appropriate safeguards, without introducing unnecessary complexity.

• Deliver value iteratively – Break down complex problems into manageable, valuable increments, balancing speed of delivery with user needs, clinical safety and long-term product quality.

• Embrace AI and emerging technologies – Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate research, exploration, prototyping and iteration, and identify opportunities for AI and automation to improve clinical workflows.

• Prototype and experiment – Move confidently between Figma, functional prototypes and AI-assisted development tools to bring ideas to life, test assumptions and validate solutions early.

• Facilitate collaborative problem-solving – Bring Product, Engineering and Clinical Safety together to explore opportunities, navigate different perspectives and reach well-informed decisions.

• Conduct user research – Build relationships with healthcare professionals through interviews, field visits and usability testing, translating insights into meaningful product improvements.

What we are looking for

At this level, we expect you to work with a high degree of autonomy, independently owning complex design challenges and influence decisions beyond your immediate workstream.

We're looking for someone who combines strong design fundamentals with sound judgement, curiosity and a constructive approach to collaboration.

Key skills and experience

• Complex, high-risk product experience – Proven experience designing clinical systems or similarly high-risk software, where errors can have significant consequences. Experience working alongside safety, risk or regulatory specialists.

• Excellent design craft – Strong UX, interaction and visual design skills, with a portfolio demonstrating complex workflows, accessible interfaces and shipped product experiences.

• Innovation and safety judgement – Ability to explore ambitious solutions while understanding risk, recognising trade-offs and knowing when a simpler, more predictable approach is appropriate.

• Practical AI experience – A proven track record of using AI-assisted tools to improve your design workflow, with examples of how you've applied them to research, exploration, prototyping or delivery.

• Research and product thinking – Experience conducting user research, navigating ambiguity and using evidence to make informed design decisions that deliver measurable outcomes.

• Collaborative facilitation – Ability to bring people together, constructively challenge assumptions, welcome different perspectives and help teams move towards shared decisions.

• Ownership and adaptability – Comfortable leading work independently, taking responsibility for outcomes, embracing feedback and continuously evolving your approach.

Nice to have

• Experience designing EHRs, EMRs, clinical decision-support systems or AI-powered healthcare products.

• Experience designing AI-powered workflows, automation or intelligent decision-support experiences.

• First-hand experience working in a clinical or healthcare setting.

What you'll get in return

• The great feeling coming with knowing you do something that matters: shaping the future of healthcare!

• £65-75k (based on your experience and the value you can bring)

• Autonomy and ownership – we’ll set the vision and share the context, then we trust you to run with things – that’s the reason we hire you!

• 3 extra paid holidays (birthday and ‘feel good’ days) - that we will expect you to actually take so you can recharge and rest.

• Private Health Insurance – covering physical and mental health, as well as dental and optical!

• Hybrid and flexible work environment – work from anywhere in France, with also some flexibility to work across Europe. You decide how much or how little you go to the office.

• Get the tech you need - You will get the latest MacBook (unless you prefer Windows) and take your pick across a wide range of equipment to set up your home office ergonomically.

• Work alongside an inspiring team – our two founders have started Semble after a successful startup exit, and your future colleagues are all knowledgeable and innovators in their field.

Diversity and inclusion

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including groups traditionally underrepresented in technology. We encourage applications from disabled and neurodivergent candidates and are happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

title: Product Designer (AI-Native, B2B)
description:
About Simulmedia

Since 2008, Simulmedia has helped brands and agencies turn TV into a measurable growth channel. Our AI-powered media platform for planning, activating, and measuring campaigns works across linear, local, and connected TV.

Everyone here owns problems end-to-end, and our design team is small, so your decisions ship and matter.

About the role

Think about it as a mix of a product manager's mindset with a strong design vertical skills. Design here is AI-first and builder-led. We expect you to take a problem, define ways to solve it, identify the best ways to shape the output, and involve stakeholders throughout the solution's development. Your output might be a Figma design mockup, a prototype, shipped production code, a PRD, or a decision document.

What you'll do

•
Own problems end to end. Define the problem with your PM and engineers, decide what should exist at all, explore options, validate them, and ship improvements that move key metrics. Stay with the work after handoff.

•
Work across the business. Client-facing products, internal tools, sales enablement, or customer experience, depending on priorities.

•
Start in writing. Use AI to clarify hypotheses, surface risks and edge cases, write short PRDs or decision documents. Sometimes the document is the final outcome: not every problem needs a UI solution.

•
Use research to go faster. Talk to sales managers, customer success managers, and internal users, run quick tests, and adjust direction based on what you learn. Use research to speed up decisions, not block them.

•
Prototype with AI. Build and iterate on flows in Claude Code, Cursor, or similar. AI writes the code, and you own structure, behavior, and UX quality.

•
UI Design. When it makes sense, turn validated concepts into production-ready designs with every state covered and aligned with our design system.

•
Ship with engineers. You'll occasionally ship small UI fixes to production; engineers own production code, and your share can grow over time.

What we expect from you

• 3+ years as a product designer on complex B2B products with dense, data-heavy interfaces: tables, filters, reporting, multi-role flows.

• A portfolio that shows product thinking, interaction design, and craft

• At least several products you've built or prototyped in code with AI tools.

• You proactively build domain and technical knowledge and get up to speed quickly on new problems.

• Comfort in Claude Code, or similar: you can work in an existing codebase and get a prototype running without waiting for an engineer.

• Good UI skills: your mockups are neat, balanced, and focused on user value.

• Based anywhere in Ukraine

• English at B2+ (upper-intermediate) or higher.

Nice to have

• Ad tech, media, or analytics/reporting product experience.

• A public GitHub or shipped side projects.

• Experience in data visualization

• Interest in growing your product management and engineering skills alongside design.

How we hire

Apply with a link to your portfolio. The process has three steps:

•
Technical interview. Walk us through your portfolio and how you work: your research, how you prototype, and the decisions behind one project you built.

•
Test task. We'd like to understand how you operate within an new domain and are ready to defend your own work

•
Product manager interview. Product thinking and collaboration: how you define problems and success, prioritize, and work with a PM day to day.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Cavallo is looking for a Product Designer to create intuitive, high-impact experiences for distributors navigating complex operational challenges. You will partner closely with product managers, engineers, customers, and fellow designers to turn ambiguity into clear, useful, and scalable product experiences.

This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong product thinking with exceptional craft. You are curious about how emerging technologies can improve both the products we build and the way design work gets done. You will help shape intelligent, trustworthy experiences that make complex workflows feel simple, fast, and actionable.

What You’ll Do

• Lead design work across the full product development lifecycle, from early discovery and concept exploration through detailed interaction design and implementation.

• Partner closely with product managers and engineers to define problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and shape solutions together.

• Engage directly with customers and customer-facing teams to uncover pain points, validate concepts, and identify opportunities.

• Use qualitative research, product data, and business insights to inform decisions and measure the impact of design improvements.

• Leverage AI tools to streamline research, generate and test ideas, and move from concept to validated design more quickly.

• Explore opportunities to introduce AI-powered capabilities that are useful, explainable, and grounded in real customer needs.

• Contribute to and evolve Cavallo’s design system, interaction patterns, and product standards for greater consistency and scalability.

• Collaborate with engineering throughout implementation to preserve the intent, quality, and usability of the final experience.

• Help raise the quality bar for product thinking, visual design, usability, and accessibility across the organization.

• Make complex B2B workflows feel clear, efficient, and intuitive without oversimplifying the work our customers need to accomplish.

What You Bring

• 5 years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or a related discipline, preferably within B2B, SaaS, enterprise software, or data-rich products.

• A strong portfolio that demonstrates your process, product thinking, interaction design, visual craft, and ability to solve complex problems.

• Experience designing end-to-end product experiences, from research and problem definition through prototyping, validation, and polished UI.

• Strong systems thinking and the ability to understand how individual features fit within a broader product ecosystem.

• A high level of proficiency in Figma and modern prototyping workflows.

• Experience using AI tools to improve the speed or quality of your design process, paired with the judgment to evaluate their outputs critically.

• Curiosity about AI-native product experiences and how intelligent systems can support, rather than complicate, customer decision-making.

• The ability to create prototypes at the appropriate level of fidelity, from rapid concept models to realistic, interactive experiences.

• A strong foundation in human-computer interaction, with the ability to apply behavioral principles, usability heuristics, and user-centered design methods to complex product experiences.

• Comfort navigating ambiguity, asking strong questions, and bringing structure to loosely defined problems.

Nice to Have

• Degree in Human-Computer Interaction, UX Design, Interaction Design, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience designing enterprise, analytics, financial, operational, or workflow-heavy software.

• Familiarity with distribution, order management, ERP, inventory, supply chain, or related business systems.

• Experience designing AI-powered features, conversational interfaces, decision-support tools, or human-in-the-loop workflows.

• Experience with data visualization and translating complex information into clear, actionable insights.

• A foundational understanding of front-end technologies and how design decisions affect implementation.

• Experience with motion design, interaction animation, or advanced prototyping.

• Familiarity with product analytics, experimentation, or measuring the impact of design changes.

Why Join Cavallo?

• Help solve meaningful operational challenges for distributors and the people who keep their businesses running.

• Work on complex product problems where thoughtful design can create visible, measurable customer value.

• Join a product-first team where designers are involved in shaping problems, not simply producing interfaces.

• Collaborate with colleagues who value curiosity, constructive feedback, and shared ownership.

• Help define how Cavallo thoughtfully incorporates AI into its products and product-development practices.

• Contribute to the evolution of a growing SaaS platform, design system, and product organization.

• Work with leaders who believe great design is essential to creating trustworthy, useful, and differentiated products.

• Grow your skills while having meaningful influence over the direction and quality of the customer experience.

About Cavallo

Cavallo is at the forefront of developing cutting-edge profit technologies for product-centric brands and wholesale distributors. . We’re seeking the self-motivated, the hard-working, the problem solvers, and the dedicated to join our team of experts. We're focused on helping businesses grow, expand, or reshape how they do things by approaching each and every problem with energy, creativity, and confidence. Ingenuity, adaptation, and evolution are at the core for us at Cavallo.

Our Grand Rapids-based headquarters is focused on helping change the way organizations do business through our software products, customizations, expertise, and support. Our enterprise software solutions work with leading business applications, including multiple leading ERP platforms, and integrate with a wide range of apps and other technologies. Cavallo has been in the business of helping manufacturing and distribution companies increase productivity and efficiency since 2003. Associate Director, Product Design

At Parallel, we partner with companies who care about building great products, and we help them ship work that improves lives and moves markets. As an Associate Director, you'll shape the quality of everything we make and grow the people who make it. You'll lead with vision, balancing hands-on execution with mentorship so teams deliver outstanding, high-impact design. You'll work closely with our clients, driving real business and user value while setting a clear standard for design excellence.

You do your best work in ambiguity, you bring strategic thinking to messy problems, and you raise the bar through deep expertise in product design, brand, and storytelling. As a leader, you'll champion high-quality, user-centred design and keep Parallel at the front of digital craft.

What You'll Do

Lead by doing

•
Balance leadership with hands-on design, working alongside teams to create and ship exceptional work.

•
Bring deep expertise in product design, design systems, product strategy, and human-centred design to guide and sharpen the work.

•
Actively raise the bar, giving clear, specific, actionable feedback to project teams.

Client engagement and delivery

•
Be the trusted design advisor to clients: guide them through the process, present the work, manage feedback, and build strong relationships grounded in Parallel's point of view.

•
Drive project success by applying service design and change-management thinking.

•
Partner with the business team to scope work well and spot the right opportunities to grow an account.

Advocacy and leadership at Parallel

•
Build a collaborative, inclusive, high-performance design culture.

•
Partner with Parallel's leadership to keep the team engaged and the culture strong.

•
Hire, mentor, and develop designers, building a real pipeline of leaders on the team.

•
Represent Parallel in the design community, attracting great talent and new work.

What We're Looking For

Technical expertise

•
Product / UX design: You set the quality bar, push teams toward better thinking, and drive best practice across research, strategy, and execution.

•
Visual design: You champion excellent visual craft and stay current on trends, tools, and emerging tech.

•
Product strategy: You keep design aligned with the product roadmap, release plans, and market positioning.

•
Critique and collaboration: You build a culture of constructive critique, inside the team and with clients.

•
Research: You use qualitative and quantitative signals to inform and validate design decisions.

•
Content design: You advocate for clear, compelling communication that fits the brand and the experience.

Leadership and influence

•
Selling design: You build narratives that help clients understand and buy into the decisions.

•
Vision: You lead teams to shape experience concepts that balance business goals, user needs, and genuine innovation.

•
Creative direction: You hold the strategic and creative quality of every project, through execution and client presentation.

•
Systems design: You define scalable design systems built for usability, adoption, and the long haul.

•
Brand strategy: You confidently lead brand and strategy sessions, guiding clients toward strong creative directions.

Requirements

•
10+ years in product or UX design, with proven time managing and mentoring design teams through complex work at a high bar.

•
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to align and influence a room of different stakeholders.

•
Experience working cross-functionally to drive business priorities and deliver real value.

•
A portfolio of shipped products that shows both craft and strategic thinking.

•
Everyday fluency with modern design tools and AI in your practice.

•
Working knowledge of change management and service design.

•
Active engagement in the design community through writing, talks, or panels.

•
A commitment to inclusive design and a collaborative team environment.

How We Hire

The bar is high and the role is senior, so we take the process seriously and move quickly. Expect a couple of conversations with the team, then a small, paid real-world project so we can see how you actually think and work. The role is remote. Compensation matches the seniority we're hiring for.

title: Lead Product Designer, Banking
description:
About Step

Step's mission is to improve the financial future of the next generation. Millions of people use our banking and borrowing products to manage, build, and grow their money. Now that we're part of Beast Industries – the company behind MrBeast – we're poised for a new phase of growth to deliver financial literacy and tools at massive scale.

About the Role

Step is looking for an experienced product designer who can lead the overall product, design, and UX strategy for our core banking platform. We are a design-focused consumer banking product that works on physical products, digital products, and mobile apps. We're looking for someone to roll up their sleeves, lead design on individual features and make design decisions in a role with plenty of room to grow. The ideal candidate is a passionate designer who is proactive in product ownership, comfortable working closely with cross-functional teams to influence product strategy and rally them around elegant, innovative mobile solutions that delight our customers.

In this role, you will:

• Design high quality interactive experiences across mobile, both iOS and Android, and web

• Lead projects throughout the entire design process; from creative conception to production and release

• Collaborate with Product, Engineering and Marketing to help define strategy, and the roadmap to achieve business objectives (growth)

• Collaborate and give feedback/direction to other designers to continually push the level of quality on the team

• Evaluate current processes, identify best practices, develop plans to reach goals and implement improvements

• Utilize and contribute to the Step Design System

You might thrive in this role if you have:

• Significant demonstrated experience with end-to-end (hybrid UX and UI) product design for consumer-facing products

• The ideal candidate has significant experience leading design for consumer fintech products

• Thinks in systems, designing solutions that scale across products, adapt to future needs, and create consistency beyond individual features

• Strong visual design sensibility with the range to move fluidly between systemized UI and more expressive, brand-forward moments

• A craft-obsessed designer who strives for quality and has an amazing attention to detail

• The ability to lead design for important projects with experience delegating work and giving direction to other designers

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills (you should be able to clearly articulate your design decisions and the logic behind them)

• The ability to think at a high level about product strategy and vision (not just 'how it should look' but 'what we should build')

• Experience in building and shipping applications or software (mobile/web)

• Uses AI as a creative and productivity multiplier — able to move faster and explore more ideas without sacrificing craft or judgment

• Must have a portfolio featuring examples of design work

Even better if you have:

• Experience building and maintaining scalable design systems

• Ability to translate designs into production-quality code

Logistics

Location: Remote (US) or San Mateo, CA, with occasional travel for team offsites and key meetings

Reports to: Head of Design

Education: Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single qualification. Strong candidates rarely check every box, and we'd rather meet you than miss you.

How we're different

We stand for the side hustlers, the creators, the freelancers, and the investors — people who are not afraid to take on challenges, especially when it comes to their finances. Step is focused on disrupting the banking industry by delivering a differentiated, mobile-first consumer experience, and we operate like the customers we serve: customer obsessed, acting as owners, moving with urgency, and breaking the norm.

Step is a wholly owned subsidiary of Beast Industries, the media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson (MrBeast), the most-watched person in the world. Beast Industries spans digital media, consumer products, philanthropy, and new ventures, with an audience reach no consumer company has ever had — and Step is tasked with turning that reach into financial literacy and tools for the next generation at massive scale. With Beast's distribution and brand behind it, Step is positioned to scale significantly over the next 12 months, and joining now means helping shape that trajectory from the inside.

Come work with us!

Step is a remote-first company building banking for the next generation. We offer competitive compensation and stock options, generous medical, dental, vision, and company-paid life insurance, a 401k plan with Safe Harbor company matching, a flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays, 12 weeks paid parental leave with flexible return to work, and a company-provided technology package. If you're looking to join a fast-growing company with a strong mission and vision that puts people first, we want to meet you!

Step is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Step is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need an accommodation, please let us know at and we'll work with you to provide appropriate support.

Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money. For too long, financial systems have worked for the institutions that built them, not the people using them. Runaway interest, fine print and limited access have left many behind, feeling shut out of a system that wasn't setting them up for success.

We're building a different kind of system, in a complete money app to send, spend and save. One that's clear, flexible and puts people and businesses in control. Founded in 2019, we serve customers and businesses across Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Millions of customers and 65,000 global brands, government services and small businesses rely on us today.

What began as a better way to pay at checkout has grown into a financial system working the way it should have all along.

About the roleWe're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our BNPL stream and design the merchant side of Tabby's core product. You'll work on the Merchant Dashboard, across web and the mobile app, the place where merchants run their business with Tabby: manage transactions, settlements and invoices, set up in-store and integrations, and use self-service tools.

You'll join a newly formed Merchant Experience team with a lot of attention on it and a lot to build: upgrading core dashboard pages, launching new self-service products, running merchant experiments, and rethinking how Tabby works in physical stores.

We're looking for someone who thrives on complexity, turns uncertainty into clarity, owns problems end to end, and brings strong product thinking alongside strong craft.

• A lot to build: core page upgrades, new self-service products, experiments and a rethought in-store experience

• Real ownership in a newly formed team: shape how the product and the team work from the start

• An AI-forward team where design can iterate fast and get close to code

• A dedicated UX writer and UX researcher to work with

What you will be doing

• Own merchant journeys in the Merchant Dashboard end to end, across web and mobile, from early concept through polished execution

• Upgrade core dashboard pages such as transactions, settlements and invoices, and design new self-service tools for merchants

• Design clear, data-dense interfaces that make complex financial and operational information easy to understand and act on

• Design and iterate on merchant experiments and new features with your Product Manager, and measure what works

• Help reimagine the in-store experience together with product and engineering

• Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers and our UX researcher and UX writer to identify and solve key merchant problems

• Use data, merchant feedback and research insights to inform design decisions and validate hypotheses

• Partner with designers from other B2B and B2C streams to keep the experience consistent across Tabby, and contribute to the design system

• Use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow: prototyping, ideation, and moving solutions closer to code

• Present and advocate for your work to cross-functional and senior stakeholders, ensuring clarity and alignment

What you will need

• Proven experience designing digital products, ideally B2B, fintech, or complex data-rich tools

• Strong craft skills demonstrated through a portfolio, with excellent Figma skills

• Comfort designing across both web/dashboard and native mobile (iOS and Android)

• Strong product thinking: you understand business goals, product logic and user needs, and can explain the reasoning behind your decisions

• Ability to turn uncertainty into clarity and handle complex flows, states and edge cases

• A strong level of AI proficiency: you use AI tools on real project work to prototype, explore and move faster

• Understanding of technical constraints and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering

• Confident in your work and strong communication skills, whether you're talking to another designer or a C-level executive

• Experience applying systems thinking and contributing to shared design systems

• Autonomy: you operate without close supervision and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Fluency in English

Nice to have

• Experience in fintech or financial products

• Experience conducting UX research

• A strong base in graphic design

• Experience designing for GCC markets or Arabic/RTL interfaces

We help businesses navigate their most important technology decisions with confidence, and take responsibility for seeing them through. Founded by ex-Googlers and startup veterans, we’re proud to partner with teams behind some of the most ambitious products, including Open AI, Anthropic, Stripe, Walmart and Google.

Our work spans strategy, design, and engineering — often in complex, AI-driven environments — where clarity, speed and quality are the standard. We use AI intentionally, applying it only where it adds real value and expands what’s possible. Care shapes everything we do.

Inside Fluxon, you’ll find a global, remote-first team of experienced builders, who are curious, kind and serious about their craft. We’re building a place where people can take ownership, solve problems that matter and do work they’re proud to stand behind. If you want to do your best work alongside people who care as much as you do, you’ll feel at home here.

Note: This position is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in Romania.

About the Role

As a Senior Product Designer at Fluxon, you'll lead design end-to-end on ambitious projects, often working directly with founders and product leads to shape what gets built. We are looking for design generalists, someone who owns the design surface, thrives in ambiguity, and cares as much about why something gets built as how it ships.

While specific responsibilities may differ from project to project, you will:

• Partner with founders, product leads, and other stakeholders to turn business goals into experiences customers love

• Lead design end-to-end, from discovery and research through interaction design and production-ready execution, calling the right level of depth for each project

• Make the right call when user needs, technical constraints, and business goals pull in different directions

• Collaborate closely with clients, PMs, and engineers to set the direction and ship high quality work

• Bring a point of view on craft, process, and where the field is going, while staying current with new technologies and design trends

Qualifications

• Experience leading product design end-to-end, from strategy through to production ready execution, delivering work that customers love and drives business results

• Strong judgment and ability on process, knowing when to go deep on research and when to move fast

• Strong UX foundations across the full discovery and design process, from research through interaction design, user testing and accessibility

• Strong visual craft across layout, typography, iconography, color, and motion, with the ability to take work to a polished, production ready bar

• Excellent communication and presentation skills across written, visual, and spoken formats, with experience presenting directly to clients

• Comfortable collaborating closely with clients, PMs, and engineers, including managing expectations, navigating disagreement, and keeping the work aligned

• Experience shipping with startups or founding teams, comfortable building from zero without established design foundations or process

• Experience working with US clients (European clients a plus)

A note on applications - A portfolio is a required part of your application. We treat it as a critical element of the review process, and it must be included in your submission.

What we offer

• Remote-first, flexible work with a budget to set up a work space that works for you

• Localized healthcare coverage to support you and your family’s wellbeing

• Flexible paid time off with a minimum of 3 weeks per year (plus holidays)

• "No internal meetings" on Fridays, so you can focus on deep, uninterrupted work

• A professional growth budget for learning that matters to you – whether it’s developing your technical skills or learning a new language

• A monthly wellness allowance to support your physical and mental health

• Annual company offsites, where we gather in person to build meaningful connections

• A competitive salary that reflects your expertise, impact and experience

• Profit-sharing, so you can benefit directly from the value we build together

• A paid sabbatical program, designed for rest, renewal and fresh perspective

We believe diverse teams perform better, and an inclusive environment is essential to building a successful organisation. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing accommodations throughout the hiring process.

This role may use AI-assisted tools to support initial screening. All assessments and decisions are made by a human reviewer.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Lead Product Designer

Givelify is a fintech-for-good company where brilliant minds come to power the most loved and trusted online and mobile giving app platform. Thanks to over 2 million generous donors, we’ve helped more than 80,000 nonprofits and places of worship raise over $7.5 billion. Together, they’re changing their world with kindness and generosity.

Inc. 5000, the Stevies® Awards, Gartner, Forbes, and many more have recognized our story, innovations, and achievements. Our award-winning team builds products and experiences that put more good into the world. We love to take on big challenges because we know our work matters.

Make an impact at one of the fastest-growing private companies in the U.S. Be part of a talented team of big-hearted individuals, earning competitive pay with excellent benefits.

About your role:

We’re seeking a Lead Product Designer to elevate the quality, strategy, and impact of product design across Givelify’s mobile and web experiences. You’ll drive design excellence, guide cross-functional alignment, and shape end-to-end product vision—from discovery through delivery. In this role, you’ll combine hands-on design leadership with systems-level thinking to create simple, inspiring, and scalable product experiences for our giving community.

The Creative Team:

Givelify’s Creative Team produces the experiences that wow our audiences and users. We consistently deliver world-class design and creativity across the entire business, serving our customers in collaboration with product, technology, marketing, support, and operations. This role reports to the Director of Product Design.

The Lead Product Designer will get to:

•
Drive Product Design Initiatives
Lead design initiatives, imagine novel solutions, and guide cross-functional teams toward cohesive product outcomes. You move fluidly across the entire design process—from problem framing to high-fidelity prototypes—and elevate complexity into elegant simplicity. You know great design is invisible because it works effortlessly for our giving community.

•
Own End-to-End Design Execution
Ensure successful delivery of product experiences by driving all phases of design work. From discovery and solution ideation to refined interfaces and engineering handoff, you set the standard for quality, clarity, and completeness.

•
Optimize Design Operations & Efficiency
Maximize throughput and design velocity by shaping and owning design operations for your scope of work. You establish structure, anticipate needs, remove friction, and scale effective design practices across teams.

•
Quality Elevation & Feedback Culture
Continuously raise the bar for design excellence by soliciting, synthesizing, and acting on feedback from stakeholders. You model a culture of “feedback is fuel” and know how to extract value from different points-of-view to arrive at quality—strengthening both the work and the team behind it.

To be successful in this role, you’ll also:

•
Apply Human-Centered Design for Major Initiatives
Shape end-to-end product experiences by driving cross-functional conversations, orchestrating user flows, and guiding teams from concept through launch with a deeply human-centered approach.

•
Lead Cross-Functional Alignment
Collaborate strategically with Product, Engineering, and senior cross-functional leaders to influence priorities, illuminate trade-offs, and ensure every touchpoint reflects Givelify’s mission and strategic objectives.

•
Drive Insight-Informed Decision Making
Embed a deep understanding of Givelify’s audiences and business strategy into design decisions, representing the customer perspective at all times to guide product direction and elevate design quality.

•
Advance the Design System & Standards
Drive growth and adoption of the Givelify Design System—ensuring scalable, consistent, and brand-aligned experiences across platforms while coaching teams on best practices. 

•
KPIs:

• # of creative cycle days

• # of replies per cycle

Your experience:

• Bachelor’s degree  

• Experience working on a native mobile apps team

• 5+ years of B2C native mobile app experience

•
Expert level proficiency of Figma, Adobe CC suite and/or other industry standard creative tools

• A portfolio highlighting some of your best work (please include password)

•
Prototyping: Lofi and Hifi prototypes, you know when to use one over the other and embrace an iterative process. 

•
Languages: English; Spanish a plus 

•
Communication: You can articulate what makes a good vs great design, as well as articulate your design point of view. 

• Problem solver who requires very little guidance on projects; thrives in a fast-paced environment. 

• Expert-level applied understanding of formal elements of design, including typography, layout, balance, and proportion. 

•
(Bonus) Research: You are familiar with front-end research (light ethnography) and/or able to facilitate user testing sessions to validate your designs with users. 

• (Bonus): Remote: Experience working with remote teams. 

Your superpowers:

•
Problem-Solving: Is resourceful and creative in solving complex issues. Uses sound judgment, data, and collaboration. Connects design decisions to brand and business outcomes.

•
Integrity: Demonstrates congruence in thought, speech, and action. Can be trusted to act with courage and to do the right thing. 

•
Collaboration: Fosters productive relationships; values others' opinions, shows appreciation, and seeks to understand different perspectives. 

•
Customer Focus: Adopts a human-centric approach that meets or anticipates customers' needs when developing solutions. 

•
Drive for Results: Can be relied upon to be resourceful & tenacious in achieving key desired results. 

•
Effective Communication: Inspires and aligns through clear, thoughtful dialogue.

•
Mentorship: Invests in the growth and success of fellow designers.

Our culture:

We are a virtual team of award-winning and high-performing professionals who innovate and collaborate to fulfill our mission to instantly connect people to causes that matter most to them so they can change their world with kindness and generosity. Our four keys to success - integrity, heart, simplicity, and wow - fuel our passion to be recognized among the tech industry’s most inclusive and purpose-driven workplaces.

We are steadfast in our conviction to overcome challenges while performing meaningful work alongside some of the most brilliant minds and biggest hearts. It propels our growth as individuals and as a team. We are committed to respecting each other in our workplace, firmly believing diversity is our strength.

At the heart of everything we do are our giving community, our donors and our partner organizations. We lean on research and human-centered design to consistently push the envelope and innovate our products and customer experiences.

We take great pride in providing competitive pay, full benefits to help care for you today and in the future, amazing perks (including flexible PTO), and, most importantly, the opportunity to put passion and purpose front and center.

About Givelify

Givelify is the most loved and trusted online and mobile giving platform. Along with its powerful donation management system, it’s the fastest-growing technology for advancing generosity in the world. We instantly connect people to their heart’s impulse to do good with award-winning products and experiences. A global community of over 2 million generous people supports their favorite churches, places of worship, nonprofits, and causes with over $7.5 billion in donations across more than 80,000 organizations. Givelify leads all giving apps on the App Store and Google Play Store with more than 135,000 verified, authentic reviews with an average 4.9 out of 5-star rating. Learn more at Givelify.com.

title: Lead Web Designer
description:
Remote · Anywhere in India

About Parallel

Parallel is a product and web design studio. Our clients are usually software companies in the US and Europe, and craft & taste are the reason they hire us. Quality is our competitive advantage. Most of the industry is optimising for speed right now, and we think craft holds its value longer. We sweat the details and we make it seem effortless.

Your role

The website is the piece of a company's design that everyone sees. It carries the brand, it does the selling, and it is usually the first real thing a customer touches. We are looking for a designer with impeccable taste and a deep command of the web to lead that work at Parallel. You will design our most important sites yourself and set the standard for every website the studio ships. It is a hands-on, high-ownership role.

What you'll do

•
Lead the web design on our biggest client projects, from the first concept to launch.

•
Work out how a brand behaves on the web, through type, colour, grid, and motion.

•
Design the sites we make for clients: homepage, product pages, pricing, landing pages.

•
Art direct photography, illustration, and 3D when a page needs it.

•
Present the work and the reasoning to clients, and iterate on the feedback.

•
Review the web work of other designers on the team and help them make it better.

•
Work with our developers so the site that ships matches the site you designed.

•
Work alongside our product designers so the site and the product feel cohesive.

•
Shape how Parallel designs for the web as the practice grows.

What you would bring

•
6+ years designing websites, at a studio, an agency, or in-house at a software company.

•
You have led web projects, with other designers working alongside you or reporting to you.

•
Exceptional craft and a sharp eye for typography. This is what separates good web work from decoration.

•
A strong grasp of brand systems. You can work inside one, and extend it when the website needs more than the guidelines cover.

•
Motion and interaction skill: scroll behaviour, transitions, the small movements that make a page feel alive. After Effects, Lottie, Rive, or Framer's own motion tools.

•
Fluency in Figma, and enough command of Framer or Webflow to know what is possible once a site gets built.

•
You are comfortable presenting to founders, and you can hold your ground on a decision that matters.

•
You use AI consciously in your process, and you know where it helps and where it gets in the way.

Good to have

•
Brand identity work of your own, beyond applying someone else's.

•
Enough front-end knowledge to talk to a developer precisely.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Join the Rest Revolution

The world is wired and tired. It's plagued by screens, notifications, and the sense that you should always be doing ... something. But hey, you're reading this job application right now, so you probably know exactly what we're talking about.

So here's a bit of good news amidst all the noise: Hatch is a sleep wellness company that's betting on rest in a culture obsessed with optimization. While most technology is designed to keep you engaged, our devices use the science of habit formation to help people unplug, unwind, and recharge. Through genuinely enjoyable routines, habit building, and gentle guidance (no sleep scores or wearables here), we help people build healthier sleep habits and feel the difference in everyday life.

More than a decade ago, we started with a mission to help parents navigate the complexities of newborn sleep. Today, we're helping more than 5 million people (and counting) take care of themselves and the people they love through the power of rest.

We’re open to candidates across the U.S. and Canada. However, please note that Hatch is based in California, so we just ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Product Designer with a passion for sleep health and a strong UX mindset: someone who looks beyond the screen to define what we should build and why. You will be working on the evolution of Hatch Sleep Clock, our flagship adult product.

Join our growing team as we dream up new experiences that leverage our unique ecosystem of hardware, software, and content, working to define the sleep space as an essential part of overall health and wellness. As a Senior Product Designer at Hatch, you'll be an individual contributor on the adult products team, leading UX for new and evolving features that help adults fall asleep, stay asleep, and wake up rested.

You'll shape features from the earliest stage: framing problems, synthesizing research, mapping end-to-end journeys across app and device, and turning insights into new member journeys and experiences. You'll pair that strategy with hands-on design, partner closely with product and engineering to scope and ship features, and help build the product design practice at Hatch. You'll collaborate with our stellar design, product, and engineering teams and play a big role in shaping the creative culture at our company.

What You’ll Do

Within 1 month:

• Build a solid understanding of our adult device ecosystem, the science of adult sleep, and our customers by digging into existing research, feedback, and usage data.

• Form strong collaborative relationships across the design team, PMs, and engineering teams.

• Identify the biggest UX opportunities and gaps in the adult product experience and share a point of view with the team.

Within 3 months:

• Lead UX for one or more features from problem framing through launch, working closely with PM and engineering partners.

• Design and ship your first responsive sleep experience; working closely with PM and Engineering partners and taking advantage of Hatch’s contactless sleep tracking technology.

• Discover, define, and implement new customer journeys and experiences.

• Plan and run research and prototype testing at varying levels of fidelity, and turn the findings into clear decisions.

After 6 months:

• Take on larger, more ambiguous feature work, using what you've learned about our adult customers to shape what we build next.

• Build on your learnings and design system work to develop and launch new-to-the-world features and products.

• Actively contribute to infusing creativity, play, and learning into our team culture.

What You’ll Bring

• Passion for human-centered product experiences and for solving ambiguous problems.

• 5+ years of hands-on UX and product design experience, with a portfolio that shows strategic thinking and the process behind the work, not only polished UI.

• Demonstrated ability to define problems and shape product direction: framing opportunities, mapping journeys, and making the case for what to build.

• Strong research skills: planning and running studies and turning findings into clear decisions.

• Experience leading UX for features end to end, from concept to launch, in partnership with PMs and engineers.

• A strong understanding of UX and UI best practices in mobile applications, including accessibility.

Senior UX Designer

Location: Remote

Summary

The Wikimedia Foundation is a non-profit organization supporting Wikipedia and other Wiki projects. The Foundation operates one of the world’s top five websites and has global reach and impact. Technology and innovation are critical in our quest to support every human in freely sharing knowledge.

The Product Design team is looking for a Senior UX Designer with a solid understanding of user experience and product development processes to work within a new multi-disciplinary product team that will be focused on improving trust and safety. You will be influential in creating and developing the user experience, feeding directly into the product strategy for your product team.

For this role, you will primarily be working with the Reader Growth team, software focused on ways of learning and engagement for new and casual readers of Wikipedia.

Must be available for design, product and engineering team meetings and synchronous collaboration from 14:00 UTC and 18:00 UTC (10:00-14:00 ET / 7:00-11:00 PT)

You will be responsible for…

• Reducing complexity to create simple, delightful experiences for our users.

• Creating prototypes and running experiments to iteratively test your hypotheses.

• Using and evolving our design system and guidelines, to create new features from ideas on paper to implementation.

• Applying accessibility standards and guidelines to your designs.

• Collaborating with product managers and engineers to create product plans and maintain product design processes.

• Distilling complex concepts into easy to understand talking points to engage with our readers and communities throughout the design process.

Skills and experience….

The right person is better than the right set of experiences. These are the traits we’ve identified that make great additions to our team so far.

• Can communicate their design goals and processes clearly and concisely to other team members and stakeholders.

• Provides constructive feedback to other designers and welcomes feedback from others.

• Experienced in conducting research, as well as collaborating with UX researchers, to build a deeper understanding of audience behaviours.

• Is able to generate ideas for the future as well as think tactically about how to deliver work in the present.

• Is self-motivated and seeks to evolve their skills and share what they’ve learnt with others.

• 5+ years of experience contributing on design teams.

• Bachelor's degree and/or Masters degree, or equivalent in related work experience

Additionally, we’d love it if you have...

• Background in content consumption, publishing, education, or news

• Experience acting as a researcher, both in-person and with remote participants

• Have familiarity with Free Knowledge and/or Open Source communities

• Speak more than one of the nearly 300 languages of the users you’ll be designing for

title: Product Designer
description:
Warp: We're Building the Platform for Agentic Development

Warp began with the vision of reimagining one of the fundamental dev tools, the terminal, to make it more usable and powerful for all developers. As AI has advanced, Warp has evolved beyond its terminal roots into a full agentic development environment: a workbench for dispatching agents to code, deploy, and debug production software.

Today, we have three products. Warp is the agentic development environment born out of the terminal, built on an orchestration platform for running hundreds of cloud agents in parallel. And Warp Factories is our newest product: infrastructure for engineering teams to build and run their own cloud software factories, where fleets of agents triage, spec, implement, review, and verify code across a company's entire SDLC. Together, these products are creating the scaffolding for developers to build their own workflows for working with agents.

In Warp, you can seamlessly switch between running commands, launching agents, and iterating on code with agents, eliminating the need to jump between a terminal and an IDE. It all works with our built in SOTA agent or top agents like Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. On the orchestration side, you can build custom agents that are triggered programmatically, tracked centrally, and shared across full teams to run agents across organizations without compromising security or reliability. Continue a cloud agent run locally in Warp or on the web with one click. And with Warp Factories, teams can go a step further and set up entire automated workflows around their SDLC, retaining full control over their data, models, and compute along the way.

With over 1 million active developers at companies including Docker, Ramp, and Peloton, and over half of the Fortune 500, and revenue that grew over 44x last year, Warp is one of the fastest growing startups in the AI development space.

Our mission has remained the same even as AI has advanced: to empower developers to ship better software more quickly, freeing them to focus on the creative and rewarding aspects of their work. If you want to help define what development looks like in the agentic era at a company where your work reaches hundreds of thousands of engineers every day, we'd love to have you. For more information on our team and culture, we highly recommend reading our' How We Work' guide.

As a Product Designer, you will…

• Design and prototype product experiences for Warp using Figma in close collaboration with Warp’s engineering, product, and growth teams.

• Iterate on existing features to improve ergonomics, cognitive load, workflow friction, design pattern consistency, and comprehension.

• Craft every detail of new product features, from idea to UX to pixel-perfect execution.

• Contribute to and help manage Warp’s design system and ensure implementation meets specification.

• Use Warp to ship UI nits, bugs, and modifications to production.

• Test designs with our internal team and developer community.

• Drive the product forward. You will be expected to operate as a product thinker as much as a designer.

You may be a good fit if...

• You have 3+ years of experience working on AI, ML, DevTools, Data, or other technical products.

• You enjoy iterating and perfecting detailed workflows.

• You have a lived understanding of developers’ needs and want to improve their relationships with their tools.

• You're committed to building and facilitating relationships with non-designers to execute on your shared vision of building the best product for our users

• You have great communication skills, and have experience working with engineers on a technical product.

• You have experience contributing to or managing design systems.

• Bonus:

• Familiar with the developer experience

• Some basic experience with coding or using a terminal

• Experience at a fast paced startup environment

• Experience designing for AI tools

Salary Transparency

Warp operates from a place of high trust and transparency around compensation. We state the pay range that best aligns with our understanding of the market and the needs for the open role.

When we find the right person, we try to put our best foot forward with an offer that excites you. We consider your skills, the level of experience you bring, and what similar jobs in the market pay, all while ensuring equal pay for equal work at Warp.

Total compensation at Warp consists of: (1) a market-competitive base salary, (2) a generous benefits package, and (3) meaningful equity.

The budgeted compensation amount for this role is targeted at $160,000 to $215,000.

Exact compensation will vary based on skills and experience.

In addition to salary, all employees receive further compensation in the form of equity in the company. This is a meaningful stock option grant with a four-year vesting period and one-year cliff. Your equity is where most of the significant upside potential is. Comparing startup equity is always a bit tricky, so we’re happy to walk you through different valuation scenarios at the offer stage in order to help paint a clearer picture of the upside.

What we offer

• Competitive salary, generous benefits, and meaningful equity

• 100% coverage on medical, dental, and vision benefits for employees (80% coverage for dependents)

• A flexible remote-first culture, with optional office spaces in NYC and SF for folks who want to work together IRL

• Pre-tax FSA and Health Savings Plans

• Pre-tax Commuter Benefit

• 12 company holidays, 20 days of Paid Time Off, and unlimited sick time

• 16 weeks of paid Parental Leave for both birthing and non-birthing parents

• Twice-a-year all company retreats in awesome locations

• A monthly gym and internet stipend

• A company-sponsored 401(k) through Vestwell

• A complimentary OneMedical membership

Individuals seeking employment at Warp are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation.

About Warp

We are a company run by product-first builders, building a core product for all developers. We are committed to understanding our users deeply. We will ultimately build the best product and business if that team includes developers and designers from a wide range of backgrounds. The early team comes from Google, Dropbox, Gem, LinkedIn, and Facebook. We are looking for passionate individuals to join us and help bring Warp to the world.

We value honesty, humility, and pragmatism, and our core product principle is focusing on the user. If you’re interested in learning more about our company values and the culture of our engineering team, please take a look at our internal 'How We Work' guide.

We’re very fortunate to be backed by a great group of venture capital firms. In August 2023, we announced a $50M Series B funding round ($73M total raised), led by Sequoia Capital. Our other investors include Google Ventures, Neo, and Box Group. We are also backed by a network of passionate angels, including Dylan Field (Co-Founder and CEO, Figma), Elad Gil (early investor in Airbnb, Pinterest, Stripe, and Square), Jeff Weiner (Executive Chairman and Ex-CEO, LinkedIn), Marc Benioff (Founder and CEO, Salesforce), and Sam Altman (Co-Founder & CEO, OpenAI).

title: Product Designer - UX/UI & Design Systems
description:
Product Designer – UX/UI, Design Systems & SaaS

Location: Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Mexico
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Product Designer (UX/UI) to own the end-to-end product design experience across web and mobile applications.

This is not a purely visual design role. We’re looking for someone who combines UX research, product thinking, UI design, prototyping, and design systems to solve real user problems and create intuitive, scalable digital products.

You’ll work closely with Product Managers and Engineers throughout the product lifecycle — from understanding user needs and mapping workflows to designing polished interfaces, maintaining design systems, and supporting implementation.

If you think in user journeys, flows, systems, and outcomes — not just individual screens — this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

UX Research & Product Discovery

• Conduct user interviews, usability testing, and product research.

• Analyze user behavior and identify friction across the product experience.

• Translate research into:

• User flows

• Journey maps

• Personas

• Wireframes

• Interaction models

• Use qualitative and quantitative insights to recommend product improvements.

• Work with analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar platforms to support design decisions.

UX/UI & Product Design

• Own design from early concepts through production-ready interfaces.

• Create:

• User flows

• Wireframes

• Interactive prototypes

• High-fidelity UI

• Design intuitive experiences across web and mobile applications.

• Simplify complex workflows into clear, user-friendly experiences.

• Create responsive layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile.

• Iterate quickly based on user feedback, product requirements, and analytics.

Figma & Design Systems

• Work extensively in Figma to create and maintain production-ready designs.

• Build and maintain scalable design systems and reusable component libraries.

• Establish and document standards for:

• Typography

• Color

• Spacing

• Components

• Interaction patterns

• UI behavior

• Maintain consistency across products, features, and platforms.

• Improve collaboration and efficiency between Product, Design, and Engineering.

Accessibility & Usability

• Design accessible experiences aligned with WCAG 2.1 principles.

• Consider accessibility throughout the design process rather than as a final-stage requirement.

• Ensure interfaces work effectively across devices, browsers, and screen sizes.

• Identify usability issues and continuously reduce friction across key workflows.

Testing, Analytics & Optimization

• Conduct usability testing to validate design decisions.

• Support A/B testing across:

• Layouts

• User flows

• Features

• Interaction patterns

• Analyze user behavior and product feedback.

• Use findings to improve:

• Usability

• Conversion

• Engagement

• Retention

• Task completion

• Continuously iterate on launched experiences rather than treating design as complete after handoff.

Product & Engineering Collaboration

Work closely with:

• Product Managers

• Engineers

• Developers

• Other product and business stakeholders

You will:

• Translate product requirements into clear design solutions.

• Participate in product discussions and feature planning.

• Communicate design decisions and rationale clearly.

• Prepare developer-ready designs, assets, and specifications.

• Use Figma Dev Mode, Zeplin, or similar tools for handoff.

• Review implementations and help resolve UX/UI inconsistencies before release.

Required Experience & Skills

Core Requirements

• 2+ years of professional Product Design or UX/UI Design experience.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating real product design work.

• Strong proficiency with Figma.

• Experience designing responsive web and/or mobile applications.

• Experience creating:

• User flows

• Wireframes

• Interactive prototypes

• High-fidelity interfaces

• Design systems

• Strong understanding of:

• UX principles

• Interaction design

• Information architecture

• Responsive design

• Usability testing

• Accessibility

• Experience collaborating directly with Product Managers and Engineers.

• Strong visual design skills with excellent attention to detail.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication.

• Ability to work remotely during U.S. business hours.

Portfolio Requirements

Your portfolio should demonstrate more than polished final screens.

We want to see evidence of:

• The problem you were solving.

• Your role in the project.

• User or business requirements.

• Research and discovery.

• User flows and UX decisions.

• Wireframes and prototypes.

• Final UI execution.

• Design system or component thinking.

• How feedback, testing, or data influenced your decisions.

• The outcome or impact of your work.

Nice-to-Have Experience

• Experience designing SaaS products.

• B2B or enterprise software design experience.

• Consumer application experience.

• Experience building or scaling mature design systems.

• Familiarity with:

• Mixpanel

• Amplitude

• Hotjar

• Product analytics platforms

• Experience with experimentation and A/B testing.

• Basic understanding of:

• HTML

• CSS

• JavaScript

• Experience working in Agile or sprint-based product teams.

• Familiarity with developer handoff through Figma Dev Mode or Zeplin.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

• Think about the entire user journey rather than isolated screens.

• Can explain the reasoning behind your design decisions.

• Balance user needs with product and business objectives.

• Enjoy simplifying complicated workflows.

• Use research, feedback, and data rather than designing entirely from intuition.

• Think systematically about reusable components and patterns.

• Care about accessibility and usability.

• Collaborate effectively with engineers.

• Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly.

• Can independently take a product problem from discovery through final design.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

• Reviewing product requirements with a Product Manager.

• Analyzing user behavior or customer feedback.

• Mapping a new user journey or workflow.

• Creating wireframes for a new feature.

• Building an interactive prototype in Figma.

• Designing polished responsive interfaces.

• Conducting or reviewing usability tests.

• Updating components within the design system.

• Working with engineers on implementation questions.

• Reviewing a developed feature against the approved design.

• Analyzing post-launch feedback and identifying opportunities for improvement.

In short: you turn user problems and product requirements into intuitive, scalable, accessible, and visually polished digital experiences.

Key Metrics for Success

• Improved usability and task completion rates.

• Increased product engagement and retention.

• Reduced friction across critical user journeys.

• Quality and consistency of UX/UI execution.

• Design system adoption and consistency.

• On-time delivery of design assets and prototypes.

• Reduced design-related implementation rework.

• Effective collaboration with Product and Engineering.

• Positive user and stakeholder feedback.

Why This Role Stands Out

• End-to-end ownership of meaningful product design work.

• Direct influence on product experience and customer satisfaction.

• Opportunity to work closely with Product and Engineering.

• Ability to shape and scale the product’s design system.

• Exposure to research, UX, UI, analytics, and experimentation.

• Fully remote environment.

• Growth opportunities into:

• Senior Product Designer

• Lead Product Designer

• Design Lead

• Head of Design

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’d like to hear about:

• Your experience as a Product Designer or UX/UI Designer.

• The types of SaaS, web, or mobile products you’ve designed.

• A product or feature you designed end-to-end and the problem you were solving.

• How you approach UX research before beginning the visual design process.

• Your experience building or maintaining design systems in Figma.

• An example of a complex workflow you simplified for users.

• How you collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers during development.

• How user feedback, usability testing, or analytics influenced one of your design decisions.

Please keep your answers clear, concise, and conversational. We’re interested in understanding your product thinking, communication ability, UX process, and the reasoning behind your design decisions.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Interview Process

• Initial Phone Screen

• Spark Hire Intro Video

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

• Portfolio Review

• Practical Product Design Task

• Client Interview

• Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you combine strong UX thinking with polished UI execution, understand how to build scalable design systems, and enjoy solving real product problems, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and complete the required Spark Hire intro video to move forward in the hiring process.

With more than 200 active defense programs,Lyntrisworks at every level of the mission, from national command authority to the tactical edge.

Solutions are designed by operators who understand the mission, engineered for the conditions that degrade or defeat standard systems, and built on an open, modular architecture that integrates into existing programs without requiring them to start over.Lyntrismoves faster than the traditional defense cycle — with integrated design, build and test capabilities in-house — and delivers systems that sustain and endure long after initial fielding.

Job Description

• Senior Product Designer

• Full time

• Remote

The Senior Product Designer is responsible for leading the design of intuitive, scalable, and technically grounded digital product experiences from early problem definition through implementation. This role partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, clients, and other stakeholders to translate complex business and technical requirements into thoughtful product experiences, interaction models, and high-fidelity prototypes.

The Senior Product Designer operates with a high degree of autonomy and contributes beyond traditional interface design by helping shape product strategy, explore solutions, and reduce ambiguity through rapid, AI-enabled prototyping. The role also serves as a bridge between design and engineering, using interactive prototypes to validate product behaviors, communicate design intent, and support efficient implementation.

Duties & Responsibilities

• Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Engineering, clients, and key stakeholders to define problem spaces, understand user needs, establish success criteria, and translate ambiguous business and technical requirements into clear product concepts and experience strategies.

• Lead end-to-end product design across user journeys, interaction models, system states, and high-fidelity interfaces, creating intuitive, scalable experiences that align with product and business objectives while accounting for real-world usage and edge cases.

• Facilitate design thinking engagements, including workshops, ideation sessions, discovery exercises, and design sprints, to explore opportunities, generate solutions, and build alignment across stakeholders.

• Contribute to the evolution and adoption of design systems and modern product design practices that improve consistency, speed, clarity, and technical alignment.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

• Demonstrated experience designing end-to-end digital product experiences, including user flows, interaction models, system states, and high-fidelity interfaces.

• Experience translating ambiguous business or technical requirements into clear product and experience solutions.

• Strong experience with prototyping and interactive design tools, including Figma or comparable platforms.

• Demonstrated ability to create prototypes that represent realistic user flows, system behaviors, conditional logic, and edge cases.

A web-based business reporting portal that centralizes complex data into a clean, intuitive interface, and a mobile sports betting app (iOS/Android) that consolidates multiple providers into a seamless user experience. Design must prioritize usability, accessibility (WCAG compliance), and responsive adaptability for web, while adhering to iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design standards for mobile.

The core challenge is to simplify complex data flows (portal) and enable fast, intuitive interactions for betting users, while maintaining visual consistency across both platforms. Collaboration with technical teams under Agile methodologies is required, using Figma for design systems, interactive prototyping, and technical documentation.

Mandatory requirement: Proven experience in sports betting products and advanced expertise in managing components and variants in Figma.

We are looking for a UX/UI Designer:

General activities:

1. Research & Analysis

• Conducted user research (interviews, surveys, competitor analysis) to understand user needs in sports betting and business reporting platforms.

• Executed usability testing using tools like Maze or Lookback and synthesized key findings.

• Defined user personas and journey maps for both web and mobile products.

2. Conceptual Design

• Created wireframes and user flows to validate information architecture.

• Developed low and high-fidelity interactive prototypes in Figma.

• WCAG accessibility guidelines.

• Participated in Agile ceremonies (standups, grooming sessions) using JIRA and Notion.

5. Iteration & Improvement

• Analyzed usage metrics (heatmaps, analytics) to refine and improve designs.

• Proposed A/B testing for key components (e.g., betting buttons, data filters).

• Designed core flows: user registration, deposits, live betting, balance management.

• Optimized microinteractions (notifications, animations) to enhance user engagement.

• Maintained updated design tokens and libraries in Figma/Zeroheight.
