title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Welcome to OLX

We're building marketplace sustainable ecosystems that millions of people depend on every month – to buy and sell cars, find homes, land jobs, and trade secondhand goods. It's commerce that matters: safe, smart, and environmentally responsible.

We do this with courage to innovate, commitment to outcomes, collaboration across 50+ nationalities and 7 markets, and a customer-led approach that puts real people first. Add a desire to win – and you get a culture that's ambitious, fast-moving, and built on trust.

Our brands – including AutoTrader, OLX, Otomoto, Property24, and more – are loved by millions. And we're backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest tech investors.

Join OLX and see how far you can go.

We believe the future of our products sits at the intersection of AI and design. Our ambition is to become an AI-native organization, where intelligent systems and human-centered design come together to create faster, smarter, and more meaningful customer experiences. We’re rethinking how products are built, how experiences are shaped, and how teams deliver impact.

A key part of this transformation is creating the right foundations and infrastructure to enable high-quality experiences at scale - where design systems, patterns, and workflows are structured, scalable, and AI-readable, unlocking new levels of speed, consistency, and innovation.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Product Design team. Reporting to the Product Design Manager, you will shape design strategy across product squads, own craft and quality standards, and mentor junior and mid-level designers. You'll work at the intersection of design, code, and AI systems—using tools like Lovable, Claude, and Cursor to prototype and iterate. Beyond shipping product experiences, you'll establish patterns, build systems thinking, and elevate the entire team's capabilities in AI-native design. The output we expect is not just working artifacts: it's strategic direction that raises design quality and team maturity across the organization.

What responsibilities will you get when working with us?

•
Lead design strategy across one or more product squads, translating business goals and user needs into coherent design direction that shapes product roadmaps and team priorities.

•
Use AI-native workflows to collapse the gap between strategy and production, prototyping and iterating directly in code rather than through static handoffs. Lead by example in adopting tools like Lovable, Claude, and Cursor for end-to-end design execution.

•
Establish and maintain high craft standards by defining foundational and reusable Agentic Experience patterns, designing scalable components for the design system (Nexus), and reviewing work to ensure quality and consistency.

•
Mentor and develop designers through critique, guidance, and structured feedback—helping them grow their craft, decision-making, and ability to work autonomously with AI-native tools.

•
Partner with Product and Engineering to align on experience strategy, success metrics, and technical feasibility—translating design insights into business outcomes and measurable impact.

•
Conduct user research and run experiments to validate design decisions. Define success metrics, gather feedback, and iterate fast—always balancing speed with quality and bias toward shipping.

•
Lead design reviews, brainstorming sessions, and strategic discussions with your design peers and cross-functional partners. Communicate design rationale clearly with data, influence decisions, and build alignment around priorities.

•
Identify gaps and opportunities for design improvement and innovation. Propose and champion new approaches to solving complex problems—whether through design systems improvements, new AI patterns, or cross-domain initiatives.

As a Senior Product Designer, you will need:

•
Proven experience in UX / Digital Product Design, with a strong portfolio that showcases shipped work, live prototypes, and measurable business impact—not just static screens. We won’t be interviewing if you don’t have a portfolio to share beforehand.

•
Demonstrated expertise in AI-native design: you actively use AI tools (Figma Make, Lovable, Cursor, Claude, etc.) as a core part of your design practice and can teach others how to leverage them effectively.

•
Experience building or contributing to design systems, including code components. You understand how design decisions impact engineering implementation and can collaborate deeply with engineering teams.

•
Proven track record mentoring and developing designers. You give and receive candid feedback, help others improve their craft, and create psychologically safe environments for growth and experimentation.

•
Strong product and business thinking: ability to frame problems strategically, connect design decisions to business outcomes, and define success metrics that demonstrate measurable impact.

•
Excellent English communication and influence skills: you articulate design rationale clearly with data, facilitate complex discussions, and drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders and leadership.

•
Growth mindset and adaptability: you thrive in ambiguity and rapid change, prioritize learning and impact over mastery of any specific tool, and are excited about emerging technologies and evolving design practices.

What can we offer you:

• Work with and impact all OLX websites around the world

•
Salary + annual bonus up to 15% of your annual gross salary

•
Train and conference budget and free access to Udemy courses

•
Permanent contract, health insurance and life insurance

•
MacBook Pro or Windows Dell along with necessary accessories to make your work comfortable

•
100% remote work (and the possibility to work from our office in Lisboa or Barcelona)

Hiring Process

First Stage
TA Screen

This is your first interview with our Talent Acquisition team. We’ll explore your background, skills, and
experience, as well as your approach to autonomy, ownership, and critical thinking. It’s also a chance to
discuss your aspirations and ensure alignment with our culture and values.

Second Stage
Portfolio Review

In this stage, you’ll meet with the Hiring Manager and a Designer from the team. We’ll explore your
process thinking and approach to design through a case study of your choice. This is also a great
opportunity to discuss how you collaborate with others and how your values align with our team culture.

Third Stage
AI Sandbox Challenge

This is a dynamic and interactive session where you’ll have the chance to demonstrate your thought
process in action. It’s designed to give us insight into how you approach challenges, integrate AI into your
workflows, and apply your skills in a practical setting.
We aim to make this process clear, collaborative, and reflective of the way we work as a team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. For more details on how your application data will be processed please check our Privacy Statement.

description:

We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, comprised of agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. HighLevel empowers users with all the tools needed to capture, nurture, and close new leads into repeat customers. As of mid 2025, HighLevel processes over 4 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages over 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million hostnames.

Our PeopleWith over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our ImpactAs of mid 2025, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.

About the Role

We are seeking a Staff Product Designer (P5) who can lead high-impact product design work across multiple teams, connect adjacent product experiences and turn complex problem spaces into coherent shipped outcomes. You have spent 8+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy, AI-enabled or similarly sophisticated product experiences.

As a staff individual contributor, you will operate across product areas where the right solution depends on more than one roadmap, team or feature brief. You will partner deeply with Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Design leadership and customer-facing teams to frame the right problems, define product experience direction and help teams move from ambiguity to high-quality execution.

This role requires exceptional craft, strong product judgment and the ability to balance strategic influence with hands-on design work. You should be comfortable defining experience direction, mapping complex workflows, prototyping new interaction models, strengthening shared patterns and helping teams preserve quality through implementation.

Design systems are an important part of this role, but not the whole role. You will use systems, patterns, accessibility standards and reusable components to connect product experiences while still leading original, customer-centered design work for high-impact product areas.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You'll Do

•
Lead design strategy and execution for complex initiatives that span multiple teams, product surfaces or customer workflows

•
Translate customer needs, business goals, technical constraints, data signals and product strategy into clear experience direction

•
Partner with product and engineering leaders to clarify problem spaces, sequence design work and align teams around high-quality outcomes

•
Create prototypes, workflows, interaction models and high-fidelity designs that make complex product ideas tangible and testable

•
Identify product experience gaps, design debt and cross-team inconsistencies, then turn them into practical improvements

•
Shape AI-enabled workflows, intelligent interfaces and automation-heavy experiences that give customers clarity, control and confidence

•
Strengthen shared patterns, design-system adoption, accessibility standards and implementation guidance across adjacent product areas

•
Mentor senior and lead designers through critique, coaching, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale

•
Collaborate effectively across US and India time zones in a 100% remote environment

What We Are Looking For

•
8+ years of relevant product design experience, leading complex, ambiguous and high-impact initiatives across multiple teams or product areas

•
An exceptional portfolio that demonstrates staff-level craft, product judgment, customer empathy, systems thinking, measurable impact and shipped product quality

•
Experience shaping product direction beyond a single feature or team, with the ability to connect adjacent workflows into coherent customer experiences

•
Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility, content quality and implementation detail

•
Proven experience across the design lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing

•
Strong prototyping fluency, including the ability to use Figma, Framer, AI coding tools or lightweight front-end code to make complex ideas tangible

•
Experience designing AI-powered, automation-heavy or intelligent product experiences where customers need transparency, control, trust and useful guidance

•
Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions

•
Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers

•
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to align teams through customer insight, business rationale, data, prototypes and craft

•
A collaborative, low-ego leadership style with a track record of mentoring designers, improving critique and raising standards

How You Work

•
You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking, prototyping and hands-on design execution

•
You lead through influence, clarity and credibility across teams that may not report into the same roadmap or operating rhythm

•
You are a maker as well as a strategist, using prototypes, AI-assisted tools and practical technical fluency to make ideas concrete quickly

•
You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer

•
You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people

•
You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates

•
You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum

•
You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design

description:
Hello!

Innersloth is a small remote team scattered mostly in North America. We released Among Us in 2018 and are now working on a new game. We are looking to expand our creative team with a full-time, contracted, UI/UX Designer.

Your focus will be on UI/UX Design: creating and maintaining UI/UX documentation, style guides, flows, wireframes, prototypes, mock-ups, and ready-to-implement designs. Your role will be very iterative, proactively developing solutions to address usability feedback from both playtesters and the development team.

You'll report to the project's Game Directors, take direction from the Game Designer, and work alongside the art team. We don’t want to overscope this, but because we are a small team, sometimes responsibilities overlap - a willingness to learn and help is essential. You will not be working alone, and our team prioritizes providing support and ensuring you are thriving in your role.

We especially encourage marginalized groups and people from underrepresented backgrounds, genders, and locations to apply.Diverse voices make Innersloth better, and we strive to continue creating a diverse and welcoming space from the ground up.

Please note this is not an entry-level position, but we'll consider strong candidates with general experience working in games, UI/UX development, and/or visual design that accounts for the required skillset. Please absolutely include these things in your application!

What we're looking for:

Proactivity, independence, and accountability are extremely important for this position. If you show an aptitude for working well with others, handling conflict, and understanding UI/UX design for games, we want to hear from you!

This job opening is only valid for residents living in North America.

We're aiming for a January 11th, 2027 start date.

AI-dependent workflows are not a fit for this position. Candidates should be able to demonstrate their work, reasoning, and problem-solving without AI assistance.

The following points outline the knowledge, skills and abilities that we strongly prefer. None of these are strict dealbreakers, but reflect the type of experience we feel would lead to finding the right candidate for this position.

Our expectations:

• You have a degree/diploma/certificate in Human-Computer Interaction, Game Design, Graphic Design, Information Science, or a related field. (Equivalent experience is highly valued)

• You have at least 3 years of prior experience as a UI/UX Designer for games (mobile, PC and/or console) with a strong portfolio that clearly communicates your skill and approach

• You understand and apply best practices for UX flow and accessibility

• You pay strong attention to detail and have a keen eye for aesthetics

• You are proficient in industry standard design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Miro, and Figma

• You have excellent written and oral communication skills and can clearly articulate your ideas, designs, and suggestions

• You are comfortable giving and receiving feedback, and can rapidly iterate based on playtest and team feedback

• Can collaborate and work well in a team-based, dynamic, cross-functional setting

• You are a highly organized, self-sufficient person who is task-oriented

Nice to have:

• Experience working within Unity and the Unity UI Toolkit

• Experience using version control tools (e.g. Git)

• Experience designing UI/UX for mobile games

• Experience designing responsive interfaces that accommodate localized text

• Experience/understanding on running user testing initiatives

• An understanding of general console certification requirements as they pertain to UI

What you'll be doing:

• Create original UI/UX designs that exhibit a strong understanding of layout, composition, iconography, typography, and accessibility, while aligning with the art direction and gameplay goals

• Create and maintain UI/UX documentation, style guides, flows, wireframes, prototypes, mock-ups, and ready-to-implement designs

• Design UI elements such as menu interfaces, HUD, input controls, navigational components, informational components, and dialogue boxes

• Design UI/UX that is responsive across multiple platforms, aspect ratios, and screen orientations

• Report to the game directors while working closely with the game designer, artists, and engineers to help bring the game interfaces to life

• Identify and troubleshoot UX challenges and opportunities based on playtesting and team feedback

• Demonstrate ownership and autonomy while delivering project priorities on time

• Communication requirements include:

• Responsive and proactive usage of ClickUp and Microsoft Teams

• Attend and contribute to scheduled meetings when required

Our offer

• A guaranteed 6 month, full-time, remote, work from home position.

• While this original contract is set for 6 months, we're open to discussing an extension should the need be proven and required for project completion.

• Your work week cannot exceed 40 hours/week and must include and relate to Innersloth's Monday to Friday working schedule. Our company core hours are 10 AM to 2 PM PST. You would be expected to be online during this time but how you make up the rest of your day is up to you.

• You will be responsible to ensure you can perform your job effectively and efficiently.

• Due to the length of this contract, we are unable to offer health benefits to anyone outside of the United States of America. If our perfect candidate lives internationally, we will offer a fair salary in lieu of benefits.

• A competitive, fixed, monthly rate of payment.

• A guarantee that your position is safe and stable for the duration of this project - regardless of what's happening around us, we have a very healthy financial runway.

• A collection of friendly, diverse workmates and partner companies.

FAQ

• What's the level of experience necessary?

• There’s no hard requirement (3+ years is suggested), but ideally you have an applied understanding of UI/UX design workflows.

• What’s the immediate team like?

• You will be joining an established team of 6
people, with three department leads, game designer, programmer, and artists working on the unannounced title.

• You'll be managed by the game directors. You will communicate and collaborate with the rest of the team often.

Recruitment Process

**Applications close at 10:00 AM PST on November 19th, 2026.**

• You'll get an email from us to acknowledge receipt.

• We’ll review applications and contact everyone to let you know if you made it to the next stage or not.

• Stage 2 will be a video call with 2-3 people from the team to get context on your technical experience, the depth of your technical skillset, and what you could bring to the company. There will be time for you to ask questions as well.

• Stage 3 will be another video call with some of the wider team members you may work with at Innersloth. Here we will learn more about your experience as a problem solver and team member. There will be time for you to ask questions as well.

• If all goes well you'll get a job offer.

Wow, you made it to the end!

Please press the button and send us your application. We look forward to hearing from you (and don't forget to upload/link us your portfolio!)
Salary: $9600/Month

title: Lead Design Engineer
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About this role:

As a Lead Design Engineer at Samsara, you'll build the systems that power our product and scale our impact as a design team. You'll define the components, patterns, tokens, and guidelines for both people and agents to build with. You'll work in design and in code, shipping highly interactive UI across web and mobile. You’ll codify our principles, heuristics, and taste for high quality ai generation. Your work will shape how quickly teams can build, how reliably our products behave, and how confidently customers use them.

This is a remote role open to candidates residing in Canada.

You should apply if:

•
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

•
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

•
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

•
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

• Develop core system components, evals, and feedback loops to harden AI design and code generation.

• Govern taste through structure, preventing ai slop from ever making it into our customers’ hands.

• Make sure system decisions translate cleanly into code, with shared ownership of quality, performance, and maintainability.

• Build accessibility, responsiveness, and performance into the system by default.

• Set clear contribution, governance, and deprecation models that balance speed with system integrity.

• Meet regularly with the designers and engineers who use the system, and bring their feedback alongside usage data into what you build next.

• Share the AI tools, workflows, and tactics that work with the wider design and engineering teams.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as the company scales globally across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 8+ years of experience in design engineering, design systems, product design, or front-end engineering, building UX/UI for web and mobile applications.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction Design, or equivalent practical experience.

• Shipped design system or component library work, with a portfolio, case studies, or code samples that explain what you built, how you decided, and how teams adopted it. We cannot consider applications without a portfolio at this time.

• Strong interaction and visual design skills, with the judgment to know when to use an established pattern and when to invent one.

• Experience with design tokens, theming, and accessibility standards.

• AI tools in your regular practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Figma Make), with shipped work you can attribute to them, and experience connecting them to a design system. You can explain, review, and debug the code they generate.

• Experience partnering with designers, engineers, and product managers on short cycles.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$151,300—$195,800 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

💼 Senior Product Designer

🌍 Open to Latin America and Nigeria

🏠 Remote

About Our Client

Our client is an early-stage GovTech startup building a modern planning and permitting platform for local governments. Their mission is to make more housing happen faster by making permitting unremarkable, tackling one of the biggest bottlenecks in a country short millions of homes.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to design and deliver intuitive web experiences and native mobile apps for inspections and code enforcement products. You'll also scale design quality and judgment across the company as the second designer on the team.

You'll join early, report directly to the CEO, and own design end to end across web and mobile without a design manager, a detailed spec, or a PM handing you a brief. If you've shipped 0-to-1 B2B products for complex workflows, use AI in your design work every day, and want to make the people around you better at design, this role is a strong fit.

Responsibilities

• Design and deliver the Inspections MVP to live customers within 3 months of starting, and the Code Enforcement product within 5 months

• Design intuitive experiences for native mobile and dense desktop, from information architecture through visual detail

• Work from how inspectors, code enforcement officers, and planning staff actually do their jobs rather than from what similar products look like

• Take fuzzy problems, decide what makes the MVP and what waits, and move without waiting for requirements to firm up

• Maintain the design system after the contractor build across web and mobile, keeping it consistent so engineers and coding agents can build from it with minimal drift

• Design products as a coherent whole, thinking in models and workflows rather than isolated screens

• Enable engineers to ship UI that meets the bar on their own through shared design principles, a working critique practice, and a system that makes the consistent choice the easy one

• Give clear, helpful feedback often and make other people better at design without doing the work for them

• Use AI tools daily in your design process, from research and exploration to prototyping and specification

What We're Looking For

• Experience designing, shipping, and iterating on 0-to-1 B2B web and mobile apps for complex workflows with multiple user types

• A record of independently owning end-to-end web and mobile designs without a design manager

• Strong product judgment and scoping, able to decide what ships first and why

• Design craft that holds up across native mobile and dense desktop interfaces, with the systems thinking to keep a design system coherent as new surfaces are added

• Daily use of AI in your design work

• Ownership in ambiguity: you make progress without a spec, a PM, or a clear brief, and you fix problems you see rather than flagging them and waiting

• Strong written and spoken English, with a habit of giving direct, kind feedback

• Available to work US Pacific Time (PST) business hours

Nice to Have

• Experience designing for deskless workers, government staff, or less technology-savvy users

• Experience designing AI product surfaces or maintaining design systems

• Experience designing products that meet WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards

• Experience with brand or marketing design

• Former founder experience, beyond solo consulting

If you meet most of this but not every point, apply anyway. We hire for strengths and potential, not for a perfect resume.

Work Schedule

• 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

• This position operates on a full-time basis, with dedicated hours to ensure alignment with the team and delivery of quality work

• Working hours aligned to US Pacific Time (PST)

Compensation & Time Off

• Compensation paid in USD

• Paid bi-monthly on the 15th and 30th

•
Paid Time Off according to company policy

•
Holidays observed according to company guidelines

Application Requirements

Please submit:

• An updated resume

• A portfolio link with case studies of 0-to-1 B2B web or mobile products, showing your process, decisions, and outcomes

• A 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself and walking through one project where you decided what made the MVP and what had to wait, and why

Only candidates who submit both a portfolio and a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

Benefits

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

•
Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions

•
Video Introduction - Record a video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience

•
Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)

•
Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team

•
Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment

•
Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting

•
Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification

•
Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

description:
About Asite

We start with a simple idea: the built environment should be smarter, safer and more sustainable. Everything we do is about helping the people behind major construction and infrastructure projects work together more easily and make better decisions.

Asite offers a cloud-based platform that connects project teams, improves collaboration and manages data from the first design to the final handover. Industry leaders such as Laing O’Rourke, Transport for London and Aldar use Asite to keep their projects running smoothly and delivering strong results.

With offices around the world and a record of steady, profitable growth, we are shaping the future of construction technology while supporting the people who build the world around us.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced Senior UX Designer who enjoys solving complex workflow problems rather than simply producing UI screens.

You'll work alongside Product Managers, Product Owners, Engineers and the wider Design team to create enterprise software used by some of the world's largest construction organisations.

This role combines product thinking, UX research, interaction design, information architecture and modern AI-assisted design practices.

You will own design work from discovery through delivery, helping transform complex business requirements into intuitive, accessible and commercially valuable experiences.

Ready to use AI to increase the quality of output across all areas of UX, including: User Research Synthesis & Ideation, Personas, User Flows, Journey Mapping, Wireframing, Visual Design & Prototypes, Usability Testing & Accessibility Review, UX Copywriting & Microcopy, and Design QA & Handoff

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working in ambiguity, influencing product direction, collaborating closely with engineering and using evidence—not opinion—to drive design decisions.

• Reports directly to the Head of UX & Product Design for design direction, UX strategy, design quality, AI-first design practices, user research, accessibility, design system governance, and performance development

• Works closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, Engineering Leads, QA, Customer Success, Product Marketing, and client stakeholders to ensure product decisions are grounded in user needs, aligned with business priorities, technically feasible, and delivered to a high standard.

Translate complex customer workflows into simple, intuitive product experiences.

Design:

●Information architecture

●User flows

●Wireframes

●High-fidelity UI

●Interactive prototypes

Ensure every design balances:

●User needs

Leverage AI to assist with:

●Rapid prototyping

Stay current with emerging AI-assisted design workflows and identify opportunities to improve team productivity.

●Learnable

●Efficient

●Accessible

Design for:

●Large datasets

●Complex workflows

●Permission-based systems

●Multi-step business processes

title: Design Lead - Systems
description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

Atlassian is used by teams around the world for everything from pizza deliveries to space travel. To help us achieve our mission of unleashing the potential of every team, the Atlassian Creative Team is looking for a Lead Designer to guide how our identity system evolves and scales across a growing portfolio and audience. We're looking for someone who pairs brand strategy and identity expertise with a deep understanding of how individual systems connect to create a brand. You'll be a hands-on player/coach who is actively on the tools and owning the quality of the work.

In this role, you'll

•
Shape and evolve the Atlassian brand system: its core elements, how it all scales, and the vision for where it goes next.

•
Lead brand systems projects from brief to delivery, directing designers, art directors, and copywriters and setting the creative bar for the work.

•
Be the main point of contact for leadership, clients, and agency partners. You'll align on goals, manage feedback, and keep projects moving.

•
Partner with other design teams across Atlassian so that our brand and product systems connect into one coherent experience for our customers.

•
Extend the brand into new territories, developing product and sub-brands alongside strategy, marketing, and product teams.

•
Turn the brand system into living, AI-ready guidance and tools that people and AI can both work from, so teams and partners can create on-brand work independently and quickly.

•
Shape how our team uses AI in brand work. Set the standard for where it belongs across concepting, production, and review, and protect quality as these tools become part of how work gets made.

On the first day, we'll expect you to have

•
8+ years of professional experience, with a portfolio of ambitious brand systems work and problem-solving at scale.

•
A track record of leading complex, multidisciplinary projects and directing other creatives toward a shared vision.

•
Deep expertise in the core elements of identity, including typography, color, layout, grid, hierarchy, iconography, and imagery. You bring a clear aesthetic point of view and an uncompromising eye for detail and quality.

•
Applied experience building and evolving design systems for brands, with a technical understanding of how they're implemented at scale. You know how type, color, and layout behave across print, web, product, and motion, and you can turn brand decisions into tokens, specs, and assets that teams and engineers can use.

•
Strong stakeholder and agency management skills. You build alignment, balance competing priorities, give clear creative direction, and earn the trust of leadership.

•
Fluency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and Keynote, and hands-on experience with AI tools for generation, workflow building, and automation.

•
A considered point of view on AI's role in brand and creative work. You've used it in real projects, you can judge generated work critically, and you can guide a team on where it helps without lowering the bar.

•
A collaborative mindset: you seek out feedback, mentor others, and believe the best work comes from productive debate.

Qualifications

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

title: Head of Product Design
description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower veterinary professionals with opportunities to achieve greater flexibility in their careers while helping animal hospitals provide care for more pets in their communities.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the leading veterinary staffing and careers platform, connecting Vets, Techs, and Veterinary Assistants with practices for relief support, full-time hiring, and free continuing education. Roo empowers the largest network of over 30,000 veterinary professionals to earn and learn on their schedule, helping Veterinarians earn over $400 million. Together, we’ve provided more than 5 million hours of coverage at over 10,000 animal hospitals.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design to lead our product design team and raise the craft bar across every Roo surface.

This role sits within Roo’s product team, which owns product and design craft across the company. The product team supports a number of squads (aka business units), the cross-functional teams accountable for driving the success of the key pillars of our marketplace. Designers are aligned to one or more squads to deliver meaningful business impact but formally sit within the product team to ensure we are creating a cohesive product experience across squads. Holding that tension well is at the core of this job.

Given Roo’s size and fast-paced environment, leading the design team at Roo will require you to be a player-coach. This means you'll spend real time in Figma owning a few projects end-to-end to drive measurable business impact for one or more business units. At the same time, you’ll help set the quality bar across our full product surface by defining what design excellence means at Roo, and making it stick. You'll grow and coach the team, raise the craft, and build the practices that let design scale with the company.

This role is remote, with occasional travel to our San Francisco co-working space for key meetings and team events.

Responsibilities

• Lead, mentor, and grow the 5 person Product Design team. Support mid and staff-level designers in developing strong craft, critical thinking, and strategic influence.

• Evolve our design competencies into a standard the whole company can understand and then make it operate. Today that bar largely lives in people's heads. You’ll make it explicit, defensible, and consistently applied.

• Support career growth by running development conversations, writing performance reviews with business-unit leaders, and making the path from one level to the next clear

• Take on real design work yourself. Everything from hard problems, quick wins, exploratory concepts, and the things that unblock the team.

• Partner with leadership to align design direction with product strategy and company goals.

• Build and strengthen design systems that enable consistency, quality, and scalability. This includes raising the team's leverage with AI by helping to drive forward efforts to make our design system agentic-friendly so prototypes can be built from real components.

• Shape design practices across discovery, concept development, interaction design, prototyping, and delivery.

• Encourage exploration and push the team to rethink assumptions while staying grounded in user needs and market realities.

• Advocate for the customer experience across every surface and ensure design decisions always reflect real customer needs.

Qualifications

• 10+ years of product design experience with 4+ years of management experience

• Demonstrated ability to grow, coach, and support staff-level designers in improving their craft and helping them extend their skillset from strong execution toward strategic influence

• Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence across visual design, interaction design, systems thinking, product storytelling, and user-centered craft.

• Experience building and scaling design systems.

• AI fluency in design practice. You've used AI to move faster on real work and you have a considered view on where it helps and where it produces work that shouldn't ship.

• Ability to bring clarity to ambiguous spaces and turn loose ideas into compelling product concepts.

• Strong cross functional communication skills and experience working closely with cross-functional leadership

• Experience with a variety of user research methods. You know how to get answers from users yourself and help your designers do the same.

• Excitement about shaping the future of the industry by designing experiences that support meaningful work.

• Experience leading design across multiple products or surfaces. Two-sided marketplace experience is a strong plus.

Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

Core Values

Our Core Values are what shape us as an organization and we're looking for people who exhibit the same values in their professional life; Bias to Urgency, Drive Measurable Impact, Seek Understanding, Solve Customer Problems and Have Fun!

What to expect from working at Roo!

Located in the US:
For permanent, full time employees, we offer:

• Accelerated growth & learning potential.

• Stipends for home office setup, continuing education, and monthly wellness.

• Comprehensive health benefits to fit your needs with base medical plan covered at 100% with optional premium buy up plans.

• 401K

• Unlimited Paid Time Off.

• Paid Maternity/Paternity and reproductive care leave.

• Opportunity for domestic travel, including for regional team building events.

Overall, you would be part of a mission-driven company that will significantly empower the lives of all veterinary professionals and the health of the overall animal industry that seeks massive innovation.

We have diverse, passionate & driven team members from a variety of backgrounds, and Roo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our client is seeking an experienced, full-time Product Designer to shape the core user experience of their trend intelligence platform. As the platform rebuilds around LLM-driven capabilities, the successful candidate will be responsible for defining not just how features look, but how complex data and AI experiences should function. The primary focus is transforming dense, aggregated trend data into clear, intuitive, and actionable insights.

This position joins a close-knit Frontend & UX team reporting directly to the Frontend Lead. The role is 100% remote and open to candidates based between US Central Time (UTC−6) and Central European Time (UTC+1). Candidates must be available during core collaboration hours of 9:00 AM–12:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (2:00 PM–5:00 PM UK / 3:00 PM–6:00 PM CET).

•

Problem Identification & Solution Design: Independently identify user pain points through customer calls, interviews, user feedback, and usage data to build compelling product proposals.

•
AI & LLM Experience Design: Define user interactions for AI features (chat, automated reports, inline summaries), establish standards for insight attribution and uncertainty handling, and help refine the voice and structure of AI-generated content.

Design System Management: Own the principles and Figma library for the design system, partnering with frontend engineers to align with the React component library and establish robust data visualization and AI UX patterns.

•
UX Quality & Feedback Loops: Co-own product metrics, user feedback tracking, and quality evaluation rubrics for LLM outputs alongside the Frontend Lead.

Note: This position focuses strictly on product/UI/UX design. It does not involve writing production code, managing brand/marketing assets, or overseeing back-end API integrations.

Experience: 3+ years of product design experience, ideally owning features end-to-end within a B2B or SaaS platform.

Domain Focus: Experience designing data-heavy products, such as dashboards, analytics platforms, or reporting tools.

Schedule: Location within UTC−6 to UTC+1, with full availability during core collaboration hours (9:00 AM–12:00 PM EST).

• Experience as the founding or primary designer on a product team.

• Hands-on experience building or evolving design systems adopted by engineering teams.

• Direct experience designing AI features or creating evaluation rubrics for LLM output quality.

Benefits

﻿

UX/UI Designer – Figma, Product Design & User Experience | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a UX/UI Designer to create intuitive, visually polished, and high-performing digital experiences across web and mobile products.

This is more than a visual design role. You’ll own the design process from user research and UX strategy through wireframing, prototyping, high-fidelity UI design, design systems, and developer handoff.

You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, QA, and leadership to understand user problems and translate them into digital experiences that are easy to use, scalable, accessible, and aligned with business objectives.

If you combine strong UX thinking with polished UI execution and enjoy solving real product problems through design, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

User Research & UX Strategy

• Conduct user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and behavioral analysis

• Identify user needs, pain points, and friction across digital experiences

• Translate research into:

• Personas

• User journeys

• User flows

• Information architecture

• Wireframes

• Use behavioral and analytics tools such as:

• Hotjar

• FullStory

• Google Analytics

• Combine qualitative and quantitative insights to identify UX opportunities

• Recommend improvements based on user behavior, research, and product goals

Wireframing & Prototyping

• Create low-fidelity wireframes to validate concepts and workflows

• Build interactive prototypes for usability testing and stakeholder review

• Develop high-fidelity product mockups using:

• Figma

• Adobe XD

• Sketch

• Rapidly iterate based on:

• User testing

• Stakeholder feedback

• QA findings

• Clearly communicate interaction patterns and intended product behavior

• Move concepts efficiently from early exploration to production-ready design

UI & Product Design

• Design clean, modern, and user-friendly interfaces

• Create responsive experiences across:

• Desktop

• Tablet

• Mobile

• Balance usability, aesthetics, accessibility, and business objectives

• Design user flows and conversion paths that minimize friction

• Ensure interfaces are visually polished and production-ready

• Maintain consistency across features and product experiences

Design Systems & Scalability

• Establish consistent standards for:

• Typography

• Color

• Spacing

• Layouts

• Components

• Interaction patterns

• Create reusable components that improve design and development efficiency

• Maintain organized design files, assets, specifications, and documentation

• Ensure consistency across products, features, and platforms

• Evolve design systems as product requirements grow

Accessibility & Usability

• Contrast

• Readability

• Keyboard accessibility

• Responsiveness

• Overall usability

• Conduct usability reviews

• Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows

• Improve:

• Task completion

• Navigation

• Conversion paths

• Overall product usability

• Incorporate accessibility into designs from the beginning rather than treating it as a final check

Product & Engineering Collaboration

• Work closely with:

• Product Managers

• Developers

• QA

• Leadership

• Participate in sprint planning, product discussions, and feature prioritization

• Collaborate with engineering throughout implementation rather than only at handoff

• Deliver developer-ready designs using:

• Figma Dev Mode

• Zeplin

• InVision Inspect

• Provide clear specifications, assets, and interaction documentation

• Review implemented designs

• Identify and resolve inconsistencies before release

• Help ensure the final product accurately reflects the intended user experience

• Strong portfolio demonstrating:

• UX problem-solving

• UI craftsmanship

• Responsive design

• Product design thinking

• Advanced proficiency with:

• Figma

• Adobe XD

• Sketch

• Experience creating:

• User flows

• Wireframes

• Interactive prototypes

• High-fidelity interfaces

• Responsive layouts

• Design systems

• Strong understanding of:

• UX and usability principles

• Interaction design

• Accessibility

• Responsive design

• Mobile-first design

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Ability to clearly explain and defend design decisions

• Ability to collaborate effectively in a remote product environment

• Availability during U.S. client business hours

Preferred Experience

• Experience designing:

• SaaS products

• Mobile applications

• E-commerce platforms

• Experience building or maintaining scalable design systems

• Familiarity with:

• HTML/CSS fundamentals

• Developer workflows

• Agile/Scrum environments

• Experience with behavioral analytics tools such as:

• Hotjar

• FullStory

• Google Analytics

• Experience conducting A/B tests or design experiments

• Understanding of Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

Tools & Technology

Figma | Figma Dev Mode | Adobe XD | Sketch | Zeplin | InVision Inspect | Hotjar | FullStory | Google Analytics | HTML/CSS | Design Systems | Prototyping & Usability Testing Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

• Think about user journeys and product problems, not just individual screens

• Combine strong visual design skills with practical UX thinking

• Can clearly explain the reasoning behind your design decisions

• Are comfortable using research and data to challenge assumptions

• Understand how UX impacts adoption, engagement, conversion, and satisfaction

Your day may begin by reviewing user behavior, product feedback, or upcoming feature requirements to identify UX opportunities and potential friction.

Throughout the day, you could create user flows and wireframes, build and test interactive prototypes, design polished interfaces in Figma, or refine the product’s design system.

You’ll collaborate closely with Product and Engineering during sprint execution, incorporate feedback from usability testing and QA, and prepare developer-ready designs with clear specifications and interaction details.

description:
99Bright Minds is seeking a creative and experienced Senior UI/UX Designer to lead the design and user experience of the client's bilingual corporate website across desktop and mobile platforms. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in user-centered design, Arabic and English digital experiences, and modern design systems. You will be responsible for ensuring a consistent, accessible, and engaging user experience while maintaining alignment with brand guidelines and business goals.

Requirements

• Lead UX research activities, user journey mapping, information architecture, and wireframing for new pages, services, and digital features.

• Design high-fidelity user interfaces for desktop and mobile platforms in both Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR).

• Create, maintain, and evolve a comprehensive design system including components, typography, color palettes, spacing, grids, states, and reusable patterns.

• Develop interactive prototypes and facilitate design workshops, stakeholder reviews, and feedback sessions.

• Ensure designs comply with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards and align with corporate branding guidelines.

• Collaborate closely with development teams by providing detailed specifications, assets, and design documentation.

• Conduct design QA reviews to ensure implementation accuracy and consistency.

• Leverage analytics, usability data, and user feedback to identify opportunities for continuous UX improvement.

• Document design standards, decisions, and best practices for long-term maintainability and knowledge transfer.

Requirements

• 5 years of professional experience in UI/UX design for websites and mobile applications.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating successful delivery of user-centered digital products and corporate websites.

• Expert-level proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, auto layout, design systems, and interactive prototyping.

• Proven experience designing bilingual Arabic and English interfaces, including RTL layouts and Arabic typography best practices.

• Strong understanding of UX research methodologies, usability testing, user flows, and information architecture.

• Experience creating responsive designs across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

• Understanding of frontend implementation constraints, including HTML/CSS fundamentals and responsive design principles.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• At least one successfully delivered project for a client based in Saudi Arabia.

• Professional proficiency in both Arabic and English.

Nice to Have

• Experience designing corporate, enterprise, or government websites for organizations in Saudi Arabia or the GCC region.

• Familiarity with Saudi Digital Government Authority (DGA) digital experience and design guidelines.

• Experience in motion design, micro-interactions, and UI animation principles.

• Knowledge of accessibility auditing and inclusive design best practices.

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum product development environments.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
Staff Product Designer

Why YOU want this position

At Enverus, we’re committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world.

We are the most trusted energy-dedicated SaaS company, with a platform built to maximize value from generative AI, and our innovative solutions are reshaping the way energy is consumed and managed. By offering anytime, anywhere access to analytics and insights, we’re helping our customers make better decisions that help provide communities around the world with clean, affordable energy.

The energy industry is changing fast. But we’ve continued to lead the way in energy technology, creating intelligent connections across the entire energy ecosystem, from renewables, power and utilities, to oil and gas and financial institutions. Our solutions create more efficient production and distribution, capital allocation, renewable energy development, investment and sourcing, and help reduce costs by automating crucial business operations. Of course, this wouldn’t be possible without our people, which is why we have built a team of individuals from a diverse range of backgrounds.

Are you ready to help power the global quality of life? Join Enverus, and be a part of creating a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

About the Role

Enverus is looking for a Staff Product Designer to help bring structure, clarity, and a shared design practice to a product organization that is growing fast and scaling its design foundations. This is not a role where you inherit a mature design process. You’ll help create one: deciding what good looks like, setting the standards others follow, and building the systems that let the company move faster with more coherence.

This role sits at the intersection of product strategy and craft. You’ll help decide what to build and why, not only how it should look and work.

What You’ll Do

Strategy and Product Influence

• Partner with Product and Engineering to identify high-impact opportunities grounded in customer needs, business goals, and product insights.

• Help define product strategy by connecting user research and behavioral insight with business direction.

• Shape the “what and why” of product decisions, not only the “how.”

• Work with ambiguous problem spaces and help turn them into clear, actionable direction.

Design Systems and Foundations

• Partner with design system manager to evolve, and govern shared foundations, aligning on standards where systems overlap and making deliberate decisions where they diverge across Enverus products.

• Establish patterns, components, and principles that scale across squads and reduce inconsistency.

• Operate across squads to ensure coherence, quality, and long-term scalability of the product experience.

• Read and write front-end code (HTML, CSS, and component-level JavaScript or React) well enough to prototype in production-like conditions, review implementation details, and collaborate closely with Engineering on how the system is built and maintained.

Leading Through Ambiguity

• Bring structure to a complex, evolving organization: create clarity where little exists today, without waiting for perfect conditions.

• Design ways of working that fit both agile product teams and the more waterfall-style processes that exist across the business.

• Lead large initiatives that span multiple product areas or systems.

Craft and Quality

• Set design standards and lead critiques and design reviews across teams.

• Simplify complex workflows, particularly in data-heavy and domain-specific products.

• Raise the bar on craft, from interaction details to information architecture to visual systems.

Influence and Communication

• Frame design vision in business and user terms, and make the case for it to executives and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Align multiple teams around a shared direction, and facilitate discussions that lead to clear decisions.

• Tell compelling stories with research, prototypes, and data to build conviction.

Mentorship and Capability Building

• Mentor designers across teams and help grow the design practice from the ground up.

• Influence design decisions beyond the design team, across the wider Enverus organization.

• Help build the culture, processes, and habits that a design-led organization needs.

Working with AI

• Embrace emerging AI tools and workflows to accelerate discovery, exploration, prototyping, and execution.

• Experiment with new ways of working that increase design velocity without compromising quality.

• Help shape how Design collaborates with Product and Engineering as AI transforms the product development process.

• Bring curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to challenge traditional approaches to designing and building software.

What We’re Looking For

Required

• At least 3 years of experience in a staff, senior, or equivalent product design role, with demonstrated ownership of complex work.

• Strong, mature product design craft across interaction, visual, and systems design.

• Working knowledge of front-end code (HTML, CSS, and component-level JavaScript or React), enough to collaborate effectively with engineers on design system implementation and product delivery.

• Experience working in agile product environments, and comfort working within waterfall processes where they exist.

• Proven ability to establish structure and build systems within an organization that lacks formal processes.

• Comfort working across multiple design systems or product-specific component libraries.

• Exceptional communication skills, with experience influencing senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

• High autonomy: you make design decisions, push back when needed, and manage trade-offs without needing detailed oversight.

• Hands-on curiosity about AI tools and a practical sense of how they can change design and development work.

Preferred

• Experience building or scaling a design system.

• Experience designing for complex, data-intensive, or B2B domain products.

• Experience introducing design practice or process into a company that is early in its design maturity.

• Experience mentoring designers or leading design reviews across teams.

• Experience using AI tools in a design or prototyping workflow, and a point of view on where they help and where they don’t.

title: Studio Design Engineer
description:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

As a Studio Design Engineer, you turn design intent into real parts. You are part of the design studio, but your role sits at the intersection of industrial design and mechanical engineering, holding the design's intent on one side and the system’s demands on the other. You carry the surface all the way into production.

Key Responsibilities:

•
Engineer the part behind the surface. Take the A-surface from industrial design and build the B-side behind it: wall thickness, ribs, bosses, draft, parting lines, fastening, clips.

•
Own surface quality through every trade. Continuity, highlights, radii, gaps, flushness. When engineering pushes back, know what the surface can give up and what it cannot.

•
Work in CAD and in the physical. Model parametrically and build physically. Iterate fast: prepare prototypes, print parts, and refine fit and finish in the hand.

•
Lead material and process selection for hard surfaces. Polymers, metals, coatings, and the processes that form them. Match each material to surface, structure, cost, and feel. Keep a working library of qualified materials, processes, and suppliers.

•
Take parts into production. Run sample rounds, DFM reviews, and tooling. Own fit and finish until the part ships.

•
Present and own your work. Present directly to the Head of Design and stakeholders. Argue clearly for your ideas, take feedback on board, and plan the next steps.

Your profile

You are an engineer who can think like a designer. Someone who takes on complex problems, takes pride in their work, and holds beauty and invention as high as precision.

•
Experience: 4+ years engineering products that reached production. We hire on the portfolio: show us parts you took from sketch to CAD to tooling.

•
Core Skills: Parametric CAD, millimeter-precise. Plastic part design: draft, ribs, bosses, clips. Design for manufacture across injection molding, LSR, casting, and stamping. Hands-on prototyping and fit checks.

•
Mindset: You care how a part looks as much as how it works. You protect the design without slowing it down. You understand that our scope sometimes reaches beyond typical engineering work, and you are happy to help where needed. You carry the agility of a startup and the rigor of a segment-leading design studio.

Helpful (but not required) skills and experience

•
Experience in a design studio or consultancy.

•
Fusion 360, its PLM, and FEA.

•
A-surface modeling and analysis.

•
Interfaces between hard and soft goods.

Why us?

•
The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

•
Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

•
Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

•
Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

Product Designer (UX/UI) - Wellis Health

Rotterdam · Hybrid · Full-time

Wellis is a fast-growing healthtech scale-up reinventing healthcare. We are building the first truly integrated health platform in the Netherlands, offering on-demand care for everyday health needs such as weight loss, hair loss, sexual health, and more. Our platform covers the full journey: from diagnosis and medical assessment to prescription and delivery at home. By combining medical expertise, technology, and data, we make healthcare smarter, more accessible, more personal, and easier to use. We are growing quickly, which means we are building the structures, teams, products, and processes that will help us scale responsibly. You will join an ambitious, international team where ownership is encouraged, collaboration is key, and impact is visible from day one.

The role

You'll join our Web/App design chapter to shape how thousands of patients experience Wellis, from the first landing page to long-term treatment in our app. This is a hands-on B2C role with real ownership: you'll take problems from research to shipped UI, and you'll have wide scope to shape the art direction of our app.

We work AI-first. Research synthesis, ideation, prototyping, component work and design-to-code all run through tools like Claude, Figma MCP and Cursor.

What you'll do

•
Own product flows end to end across web and app. You'll frame the problem, join discovery, research, design, test and keep iterating on what ships.

•
Talk to customers regularly. You'll run interviews and usability tests and turn what you learn into product decisions that improve conversion, retention and trust.

•
Tell stories through the product. Design experiences that guide customers through their health journey and make complex medical information feel simple, human and engaging.

•
Bring gamification into the app: progress, milestones, rewards and the small moments of delight that keep people coming back and sticking with their treatment.

•
Set the art direction for the Wellis app and build a distinct design language that people recognise as Wellis at a glance.

•
Design high-quality UI with strong motion and interaction, so the product feels alive rather than static.

•
Extend and document our design system so the whole team can build on it.

•
Work closely with product and engineering, using end-to-end AI workflows to get from idea to production fast.

Non-negotiables

•
B2C experience. You've designed consumer products used by real people at scale.

•

We're designing entirely new interaction patterns around how AI and humans work together through agents, through writing, from fixing your grammar to helping you schedule meetings. We're looking for someone to help us on that journey, help us build out new agents across Grammarly and Superhuman Go, and really define what these modern interaction patterns will be. You'd be involved end to end, partnering closely with our engineering and product teams, from Kyiv to Silicon Valley.

Design zero to one agents. New writing and communication agents, built as AI-first products. A lot of the job is inventing interaction patterns that don't exist yet rather than applying ones that do.

Pioneer new AI design workflows. The way we design is changing underneath us. We often start in code, refine in Figma, and ship frontend changes back into the codebase. We're defining that way of working as we go, and we want people who are excited to help build something that lets designers make whatever they can imagine.

•
Lead and mentor. Raise the standard through critique, feedback, and working closely with less experienced designers.

Qualifications

•
Proficiency in industry-standard tools such as Figma and Claude Design is expected. The following outlines the skills and experience that will set exceptional candidates apart for this role.

•
Extensive experience designing complex, scalable software. The kind of tool people sit inside all day, so productivity tools, creative or CAD software, developer tools. Most of that depth lives on desktop, so mobile isn't a primary focus for this role.

•
A genuine interest in AI technology, both conceptually and in practical workflows like reading, writing and translating, and you're already experimenting with AI-driven prototyping.

•
You care about language and writing. Words are the product here, so we want someone who also thinks about how a sentence works, what makes writing sound like a person, and how tone shifts depending on who you're talking to, not just the interface around the words.

•
Comfortable working with metrics and data-driven design decision-making.

•
Bonus is having worked directly in code and shipped PRs to production.

Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.
