title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

The Role

As Senior Product Designer you shape how our customers and operators experience Optics11’s end-to-end underwater security solutions: from in-field sensor data acquisition, through data processing, to the software platform where that data is exposed and acted on. You combine user research with hands-on UX/UI design: you understand users in the field, turn those insights into workflows and interface designs, and hand over clear, build-ready designs to our front-end developers. You are part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with Product Management, R&D, Engineering, Data Science, Software, Sales, Projects and Application Engineering.

No two weeks will look the same. You might join an Application Engineer in the field, interview operators and technicians, trace how sensor data flows from the field to the operator’s screen, prototype a new workflow in Figma, or review a front-end implementation with the developers. You own the user experience of our software platform, from research insight to interface design, and make sure real user needs guide decisions across technical, product and commercial teams.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will establish a shared, evidence-based view of our users through personas, journey maps and a structured insight repository; evolve our design system and UI guidelines for the software platform; and deliver interface designs for priority platform features that our developers can build with confidence. This reduces development risk and helps us deliver technology customers can trust in demanding, high-stakes environments

Responsibilities

•
Lead user and customer research: plan and run qualitative, quantitative and field studies across installation, operation and maintenance (for example alongside our Application Engineers), and translate findings into product and design decisions.

•
Design the user experience of our software platform: turn product requirements from Product Management and the Product Owner into information architecture, user flows and interaction patterns for complex, data-rich operator workflows (detect, assess, identify and classify), from early concepts to interactive prototypes.

•
Propose and hand over UI designs to front-end developers: create high-fidelity, build-ready designs and specifications, align on feasibility with developers and the Product Owner, and review implementations for quality and consistency.

•
Own end-to-end customer journeys: map the experience from in-field deployment and data acquisition through data processing to the software platform, including demo flows and supporting internal processes.

•
Manage personas and customer insights: maintain the persona set and a central research repository, and synthesise learnings collected across the organisation.

•
Validate and measure outcomes: run usability tests before and after release, define adoption and usability metrics, and report impact to stakeholders.

•
Evolve and maintain our design system: extend the existing basis with UI components, patterns and guidelines that keep the platform consistent, accessible and efficient to develop.

•
Partner across the organisation: work closely with Product Management, Product Ownership and System Architecture, as well as Sales, Business Development, Application Engineering, Support and Marketing, to prioritise development, reduce product risk and advance user-centred practices.

Requirements

•
Master’s degree in interaction design, human-computer interaction, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

•
5+ years of experience in UX or product design, covering both user research and hands-on UX/UI design, preferably in defense or other technical, high-stakes industries.

•
A portfolio showing end-to-end work, from research and workflows to high-fidelity UX/UI for data-rich professional software (e.g. situational-awareness, control-room or analytics applications).

•
Experience working on integrated software platforms rather than isolated websites or prototypes.

•
Experience handing designs over to front-end developers and working with and evolving a design system, with a working understanding of front-end technology and its constraints.

•
Proficiency in qualitative and quantitative research methods, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and design proposals.

•
Understanding of end-to-end systems in which sensor data is acquired in the field, processed and exposed on a software platform, ideally in complex or regulated environments.

•
Able to translate complex technical workflows and data into clear, intuitive interfaces, with strong attention to visual detail, consistency and quality.

•
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; able to present research and designs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

•
Proficiency in Figma and in research and collaboration tools such as Jira Product Discovery, Dovetail and Miro.

•
Willingness to travel and do field research.

Driver’s license B (or international equivalent).

Ability to pass a background / security screening by the Dutch AIVD/MIVD, as you will be working with clients in the defense industry.

Nice to Have

title: Senior Web Designer / Delivery Lead
description:
NAXCON GmbH, located in the heart of Freiburg, is at the forefront of the German IT and engineering industry.

Our experts have extensive knowledge in software and hardware development, state-of-the-art electronics, and future-oriented technologies such as artificial intelligence and virtual reality.

We are not only dedicated to project work for our customers, but also intensively pursue in-house innovation projects as well as research & development. Renowned companies from a wide range of German industries place their trust in us - demonstrating the outstanding expertise and commitment of our engineers.

Position: Senior Web Designer / Delivery Lead

Type: Full-time/Remote

Field: Development of Information Platform

About the Role

The Senior Web Designer is the creative and delivery lead for a confidential geospatial project. The role combines senior-level screen design ownership with project management responsibility for the development period.

Design work covers: a TYPO3 13 LTS editorial website, a React 18 geospatial dashboard with interactive map (MapLibre GL JS), five chart types, paginated data tables, a report builder with PDF export, and an embeddable widget distributed as an npm package. The platform must meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA on the website and best-effort Level AA on the dashboard, with colour-blind-safe cartographic palettes throughout. All client communication is conducted in German.

Key Responsibilities

•
Own corporate design Develop the project-specific corporate design from scratch: logo direction, colour palette, typography, iconography, and form language — creating a visual identity that can be shared across two independent institutional project partners (Brandenburg & Mecklenburg-Vorpommern).

•
Screen design all view types Design responsive layouts for all page types (desktop, tablet, mobile) — including the Homepage, 12+ CMS page templates, and all dashboard states (standard fullpage, two-column comparison, filter panel, map layer controls, chart views, table views, and report builder flow).

•
Lead dashboard UX Translate complex geospatial and forestry inventory data into clear, usable dashboard interfaces. Design the information hierarchy for map layers, filters, legends, layer ordering, chart frames, and data tables. Define UX for the comparison view and URL-shareable filter states.

•
Build Figma component library Deliver a complete Asset Library and component set in Figma covering all interactive UI elements: CTAs, buttons, labels, tags, filter selectors, map controls, tooltips, chart frames, table controls, and report builder components.

•
Ensure WCAG 2.2 AA compliance Validate all colour choices for WCAG 2.2 AA contrast ratios. Design colour-blind-safe palettes for map layers and chart series (protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia). Annotate all Figma components with accessibility requirements (ARIA roles, focus states, keyboard interaction patterns).

•
Manage client delivery Serve as primary client contact for all design-related reviews. Lead formal design feedback cycles, present screen designs to client stakeholders in German, and ensure all accepted designs meet contractual accessibility and UX quality gates before handover to frontend development.

•
Support through Alpha & Beta Provide ongoing design support through both test phases — clarifying design intent, reviewing frontend implementations against Figma specs, and iterating based on user test feedback collected in the Beta round.

•
Optional deliverables Optionally lead Naming process, define a photographic image language, produce a clickdummy for stakeholder validation, and design a Dark Mode variant for the map view and/or the full platform.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional experience as a Senior Web Designer, UX/UI Designer, or equivalent creative lead role on web platform or digital product projects.

• Demonstrated project responsibility: at least 2 reference projects meeting the financial thresholds — one project with a minimum turnover of EUR 250,000 and a minimum duration of 2 years; one project with a minimum turnover of EUR 150,000 completed within one year.

• Proficiency in Figma — including component libraries, variants, auto-layout, and design-to-developer handoff workflows.

• Demonstrated experience designing responsive web interfaces across website and web application contexts.

• Proven WCAG 2.2 accessibility compliance at the design stage — practical knowledge of colour contrast validation, keyboard navigation patterns, and accessible component design for at least 1 reference project.

• Portfolio demonstrating at least one dashboard, data visualisation, or mapping/GIS interface design.

• Fluent German at minimum C1 level — all client communication and design presentations are conducted in German.

Nice to Have

• Experience designing geospatial or map-based interfaces (layer controls, map legends, filter panels, H3 hexagonal overlays).

• Background in creating complete design systems or corporate identity from scratch for multi-partner projects.

• Familiarity with BITV 2.0 or German public-sector accessibility expectations and EN 301 549.

• Experience designing colour-blind-safe palettes for data visualisation (tools such as Viz Palette, Colour Oracle, or equivalent).

• Knowledge of PDF/UA requirements for exported report design.

• Prior involvement in a German public-sector, open-source, or institutional digital platform project.

• Exposure to agile delivery workflows with structured developer handoff using Figma dev mode or design tokens.

• Optional: familiarity with dark-mode design for web applications.

What we offer:
•Join a cosmopolitan and internationally mixed team: We welcome individuals from all backgrounds and cultures to contribute their unique perspectives and talents to our team.
•Polish your German language skills: If you are looking to improve your German language skills, we offer a supportive environment where you can practice and develop your language abilities: whether you are a beginner or an advanced speaker.
•Benefit from a fixed contact person from the company: We understand the importance of having a reliable point of contact within the company. That's why we assign a dedicated contact person who will provide guidance and support throughout your employment with us.
•Professional growth and development: With us, our engineers can immerse themselves in new industries or projects after just 1-2 years and actively transfer knowledge.
•Enjoy regular team events with the company: We believe in the power of team building and fostering positive relationships within the workplace. That's why we organize regular team events to promote collaboration and strengthen our team bonds.
•Competitive compensation package: At NAXCON, we believe that our engineers are our greatest asset. That's why we offer a comprehensive and competitive compensation package that includes a salary commensurate with experience and expertise.

title: Member of Design Staff, Product Design
description:
About Abridge

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

The Role

As a Product Designer at Abridge, you won’t just be designing software. You’ll be redesigning the future of healthcare delivery. You’ll create experiences that give clinicians back time, reduce cognitive load, and enable doctors to give their patients undivided attention again.

Healthcare is broken in ways most people don’t see. Clinicians spend much of their time on administrative tasks, contributing to unprecedented burnout and compromised patient care. The current state of clinical documentation forces doctors to choose between looking at their patients and looking at their computers.

We’re hiring product designers with a range of experience levels, strengths, and areas of expertise. Your scope will reflect what you bring to the team, but every designer at Abridge is expected to take meaningful ownership, navigate ambiguity, and help raise the quality of our products and practice.

This role is for someone who dreams big and can reimagine experiences. You’ll work on problems that have never been solved before, in an industry where design decisions directly affect human lives and well-being.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Designer, you’ll shape the product experience at Abridge, setting a high bar for taste, clarity, and strategic thinking across initiatives that directly impact clinicians, patients, and care teams.

You’ll collaborate deeply with cross-functional partners, immerse yourself in the complexity of clinical workflows, and bring structure and empathy to ambiguous problems. Whether you’re exploring new ideas or refining existing experiences, you’ll advocate for design excellence throughout the product lifecycle.

•
Simplify the Complex: Tackle challenging and ambiguous design and customer problems, transforming complex clinical workflows and AI capabilities into intuitive, thoughtful, and delightful experiences.

•
Elevate Our Craft and Standards: Push the boundaries of visual and interaction design. Bring a strong command of design principles, motion, and prototyping; contribute to our evolving design standards; and ensure every detail and interaction is carefully considered.

•
Own End-to-End Design Execution: Design for today’s needs and tomorrow’s challenges, translating early ideas into clear product direction, high-fidelity designs, prototypes, and user flows. No task is too small or too large when it contributes to building an exceptional product.

•
Champion User-Centered Design: Advocate passionately for the clinicians and care teams who rely on our product every day. Engage in user research, synthesize insights, and ground design decisions in a deep understanding of users’ needs and pain points.

•
Lead Through Collaboration: Build strong partnerships across design, product, engineering, research, and other disciplines. Communicate clearly, invite feedback, and help teams make thoughtful decisions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical realities.

What You’ll Bring

•
5+ years of experience shipping impactful digital products, ideally within complex domains. Experience with AI-powered products is a plus.

•
A strong track record of taking meaningful design initiatives from concept through launch and demonstrating an impact on users and the business.

•
The ability to bring clarity and momentum to ambiguous problems, adapting your approach and level of ownership to the needs of the work.

•
A high craft bar that you consistently meet and help others elevate. You care deeply about the details while maintaining sight of the larger product experience.

•
Exceptional communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale and influence partners across functions.

•
A highly collaborative spirit and low ego, along with a genuine desire to learn, teach, give and receive feedback, and grow with a fast-paced, high-performing team.

Bonus Points If You Have Experience With

•
AI or machine-learning products

•
Consumer mobile products

•
Enterprise products

We value people who are eager to learn new things and recognize that great team members might not perfectly match a job description. If you’re interested in the role but aren’t sure whether or not you’re a good fit, we’d still like to hear from you.

Must be willing to work from our SF or NYC office at least 3x per week

This position requires a commitment to a hybrid work model, with the expectation of coming into the office a minimum of (3) three times per week. Relocation assistance is available for candidates willing to move to San Francisco or New York.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

•
Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

•
Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

•
Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

•
Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

•
Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

•
401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

•
Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

•
Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

•
Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

•
Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

•
Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

•
Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

•
... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. title: UX/UI Designer
description:
About Life Science Connect
Life Science Connect is a B2B media and data company serving the life sciences industry. We publish 15 industry websites and their email newsletters (including Bioprocess Online, Cell & Gene, Clinical Leader, Outsourced Pharma and Pharmaceutical Online), run sponsor-facing products such as Storefronts and supplier directories, and operate RFP Navigator, a platform for managing biopharma outsourcing RFPs. We are modernizing the user experience across all of it, and we are using AI to change how our content and data reach readers and clients.

The role
We're hiring our first dedicated UX/UI designer. You'll be a design partner to product, not only an executor of requirements: you'll help imagine and shape new experiences, products and interfaces for both our readers and our customers, then turn them into finished, buildable designs across web, email and SaaS. You'll work day-to-day with our Senior Product Manager, Audience & Data, alongside engineering, editorial and commercial teams.

The role starts as a 1099 contract as soon as possible, at about 22–28 hours a week. We plan to convert to a full-time position in Q1 2027. We're looking for someone who wants the full-time role. The contract start gets us working together sooner.

What you'll work on first

•
Website UX across 15 sites. For our move to a new CMS, we have core page templates and a design system in Figma, and the matching components are already built in our Storybook component library on Chromatic. You'll redesign, refine and extend them: a sponsored "Related Content" sidebar for article pages, sponsor Storefront microsite pages, and a searchable supplier directory with tiers and filters. Then you'll roll the changes out across all 15 site themes.

•
Email newsletter system. Design a modular email system and theme it into about 26 newsletter templates (editorial, sponsored and personalized "matched for you" sends). It has to render in Outlook, Gmail and Apple Mail, and work with mobile stacking, dark mode and images off.

•
RFP Navigator. A UX refresh of our B2B SaaS platform for two audiences: drug developers who issue RFPs and the CDMOs and CROs who answer them. This covers the marketing site, onboarding and the core RFP workflows.

Next on the roadmap: interactive AI content experiences (research content you can ask questions of), personalized on-site and reader-agent experiences, and self-service data products for clients.

What you'll do

• Partner with product to brainstorm and shape new experiences, products and interfaces for readers (the life science professionals who use our sites and newsletters) and customers (the sponsors and clients who buy our marketing, data and platform products).

• Turn PM requirements, briefs and rough prototypes into wireframes and high-fidelity Figma designs: desktop, tablet and mobile, with all states (empty, loading, error, logged-in vs anonymous).

• Present options and iterate with the PM, usually two or three review rounds per page type.

• Work within the existing design system (Figma plus our Storybook component library in Chromatic): reuse what's already built, and add new components back to the shared library.

• Spec designs for developers: layout, spacing, type, color tokens, interactions, responsive rules, content and data rules, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) and analytics events.

• Answer developer questions and review built pages against the designs before release.

• Use AI tools to move faster, and help the team adopt them.

What you bring (required skills)

• About 5–7 years of professional UX/UI design experience.

• A portfolio that shows work in at least two of these three areas: B2B SaaS or web application UX, content or media websites, and email or newsletter design.

• Strong Figma skills, including working inside another team's design system.

• Responsive design and clean developer handoff.

• Practical knowledge of email design constraints: client rendering, mobile stacking, dark mode and image-off fallbacks.

• Working knowledge of accessibility (WCAG 2.x AA).

•
AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your design workflow and can show how.

• You're a self-starter. You take direction, work independently and communicate progress without being chased.

• You can present your thinking clearly to product, editorial and commercial stakeholders.

Nice to have

• Mobile app UX.

• HTML/CSS, especially for email. We have engineers to build, but it helps if you can carry a design closer to code or a working prototype.

• Life sciences, B2B publishing or media experience.

• Data products, dashboards, or AI and conversational interfaces.

• Designing against a coded component library (Storybook / Chromatic).

How we work

• Remote, with a weekly working session with the PM plus reviews as needed.

• Figma for design, specs and handoff, plus shared tools for tickets and feedback.

•
Life Science Connect owns all work product.

We do not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

title: Digital Product Designer
description:
Title: Digital Product Designer
Reports to: Director of Product
Location: Remote

About the Organization
Upwardly Global is a national workforce development organization that connects work-authorized, college-educated immigrants to skill-aligned professional employment across the United States. We address one of the country’s most significant economic inefficiencies: more than 2 million highly educated, work-authorized immigrants are underemployed, representing over $40 billion in annual forgone wages and untapped productivity for the American economy.

Our model works. Jobseekers enter our programs earning an average of $9,000 per year and are placed in roles averaging $67,000 per year. To date, we have supported an estimated 35,000 job placements, contributing billions in earnings to the U.S. economy.
Upwardly Global is data-driven, economically accountable, and built for scale. We are committed to leveraging AI to its fullest potential, driving operational efficiency, jobseeker readiness, and national economic impact. We operate nationally, partnering with leading employers, workforce agencies, and policymakers to ensure that global talent becomes American advantage.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Product Designer who is passionate about designing products that improve people's lives to join our team and support our transformation to a digital product-driven organization.
The Product Designer will own the user experience of our platform end-to-end, collaborating with cross-functional teams to craft user-centered design solutions. They will leverage data and user research to inform the design process, resulting in products that are visually appealing but also highly functional and aligned with user needs. Because we are building an AI-powered career platform, this position will shape how our users experience AI as a helpful and trustworthy guide.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead design projects end-to-end, including user flows, wireframes, low-fidelity prototypes, high-fidelity mockups, and visual assets.

• Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to align design solutions with business goals and technical requirements.

• Design conversational and AI-guided experiences- chat, voice, and assistant-driven flows- so that AI feels like one coherent, consistent presence across the product.

• Design for our users' real conditions: mobile-first, accessible, and clear for users navigating English as a second or third language.

• Designing data-rich interfaces such as dashboards, progress indicators, or assessment/scoring displays and applying strong information hierarchy and visual encoding (color, iconography, progressive disclosure

• Own and evolve our design system- design documentation, style guides, component patterns, and asset libraries - to ensure consistency across a multi-role platform and to ensure alignment with the branding and enable clean handoff to engineering.

• Drive design iterations, refining and improving UX solutions based on feedback from users, team members, and stakeholders.

• Help plan and conduct usability tests, analyze results, and identify areas to improve the user experience.

Qualifications:

• 3–5 years of experience in UX and product design.

• A well-designed portfolio demonstrating relevant design projects and skills- including wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity design

• Experience designing AI-powered or conversational products (chatbots, voice agents, or AI assistants).

• Experience designing end-to-end, consumer-facing product experiences- not just individual screens or internal tools.

• Experience designing learning or educational products- structured content, progression, and progress-tracking systems.

• Familiarity with how LLM-based features behave- latency, variability, and the risk of incorrect output- and how thoughtful design mitigates those rough edges.

• Familiarity with front-end development technologies (e.g., React/component-based frameworks) and how they shape design implementation and handoff.

• Experience designing accessible, mobile-first interfaces, ideally for audiences with a range of language and digital literacy levels to ensure designs meet accessibility standards (i.e. WCAG compliance).

• Knowledge of usability testing methodologies and user research techniques.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, meet deadlines, and demonstrate professionalism and a positive attitude.

• A growth mindset- actively seeking feedback from users, stakeholders, and the design community, and continually sharpening your craft.

• Excitement about our mission to create an inclusive and welcoming country without barriers for newcomers to thrive in the labor market.

*To be considered for this role, please include a link to your portfolio or attach 3-5 relevant work samples with your application.

Salary Range: 110- 125K

Salary Disclaimer: The base salary range represents the low and high end of the Indeed salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Upwardly Global's total compensation package for employees. Benefits include a paid time off policy, medical/dental/vision insurance, paid parental leave, short-term disability insurance, life insurance and a retirement plan with employer match.
Upwardly Global is deeply committed to building a workplace where inclusion is not only valued but prioritized. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment.

The community you will join:

As a Senior Staff Experience Designer, you will partner with supporting disciplines such as writers, researchers, product specialists and engineers to build beautiful, usable, forward-looking products that empower people. Our design charter is to help foster an emotional connection with our community, keeping usability and accessibility as our prime virtues. We do our best to practice inclusive design at every turn, spanning both the online and offline experiences we create for our community.

The difference you will make:

As a Senior Staff Experience Designer in London, you will play a critical role in shaping how Airbnb shows up in markets across EMEA, Latin America, and APAC. You will help ensure our global products feel truly local—adapting core experiences to regional needs while feeding market insights back into the broader product strategy. Sitting at the intersection of product, design, and regional strategy, you will work across time zones and functions to define and deliver an international roadmap that spans both tactical UI improvements and larger strategic bets. You will bring a high bar for visual and interaction design craft, model AI-enabled ways of working, and provide senior design leadership in a space that is growing in complexity and impact for Airbnb globally. The Staff/Senior Staff Experience Designer is an individual contributor (IC) role that will report to a Manager or Director of Experience Design.

A typical day:

• Support and shape the evolution of the Airbnb platform from a design perspective; ensure consistency with, and contribute to, our brand architecture and product architecture.

• Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientist, Researchers and Writers to define problems & goals, map user flows, prototype interactions, and launch new products and services.

• Influence leadership decision making through a clear point of view and define and solve highly complex problems autonomously.

• Provide indirect leadership and mentorship for a team of designers through the end-to-end interaction and visual design of products and services for a global audience.

• Anticipate business challenges and independently create product solutions. Indirectly lead the work of a team of talented designers, writers, program managers, researchers, product managers and engineers as the defacto creative director of innovative projects

• Build strong relationships with leaders inside and outside of core product teams; strong communication and executive stakeholder management skills.

• Have a keen understanding of the technological, business and user opportunities and constraints.

• Scopes project work (in partnership with PMs and engineers) and helps define the design process and timeline.

Your expertise:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and progressive experience

• Designer/Design Leader with 12+ years of experience.

• Excellent visual and interaction skills and craft.

• Defines the design direction and process and can lead others through it.

• Can accurately scope their work as well as their teammate's.

• Can effortlessly motivate and drive small to medium teams to transform a product.

• Demonstrated ability to help a team navigate ambiguity, set vision, and set strategy for global products.

• Systems-thinker with the ability to think beyond the pixels and design for offline experiences.

• Experience with making complex information, tools, and services easily digestible for your audience.

• Strong storytelling, presentation, communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Experience designing platforms and systems.

• Experience managing and collaborating with research and writing disciplines.

• 0 to 1 experience or experience redesigning major elements of product, experience or service design.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

Spotify Technology brings our proven tools and services together for engineering organisations everywhere, from global enterprises to individual developers. As AI reshapes how software gets made, we're building on years of experience solving complex engineering challenges at scale.

Platform Design makes these powerful tools feel effortless. We shape the services, products and experiences used by Spotify's engineering teams and by developers around the world. We believe great design is a competitive advantage, and developer tools deserve the same care and craft as any consumer product.

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll combine product leadership with hands-on design and engineering. You'll shape the experience strategy for a key part of the Spotify Technology portfolio, establish a distinctive visual language, and turn internal tools into products customers love using. You'll work closely with product, engineering and marketing partners, reporting to the Spotify Technology Design Director.

What You'll Do

• Lead complex design challenges from early exploration through to production, creating intuitive flows, interfaces, interactions and motion that make powerful developer tools easier to use.

• Shape the visual language of Spotify Technology, bringing consistency, personality and craft across product experiences and brand touchpoints.

• Transform tools built for Spotify's engineering teams into compelling commercial products that meet the needs of developers and enterprise customers.

• Set experience strategy across your product area, partnering with product and engineering leaders to influence priorities, guide decisions and shape the roadmap.

Who You Are

Where You'll Be

description:

About Us

Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra's differentiated, end-to-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. Learn more at bonterratech.com.

About the Role

As a Lead Product Designer at NGP VAN, you'll own the experience of Mobilize, one of our flagship products, while shaping design direction across the broader product suite. This is a role for someone who operates at both levels: sharp enough to execute with craft and conviction, strategic enough to influence product direction before the designs are made.

You'll work closely with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional partners to drive decisions that hold up, not just look good in review. Your work will reach millions of users, people running campaigns, organizing communities, and turning out voters.

You'll work on products that help campaigns win, movements grow, and voters get heard. At NGP VAN, we're building the platform for democracy. The work is meaningful, the team is sharp, and there's real room to make your mark.

Essential Position Functions and Responsibilities:

• Own end-to-end design for a flagship NGP VAN product, from early problem framing through launch and iteration.

• Shape design direction across the NGP VAN product suite, establishing patterns and raising the quality bar beyond your primary product.

• Partner with product and engineering leadership to influence roadmap decisions, not just execute them.

• Translate ambiguous, complex problems into clear, scalable design solutions that hold up under real user pressure for both legacy product UI and AI innovation.

• Drive research and usability testing to ground decisions in evidence, and champion that standard across the team.

• Set and maintain a high bar for interaction quality, visual craft, and accessibility across everything you ship.

• Contribute to and evolve shared design systems and components that scale across products.

• Mentor designers and model what lead-level thinking looks like in critique, strategy, and execution.

Requirements:

You bring deep craft, clear thinking, and the credibility to influence product direction, not just execute it. Your portfolio shows complex, shipped work. Your process shows rigor. Your instincts show range.

• 8+ years of product design experience with a portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of complex, multi-surface experiences.

• Comfortable with designing for AI functionality and working with an AI pattern library across products.

• Fluency in interaction design and visual craft, with a high bar for quality at every level of fidelity.

• Proven ability to work within and contribute to design systems, creating solutions that scale beyond your immediate product.

• Experience shaping product strategy alongside PMs and engineers, influencing decisions upstream of execution.

• Strong research foundation: you know when to run a usability test, when to use existing data, and how to turn findings into action.

• Clear, confident communication with stakeholders at all levels, including the ability to defend and adapt decisions under scrutiny.

• Deep commitment to inclusive design, accessibility (WCAG), and ethical use of AI.

• Comfortable integrating AI tools like Claude, V0, and FigmaMake into your workflow

Preferred Skills:

• Familiarity with front-end principles (HTML/CSS) that helps you partner more effectively with engineering.

• Experience mentoring designers through critique, feedback, and modeling senior-level thinking.

This position is part of a bargaining unit represented by CWA Local 1400, 2336 or 13000.

Our Culture

At Bonterra, we’re innovating with a higher purpose: to increase giving to 3% of US GDP by 2033, creating $573 billion more in global impact every year. At Bonterra, we foster an inclusive, equitable culture where every team member belongs and contributes to meaningful impact. Read more about our values and culture here.

Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Product Design team is made up of several groups that define, create, and deliver all user-facing aspects of Stripe’s brand and product. Product Designers are strategic partners to Engineering and Product Management within their product area. In close collaboration with product teams, they shape user experiences, then translate them into high-quality designs that can be tested, shipped, and refined. Designers are responsible for building elegant, functional products that users love—and want to tell others about.

The Terminal design team crafts product experiences that empower users to configure and manage in person payments. This team transforms the intricate world of payments into intuitive solutions, letting users focus on growing their businesses. The team spans hardware and software, focusing on many types of users: end users who pay at the point of sale, cashiers and operations managers who set up and run the devices, and merchants who manage a fleet of devices and need to monitor performance.

What you’ll do

As a product designer, you’ll work closely with the product manager and engineering team to envision payments features in the Stripe Dashboard and our end-user-facing surfaces and partner with go-to-market teams to bring them to users. That includes new feature development, product quality improvements to our most frequently used workflows, and setting vision for our products to meet new user expectations in an increasingly data and AI-driven world.

Responsibilities

• Understand user workflows and pain points, and produce, test, and iterate on high-quality designs to solve user needs

• Partner closely with product, engineering, marketing, and strategy partners to define a north star and product experience for new features

• Prototype user experiences for user research testing and internal communication

• Collaborate with teams across Stripe to craft a seamless dashboard user experience

• Conduct user research to test design decisions before shipping

• Collaborate with our design systems teams to leverage and improve page templates and components

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• Has 4+ years relevant design experience at a product-driven tech company

• Has strong craft demonstrated through a portfolio of work

• Has demonstrated skills in prototyping at a high fidelity

• Has experience collaborating closely with engineering teams

• Has excellent written and verbal communication skills, demonstrated through design deliverables, videos, and written artifacts

Preferred qualifications

• Are excited about building collaborative relationships with many partners

• Are passionate for turning complexity into usable, beautiful experiences

• Are a strong design leader comfortable with bringing your point of view to a team

title: Lead Product Designer - Rentals
description:
This posting will be open until October 31, 2026. Applications received after this date may not be considered.

Redfin and Rocket are rebuilding the rental experience from the ground up. Rentals is one of the largest, most fragmented corners of real estate — millions of renters every month navigating a search-to-lease journey that is slow, opaque, and disconnected from everything that comes next. We have the audience, the data, and the distribution to fix it. What we don't have yet is the product.

As Lead Product Designer for Rentals, you’ll be the founding design voice on a business we’re rebuilding from zero to one, serving renters (B2C) and the property managers and landlords who list to them (B2B). We’re building the B2B side from the ground up, so you’ll have real say in what it becomes. You’ll partner directly with the Director of Product, Rentals, and a small, senior engineering team to define what we build, prove it fast, and ship it to a real audience at real scale. This is a true greenfield mandate with the backing of a company that already reaches 50M+ monthly visitors.

We're looking for someone who works fast and modern. The designers doing the best work right now are using AI to compress the distance between an idea and something real — generating and pressure-testing concepts in hours, building working prototypes instead of static flows, and spending the time they save on judgment and craft. We want someone who already works this way and will raise the ceiling for how the rest of the team does, too.

About the role

• Own end-to-end design for the Rentals experience for both renters and property managers — from the first search to a signed lease.

• Set the product vision for a business that doesn't exist yet: define the bets worth making, make them concrete enough to argue about, and sequence the path from first shippable thing to category-defining product.

• Move from idea to evidence fast. Use AI and prototyping tools to put real, testable artifacts in front of users and stakeholders in days rather than weeks, and let what you learn reshape the plan.

• Partner with the Director of Product, Rentals as a true peer — co-owning strategy, scope, and tradeoffs rather than receiving requirements.

• Design the B2B experience from scratch, including the tools property managers use to list, manage, and connect with renters.

• Ground decisions in both numbers and people. Run lightweight research, read the funnel, and know which signal to trust when they disagree.

• Build on our design system where it serves renters, and make the case for departing from it where it doesn't.

About you

•
8+ years as a product designer, with a portfolio of shipped products you can speak to in depth — what you decided, what you got wrong, and what the work actually did for users and the business.

• You've done zero-to-one work before and know how it differs from optimizing something mature. You're comfortable making decisions on incomplete information and changing your mind when the data arrives.

•
AI-native in practice, not in theory. You use AI tools daily in your design process and can show us how. You have a point of view on where they help, where they don't, and how designers should be working two years from now.

• A systems thinker who can hold a multi-sided marketplace in your head — renters, property managers, listings, and the rest of the Redfin and Rocket ecosystem.

•
Exceptional craft. You care about the details that make a product feel trustworthy, and you can defend why they matter to people who'd rather ship without them.

• A compelling communicator who can make a vision legible to engineers, executives, and skeptics — and move a room with it.

•
Scrappy and self-directed. You'd rather build the thing than write the deck about the thing.

•
Genuinely interested in renters. The people using this product are often at their most stressed and least served. That should feel like an opportunity to you.

•
Experience with marketplaces or B2B products is a plus. You can hold a multi-sided system in your head: renters, property managers, listings, and the rest of the Redfin and Rocket ecosystem.

What you’ll get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.

About us

Redfin is a technology-driven real estate company with the country's most-visited real estate brokerage website. As part of Rocket Companies (NYSE: RKT), Redfin is creating an integrated homeownership platform from search to close to make the dream of homeownership more affordable and accessible for everyone. Redfin’s clients can see homes first with on-demand tours, easily apply for a home loan with Rocket Mortgage, and save thousands in fees while working with a top local agent.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll shape the future of Imprint's member experiences, leading complex product initiatives from discovery through execution. You'll combine exceptional design craft with strategic thinking and strong product judgment to identify opportunities, simplify complex problems, and deliver intuitive, high-impact solutions. Partnering closely with Product and Engineering, you'll influence product direction, champion exceptional user experiences, and raise the bar for design craft, collaboration, and decision-making across the organization.

What You’ll Do

Shape Product Strategy & Direction

•
Partner with Product and Engineering to identify high-impact opportunities grounded in customer needs, business goals, and product insights.

•
Proactively define problems, challenge assumptions, and influence product priorities and direction.

•
Lead complex, ambiguous initiatives from early discovery through launch and iteration.

•
Balance near-term product improvements with longer-term opportunities to meaningfully improve the customer experience.

•
Bring clarity and structure to ambiguous problems, helping teams make thoughtful decisions and move forward.

Lead End-to-End Product Design

•
Own the design process from discovery and concept exploration through detailed interaction design, prototyping, and delivery.

•
Translate complex financial products and workflows into simple, intuitive, and engaging experiences.

•
Explore multiple approaches, establish clear design principles, and articulate the rationale behind decisions.

•
Create thoughtful, high-quality experiences that balance usability, accessibility, business objectives, and technical feasibility.

•
Partner with Engineering throughout implementation to ensure the quality and integrity of the shipped experience.

•
Use research, data, and customer feedback to validate solutions and continuously improve the product.

Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration

•
Build strong, trusted partnerships with Product Managers and Engineers, operating as an equal partner in shaping product outcomes.

•
Facilitate collaborative problem-solving, bringing teams together around shared goals and thoughtful solutions.

•
Navigate competing priorities and constraints, making pragmatic tradeoffs without losing sight of the customer experience.

•
Communicate design decisions clearly and persuasively, building alignment across stakeholders and leadership.

•
Take shared ownership of product outcomes, not just design deliverables.

Elevate Design Quality & Team Impact

•
Set a high bar for UX craft, interaction design, and the overall quality of our product experiences.

•
Contribute to a culture of thoughtful critique, continuous learning, and collaborative problem-solving.

•
Mentor and support other designers and teammates, helping strengthen their craft, judgment, and strategic thinking.

•
Identify opportunities and propose solutions to improve design practices, workflows, and collaboration across the organization.

•
Contribute to the evolution and adoption of our design system, balancing consistency with opportunities for innovation.

Explore the Future of Product Design

•
Embrace emerging AI tools and workflows to accelerate discovery, exploration, prototyping, and execution.

•
Experiment with new ways of working that increase design velocity without compromising quality.

•
Help shape how Design collaborates with Product and Engineering as AI transforms the product development process.

•
Bring curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to challenge traditional approaches to designing and building software.

What We're Looking For

Required

•
7+ years of product design experience, with a track record of leading complex, high-impact initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.

•
Exceptional UX and interaction design skills, demonstrated through strong craft, thoughtful problem-solving, and measurable outcomes.

•
Strong product judgment, connecting customer needs with business goals and balancing near-term improvements with long-term vision.

•
Proven experience independently identifying opportunities, framing problems, exploring compelling solutions, and influencing product direction.

•
Strong partnership with Product and Engineering to navigate ambiguity, evaluate tradeoffs, and prioritize solutions based on impact and effort.

•
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, articulating design rationale, building alignment, and influencing stakeholders at all levels.

•
A pragmatic, iterative approach to design, balancing speed and quality, incorporating feedback, and thoughtfully phasing solutions to deliver value over time.

Nice to Have

•
Experience designing complex financial products, consumer fintech experiences, or regulated workflows.

•
Experience working in fast-moving, high-growth startup environments.

•
Experience evolving and scaling design systems, identifying opportunities to improve patterns, strengthen consistency, and contribute to a more cohesive product experience.

•
Familiarity with experimentation, product analytics, and research-driven design.

•
Experience using AI-assisted design, prototyping, or development tools.

•
Familiarity with frontend technologies and modern design-to-development workflows.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12 months:

•
You've led meaningful product initiatives from problem definition through launch, delivering measurable customer and business impact.

•
You've built trusted partnerships with Product, Engineering, Commercial, and other stakeholders, helping shape priorities and improve product decisions.

•
You've introduced thoughtful, innovative and intuitive solutions to complex customer problems while maintaining a high bar for usability and craft.

•
You've helped the team move faster and make better decisions through clear design rationale, effective collaboration, and pragmatic execution.

•
You've elevated the quality of design across the team through mentorship, critique, and shared practices, and contribution to our design system.

•
You've helped evolve how we design and build products, embracing new tools and approaches that increase our effectiveness.

We don't expect every candidate to check every box. If this role excites you and you bring strong fundamentals, we encourage you to apply.

Figma, Storybook, design tokens. Frontend component libraries (React/TypeScript). AI-assisted design and development tooling.

Learn More

Learn more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog:

•

•
Leading configured work computers of your choice

•
Flexible paid time off

•
Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

•
Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

•
Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

title: Staff Product Designer (AI Track)
description:
Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.

We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As Staff Product Designer, you will own the end-to-end design of MEDvidi's AI Track, the core line of AI-powered clinical tools where providers interact with model outputs in a regulated healthcare environment. Your design decisions directly shape how clinicians review, accept, and correct AI-generated notes, treatment plans, and recommendations, impacting both provider efficiency and patient outcomes.

You will work closely with product managers and engineers, reporting to the Director of Product. This is a senior IC role with no direct reports: you drive product design from problem definition through delivery, gather requirements independently, and bring solutions to release. Your scope includes provider-facing tools (Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist), patient portal, and internal operational systems, all web-based.

Why this role

•
Zero-to-one in AI-first environment. You will shape new interaction patterns for agentic AI features: Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist, where design quality directly affects clinical decisions.

•
Prototype in real code, not Figma mockups. Prototyping happens in Claude Code and Cursor on the actual codebase with production components. Your prototypes go straight to engineering without redrawing.

•
Co-own a design system built for humans and AI agents. You will evolve reusable components, tokens, and documentation that are readable by both your teammates and code-generation agents, a rare opportunity to define what design systems look like in an AI-native workflow.

Responsibilities

•
Own product design in your areas of the AI Track end-to-end: from defining the problem with the product manager, through user analysis, to working with engineers on the solution and accepting the build.

•
Design and iterate on human-AI interaction patterns: interfaces where providers verify, accept, edit, or reject model output and bring those patterns to a state where other teams can reuse them.

•
Ensure quality of design decisions: validate solutions with users when needed, perform design acceptance with engineering, analyze post-release results, and feed learnings back into the product.

•
Contribute to the design system within product initiatives: turn your solutions into reusable components in Storybook with tokens, naming, and documentation that are usable by both designers and AI code-generation agents.

•
Gather requirements independently: go to providers, medical operations, and product managers, identify problems, and bring back a proposal. There is no standing PM brief in AI Track, you shape the brief.

•
Accelerate design delivery using AI tools: build functional prototypes in Claude Code or Cursor on the real codebase with production components; prototypes go to engineering without redrawing.

This role is not for you if

• You need a detailed brief before starting work. Requirements here are gathered by you, not handed to you, there is no PM or BA writing specs for AI Track.

• You prefer managing people over hands-on design. This is an IC role with no direct reports; the impact comes from the quality of your own design decisions.

• You design exclusively in Figma and hand off static specs. Prototyping at MEDvidi happens in code on the real codebase using AI agents, comfort with a code editor is a daily requirement, not a nice-to-have.

Requirements

• 6+ years in product design, with a focus on complex work interfaces: EHR, admin panels, CRM, operational tools, or other systems where specialists perform their core work.

• Demonstrable experience designing human-AI interaction: interfaces where users verify, accept, edit, or reject model output. Building a 0-to-1 agentic product is ideal; experience with review-and-approval interfaces for automated decisions also qualifies.

• Hands-on prototyping in code using AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) on an existing component library or codebase, not just design tools.

• Track record of contributing to a design system within product work: shipping reusable components, tokens, and documentation as part of feature delivery, not as a standalone project.

• Proven ability to gather requirements independently, finding problems, talking to users and stakeholders, and driving a solution to release without waiting for a mandated brief.

• Advanced English (B2+) and fluent Russian.

• Availability to work within CET-compatible hours.

Would be a plus

• Experience in healthcare or telemedicine products: understanding of HIPAA, clinical compliance constraints, and the provider's role in decision-making.

• Experience leading a design team's transition to AI tools: setting up shared agent workflows, running workshops, driving adoption across peers.

• Hands-on user research with specialist users: usability testing and interviews with doctors, nurses, or clinical operators (not only end consumers).

What we offer

•
High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.

•
Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.

•
Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.

•
Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.

•
Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.

•
Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.

•
Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

﻿

MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

description:
Company Overview / Employee Value Proposition

Established in 2010, Vinova is a passion-driven and award-winning development company for mobile, web, and enterprise applications. Our clients span the globe and cover a wide range of projects including IoT, blockchain, banking, fintech, networking, and ecommerce. Vinova earns respect from customers by being committed to quality, flexibility, and speed. We strive to build great products by working with passion, working closely with our customers, and through open but disciplined collaboration. You will be working in an encouraging and challenging environment, taking advantage of the latest technology to develop excellent digital solutions for global clients. You will be engaging clients in both on-site and off-site capacities.

•
Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary packages, performance-based bonus schemes, and structured annual merit reviews.

Application Process

Interested candidates are invited to submit:

description:
UI/UX DESIGNER, SEEKING

Product | Full-Time, Salaried | Reports to Head of Product

Location

Remote, anywhere in the USA (Las Vegas, NV strongly preferred)

Compensation

$90,000 to $140,000 base

Required for team weeks, user research, and quarterly planning in Las Vegas

About the Role

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We work at the intersection of technology, consumer psychology, and product design at the highest level. Our mission is to help people foster genuine relationships and find love, and to rethink how social platforms can advance human connection.

We are hiring a UI/UX Designer who combines three things: systems thinking, customer obsession, and an eye for emotionally rich interaction design. Dating is an emotional product. People act on emotion first and logic second, so our interface has to earn trust, build excitement, and guide each member toward the next right step.

You will work directly with the Co-CEOs and Head of Product, embedded in a cross-functional pod with a Product Manager, engineers, and a data engineer. Each pod owns a funnel, such as onboarding, and is measured on the sign-ups, engagement, and purchases it drives. You will design across web and native iOS and Android: onboarding, discovery, matching, messaging, profile, and subscription surfaces.

AI tools can now produce a basic, competent interface in minutes. That makes tool skill table stakes. We pay for judgment: understanding the member deeply, anticipating edge cases before they ship, and knowing when an experience should be fast and minimal and when it should be layered with motion, video, and texture that pull the member forward.

This role may also be a fit for candidates whose current title is UX Designer, UX/UI Designer, Product Designer, Interaction Designer, Visual Designer, Motion Designer, or Product Design Engineer. If your day-to-day is designing and shipping consumer experiences that real people love using, apply regardless of title.

What You'll Own

Customer Obsession & Research

• Spend real time with members: interviews, session recordings, support tickets, and beta groups of real users who test new work before it ships.

• Turn what you learn into designs that match how members actually want to browse, connect, and communicate.

Systems Thinking & Edge Cases

• Design complete flows, including every state, error, empty screen, and edge case, so engineering builds it right the first time.

• Break big experience problems into small, shippable steps that build momentum.

• Work inside our design system and extend it cleanly when a new pattern is needed.

Emotional & Interaction Design

• Design for emotion and guidance: motion, video, fluid transitions, and layered texture that build excitement and lead members along the right path.

• Keep task moments such as settings, payments, and verification fast, clean, and effortless.

• Make the effect of member actions visible, so adding a photo, completing a profile, or verifying feels immediately rewarding.

Core Experiences You'll Shape

• Onboarding that takes a new member from download to a compelling profile in minutes.

• Conversational, AI-guided profile building that replaces long forms.

• Discovery and shortlisting flows that move members from browsing to real connection.

• Messaging as seamless as the best consumer apps, with rich media and video built in.

• Self-presentation tools that let members who value discretion show who they are with confidence.

Data-Driven Iteration

• Work from funnel and engagement data with your pod. Instrument what you ship and read the results.

• Prototype in Figma, Framer, or code (v0, Lovable, Cursor) and put ideas in front of real members within days.

Agentic Operating Model

• Use Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and comparable tools every day to explore more options and ship faster.

• Help build the design team's agent workflows and playbook so the whole team compounds.

Required Qualifications

• A portfolio of shipped consumer product work that shows exceptional UI/UX craft: typography, layout, motion, interaction, and polish.

• A consistent pattern of customer obsession across your career. Your case studies start with the user and end with what changed for them.

• Systems thinking. You anticipate edge cases, design every state, and see how one screen affects the whole journey.

• Proven ability to design for emotion, using motion, transitions, video, and visual texture with purpose.

• Relentless curiosity. You keep asking why until you understand the member, and you are always learning.

• Smart risk-taking. You try bold ideas, test them small, and learn fast.

• Three or more years of hands-on UI/UX or product design experience in consumer B2C, mobile, or subscription products.

• Expert Figma: component systems, auto-layout, prototyping, tokens, and multi-file library management.

• Daily, fluent use of agentic AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, or comparable), with enough technical and architectural fluency to direct AI toward results that scale. You will be asked to demonstrate this in the interview.

• Comfort working from funnel and engagement data (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Firebase, or comparable).

• Outstanding written and verbal communication. You can walk the CEO through a design decision clearly and quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior work in dating, social, marketplace, or subscription products.

• Motion design skills in tools such as After Effects, Rive, Lottie, or Principle.

• Front-end fluency (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) sufficient to ship small changes yourself.

• Experience running or partnering on customer beta programs.

• Public work we can see: portfolio, prototypes, Dribbble, Behance, or a personal site.

• Bachelor's degree in design, human-computer interaction, or a related field. We weigh the work most heavily.

Compensation & Benefits

• Base salary: $90,000 to $140,000, commensurate with experience and craft.

• Full-time, salaried, fully remote within the US.

• 99% coverage of our medical base plan, dental, and vision insurance. 65% coverage for qualified dependents. 100% coverage of short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance for qualified employees.

• 50% 401(k) match up to 6% per month. Flexible Spending Account. Flexible paid time off.

• Direct exposure to the CEO and Head of Product, and regular time with real members.

Datavanters bring a diversity of professional, educational and life experiences to realize our bold vision for healthcare.

As a member of our Product Design team, you will be designing our most critical user experiences and internal tools for our Release of Information team. You will be collaborating with Product Managers, Engineers and Operations partners to conduct user research, and design and build a suite of internal tools and enterprise capabilities that powers our internal operations teams to deliver high-quality products and service experiences to our customers.
